english_meaning: The true God who alone deserves to be worshipped
bahasa_meaning: Nama khas bagi Tuhan yang sebenar-benarnya, yang berhak disembah dengan penuh kecintaan, pengagungan, dan ketundukan
proof_text: إِنَّنِي أَنَا اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنَا فَاعْبُدْنِي وَأَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ لِذِكْرِي
aqeedah_belief: The supreme proper name of God that encompasses all of His beautiful Names and Attributes. It indicates His absolute Lordship, absolute Divinity (Uluhiyyah), and His unique right to be worshipped exclusively without partners.
salah_usage: Bring complete presence of heart during the opening Takbeer (Allahu Akbar) and reflect on His sole divinity.
dua_usage: Invoke using Ya Allah for comprehensive worldly and spiritual needs, as it is the most encompassing supplication.
dhikr_usage: Constantly repeat La ilaha illa Allah (There is no deity except Allah) and Subhan Allah (Glory be to Allah) to purify the soul.
when_to_invoke: In times of severe distress, when seeking total guidance, and when renewing one's sincerity and monotheism.
ghazali_insight: This name is the greatest of the ninety-nine names of God because it refers to the essence which unites all the attributes of divinity, so that none of them is left out. Man's share in this name should be for his heart and aspiration to be completely taken up with God, looking to none other and fearing none other.
description_en: Allah is the proper name of the Supreme Being. It is the majestic, all-encompassing name that forms the very core of Islamic monotheism (Tawhid). It is never given to any creation, literally or metaphorically. When a believer says Allah, they are calling upon the One who holds the keys to the unseen, the Creator of the heavens and the earth, and the source of all existence.
description_ms: Allah ialah nama khas bagi Zat Yang Maha Suci, Pencipta sekalian alam. Nama agung ini menghimpunkan segala sifat kesempurnaan, keagungan, dan keindahan-Nya. Menyebut nama Allah dengan penuh adab akan menumbuhkan rasa cinta yang mendalam, membangkitkan ketundukan jiwa, dan mengukuhkan tauhid di dalam hati sanubari seorang mukmin.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 51-52; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 15-20; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 12, p. 277 / page_id 5933).
al_jalil_commentary: Focuses on refining sincerity (Ikhlas) and establishing love, fear, and hope (Al-Mahabbah, Al-Khawf, Al-Raja') inside the heart, which are the pillars of true worship.
dhikr_usage_en: Constantly repeat La ilaha illa Allah (There is no deity except Allah) and Subhan Allah (Glory be to Allah) to purify the soul.
dhikr_usage_ms: Ucapkan La ilaha illa Allah (Tiada tuhan selain Allah) dan Subhan Allah (Maha Suci Allah) secara berterusan untuk menyucikan jiwa.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Al-Biqa'i notes that 'Allah' is used as the proper Name (Al-Ism al-Alam) in 20:14 because it encompasses all beautiful Names and fits the station of divine majesty shown to Musa (AS), leading directly into the command for exclusive worship.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 12, p. 277 / page_id 5933)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Tunggal dalam Zat, Sifat, dan Perbuatan-Nya
proof_text: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
aqeedah_belief: Belief that Allah is absolutely unique, indivisible, and without partner, peer, or equal. He is singular in His Being and His Attributes, and there is absolutely nothing like unto Him in the universe.
salah_usage: Recite Surah Al-Ikhlas in daily prayers with deep contemplation of His absolute uniqueness and independence.
dua_usage: Supplicate to Ya Al-Ahad to keep your heart firm on monotheism and free from any attachment to creation.
dhikr_usage: Say Ya Al-Ahad to anchor the heart in divine singularity and detach from worldly illusions.
when_to_invoke: When feeling lonely, when facing peer pressure to compromise one's faith, or when purifying one's heart from hidden shirk (polytheism).
ghazali_insight: Imam al-Ghazali explains in Part One that Al-Ahad (the One) and Al-Wahid (the Unique) appear in different narrations of the ninety-nine names to convey the same meaning of God's unity (tawhid). Rather than counting both as separate names when their meaning is one, either name points to the indivisible, peerless Essence that can neither be partitioned nor duplicated.
description_en: Al-Ahad is the Name that signifies Allah's absolute uniqueness and indivisibility. Unlike Al-Wahid (The One), which can signify being first in a sequence, Al-Ahad emphasizes that there is no second, no partner, and no equal whatsoever. He is completely singular in His majesty and glory, transcending any concept of composition or physical parts.
description_ms: Al-Ahad ialah nama agung yang menegaskan bahawa Allah Maha Tunggal dan tidak boleh dibahagi-bahagikan. Dia Esa dalam segala Sifat keagungan-Nya, tanpa ada sekutu, tandingan, atau pembantu. Sifat ketunggalan ini membersihkan jiwa mukmin daripada bergantung kepada makhluk, serta mengarahkan segala ibadah dan pergantungan hanya kepada-Nya.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 17, 134; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 55-60; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, pp. 11678-11683).
al_jalil_commentary: Cultivates pure reliance (Tawakkul) by realizing that since Allah is uniquely the only controller of benefit and harm, the heart should seek help and fear only Him.
dhikr_usage_en: Say Ya Al-Ahad to anchor the heart in divine singularity and detach from worldly illusions.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Ahad untuk meneguhkan hati pada keesaan Ilahi dan melepaskan diri daripada ilusi duniawi.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Al-Biqa'i explains why 'Ahad' in Surah Al-Ikhlas 112:1 appears without 'al-' whereas Al-Wahid always takes 'al-': in affirmative speech, 'Ahad' is exclusive to Allah (indivisible in Essence, unlike Al-Wahid which affirms relational uniqueness without partner). In ordinary Arabic, bare 'ahad' is only used in negation ('not a single one').
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, pp. 11678-11683)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One,

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Tinggi Sifat, Kedudukan, dan Kekuasaan-Nya mengatasi segala sesuatu
proof_text: سَبِّحِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى
aqeedah_belief: Belief in Allah's absolute highness (Uluww) in three dimensions: His Highness of status and attributes, His Highness of subjugation and power, and His Highness of Being (Dhat) above His Throne, transcending all creation.
salah_usage: Say Subhana Rabbiyal A'laa (Glory be to my Lord the Most High) during prostration, placing your highest part (the forehead) on the lowest ground in complete humility.
dua_usage: Invoke Ya Al-A'laa to elevate your spiritual rank and grant victory over injustice.
dhikr_usage: Repeat Subhana Rabbiyal A'laa to establish humility in the soul and declare Allah's supreme position.
when_to_invoke: When feeling small or oppressed, when facing situations of arrogance in others, or during prostration to humble oneself.
ghazali_insight: Al-Ghazali notes that the most exalted creation (the Prophet ﷺ) was given this Name as a veil of Divine Reality, for only Allah truly knows the ultimate depth of His High status. High status in servants is achieved by elevating one's aspiration above sensory desires.
description_en: Al-A'laa denotes Allah's supreme elevation above everything in existence. His Highness is absolute and flawless—transcending physical height, He is High in His majestic status, His ultimate dominion, and His lofty Essence. He reigns supreme above the heavens, and everything else is under His absolute control and superior authority.
description_ms: Al-A'laa menunjukkan bahawa Allah Maha Tinggi dalam segala aspek tanpa sebarang bandingan. Ketinggian-Nya meliputi Zat, Sifat, dan kekuasaan-Nya yang mutlak di atas seluruh makhluk. Menyedari sifat ketinggian Allah melahirkan rasa kerdil dalam diri manusia, membuang sifat takbur dan ego, serta menanam kesetiaan yang mutlak kepada perintah-Nya.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 26, 47; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 110-115; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 21, p. 391 / page_id 11260).
al_jalil_commentary: Teaches the believer to lower themselves in absolute submission, removing all pride, since all highness belongs exclusively to the Lord of the worlds.
dhikr_usage_en: Repeat Subhana Rabbiyal A'laa to establish humility in the soul and declare Allah's supreme position.
dhikr_usage_ms: Ulangi Subhana Rabbiyal A'laa untuk menyemai sifat rendah diri dalam jiwa serta mengikrarkan ketinggian darjat Allah.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Surah Al-A'laa 87:1, al-Biqa'i notes that 'Al-A'laa' (The Most High) commands the Prophet (SAW) to exalt Allah far above the false claims and accusations of the disbelievers.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 21, p. 391 / page_id 11260)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Pemurah dan Maha Mulia melebihi segala bentuk kemurahan makhluk
proof_text: اقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ الْأَكْرَمُ
aqeedah_belief: Belief that Allah's generosity (Karam) is infinite and unmatched. He gives without being asked, multiplies small deeds into massive rewards, forgives major sins upon sincere repentance, and bestows blessings without expecting anything in return.
salah_usage: Reflect on Al-Akram's endless giving during Ruku and Sujud, begging Him for His noble rewards and bounty.
dua_usage: Call upon Ya Al-Akram to grant success in studies, increase in useful knowledge, and abundance in provision.
dhikr_usage: Say Ya Al-Akram to remind yourself of the boundless ocean of divine grace and to foster gratitude.
when_to_invoke: When seeking knowledge, when initiating a new project (like writing or reading), or when feeling unworthy or despairing of Allah's forgiveness.
ghazali_insight: True generosity (Karam) in the absolute sense belongs only to Allah, who forgives when He is able, fulfills when He promises, and exceeds expectations when He gives. A servant's share is to be generous with their wealth, knowledge, and kindness towards others without expecting return.
description_en: Al-Akram is the superlative form of Al-Karim, representing the apex of generosity, nobility, and kindness. While Al-Karim is generous, Al-Akram is the Most Generous, whose giving has no boundaries and whose tolerance of His servants' shortcomings is infinite. He initiated creation out of pure generosity and sustains them with unceasing blessings.
description_ms: Al-Akram melambangkan kemuncak kemurahan dan kemuliaan Allah yang tiada tandingan. Dia memberi sebelum diminta, mengurniakan ganjaran berlipat kali ganda ke atas amalan yang sedikit, dan mengampunkan dosa-dosa besar apabila hamba-Nya bertaubat. Nama ini mula-mula diturunkan dalam wahyu pertama untuk menunjukkan bahawa kurniaan ilmu dan bimbingan al-Quran adalah tanda terbesar kemurahan-Nya.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 94; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 130-135; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 22, p. 159 / page_id 11455).
al_jalil_commentary: Links the first revelation of "Read! and your Lord is the Most Generous" to show that Allah's greatest generosity is the gift of revelation, knowledge, and the intellect to understand His signs.
dhikr_usage_en: Say Ya Al-Akram to remind yourself of the boundless ocean of divine grace and to foster gratitude.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Akram untuk mengingatkan diri tentang limpahan kurnia Ilahi yang tiada batasnya serta memupuk rasa syukur.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Alaq 96:3, al-Biqa'i explains why 'wa Rabbuka al-Akram' ('and your Lord is the Most Generous') follows the second 'Read!': when the Prophet (SAW) could not read, Allah's supreme generosity guarantees He will teach and make him read.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 22, p. 159 / page_id 11455)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -

english_meaning: The One Who alone deserves to be worshipped
bahasa_meaning: Tuhan Yang Sebenar, yang berhak disembah dan diabdikan diri kepada-Nya secara mutlak
proof_text: وَإِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ ۖ لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الرَّحْمَٰنُ الرَّحِيمُ
aqeedah_belief: Belief that Allah is the only true object of adoration, love, and submission. All other false gods, idols, desires, and worldly forces are invalid objects of worship. Tawhid al-Uluhiyyah is built entirely upon this Name.
salah_usage: Focus intensely on the phrase Iyyaka na'budu wa iyyaka nasta'in (You alone we worship and You alone we ask for help) as the practical realization of Al-Ilaah.
dua_usage: Use Ya Ilaahi (O my Lord/God) when begging for spiritual steadfastness and protection from deviation.
dhikr_usage: Say La ilaha illa Allah continuously as a direct affirmation of the name Al-Ilaah, purifying the soul from minor associations.
when_to_invoke: When refining your intention (Niyyah), when protecting your heart from showing off (Riya'), or when renewing the declaration of faith (Shahadah).
ghazali_insight: Al-Ilaah represents the true existent who unites all the attributes of divinity, making Him the sole legitimate target of devotion and worship. The servant's share is to turn their heart completely away from worldly deities like money, status, or self-desires.
description_en: Al-Ilaah is the direct Quranic term for 'The Deity' who possesses the absolute right to be worshipped. While 'Rabb' emphasizes creation, ownership, and lordship, Al-Ilaah focuses on the relationship of worship, love, fear, hope, and absolute submission that creatures owe to their Creator. It is the defining word in the test of faith.
description_ms: Al-Ilaah merujuk kepada Tuhan yang sebenar-benarnya berhak disembah dan ditaati secara mutlak. Nama ini menegaskan kebatilan segala sembahan selain-Nya, sama ada patung, berhala, mahupun hawa nafsu dan kebendaan duniawi. Mengesakan Allah sebagai Al-Ilaah bermakna menyucikan segala niat, cinta, dan ketakutan hanya untuk keredaan-Nya.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 51, 62; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 25-30; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 2, p. 280 / page_id 785).
al_jalil_commentary: Focuses on the psychology of worship—realizing that the human heart has an innate need (fitrah) to love, revere, and deify a supreme being, and this need can only be fully satisfied by Al-Ilaah.
dhikr_usage_en: Say La ilaha illa Allah continuously as a direct affirmation of the name Al-Ilaah, purifying the soul from minor associations.
dhikr_usage_ms: Ucapkan La ilaha illa Allah secara berterusan sebagai pengesahan langsung terhadap nama Al-Ilaah, menyucikan jiwa daripada syirik kecil.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Baqarah 2:163 ('And your Ilah is one Ilah'), al-Biqa'i notes that 'Ilah' is repeated to affirm that absolute oneness (Wahdaniyyah) belongs to the True Deity—He cannot be divided in essence, kind, or attributes.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 2, p. 280 / page_id 785)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَإِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۖ لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And your god is one God. There is no deity [worthy of worship] except Him, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Awal, yang tiada permulaan bagi kewujudan-Nya
proof_text: هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
aqeedah_belief: Belief that Allah existed before anything else did. He is the Uncreated Creator, the first cause of all existence. His existence is eternal and uninitiated, having absolutely no beginning in time or space.
salah_usage: Reflect during the early morning prayer (Fajr) on how Allah initiated your life and this day out of His sheer grace.
dua_usage: Supplicate using Ya Al-Awwal to bless your beginnings, launch successful endeavors, and keep you steadfast from day one.
dhikr_usage: Say Ya Al-Awwal to find comfort that Allah was there before any of your troubles or difficulties ever began.
when_to_invoke: At the beginning of any major project, when starting a new day, or when reflecting on the origin of creation and destiny.
ghazali_insight: When you ponder the order of existence and consider the ordered chain of beings, God the most high is first with respect to it, since all of them receive their existence from Him, and He does not receive existence from another but is existent by His essence. He is the first beginning and initiator of all.
description_en: Al-Awwal signifies that Allah stands before time itself. He is not bound by the chronological order of the universe, as He created time. Understanding Al-Awwal liberates the mind from the paradox of infinite regress, establishing that all of creation flows from a singular, eternal, and uncaused Originator.
description_ms: Al-Awwal bermaksud Allah Yang Maha Awal tanpa ada permulaan bagi kewujudan-Nya. Sifat ini menegaskan bahawa Dia mendahului segala makhluk dan masa, kerana Dialah Pencipta masa itu sendiri. Menyedari nama Al-Awwal melatih seorang hamba untuk sentiasa mendahulukan keredaan Allah, memulakan setiap urusan dengan nama-Nya, dan meyakini bahawa segalanya bermula daripada kudrat-Nya.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 133-134; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 210-215; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 256 / page_id 9933).
al_jalil_commentary: Teaches the believer to prioritize Allah in all aspects of life (putting His commands first, starting with His name, and seeking His pleasure before all else).
dhikr_usage_en: Say Ya Al-Awwal to find comfort that Allah was there before any of your troubles or difficulties ever began.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Awwal untuk mencari ketenangan bahawa Allah telah wujud sebelum bermulanya sebarang kesulitan atau dugaan hidup anda.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Hadid 57:3, al-Biqa'i explains why 'Al-Awwal, Al-Aakhir, Adh-Dhaahir, Al-Baatin' are joined with 'and': without 'and', apparent opposites might seem to limit each other, so 'and' proves each Name is absolute—Al-Awwal is First without beginning.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 256 / page_id 9933)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْءَاخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Akhir, yang kekal abadi tanpa ada kesudahan bagi kewujudan-Nya
proof_text: هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
aqeedah_belief: Belief that Allah will exist for all eternity after all creation perishes. He is infinite and everlasting, having no end, no death, and no disappearance. He remains when everything else fades away.
salah_usage: Reflect during the closing Tashahhud on the transient nature of this world and the eternal nature of the afterlife with Allah.
dua_usage: Call upon Ya Al-Aakhir to grant a good end to your life (Husn al-Khatimah) and bless the outcomes of your deeds.
dhikr_usage: Say Ya Al-Aakhir to anchor your hopes in the eternal Divine, rather than the temporary and fleeting pleasures of this world.
when_to_invoke: When dealing with anxiety about the future, when experiencing the death of loved ones, or at the end of a project or life stage.
ghazali_insight: Whenever you ponder the order of wayfaring and observe the stages attained by those journeying towards Him, He is the last, for He is the final point to which the levels of 'knowers' ascend. The highest stage is knowledge of God. So He is last with respect to wayfaring.
description_en: Al-Aakhir represents the ultimate finality of all things returning to their Creator. In a world where everything decays and disappears, Al-Aakhir is the permanent anchor. He is the ultimate destination of the spiritual journey, the ultimate judge of all affairs, and the Only One who remains when the universe is folded up.
description_ms: Al-Aakhir bererti Allah Yang Maha Akhir, yang kekal abadi tanpa ada kesudahan bagi kewujudan-Nya. Tatkala seluruh alam ini hancur dan binasa, Dialah yang tetap kekal. Memahami nama Al-Aakhir mendidik jiwa mukmin untuk tidak bergantung kepada kebendaan dunia yang sementara, sebaliknya sentiasa bersiap sedia dengan amalan soleh untuk menghadapi hari pertemuan abadi dengan-Nya.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 133-134; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 216-220; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 256 / page_id 9933).
al_jalil_commentary: Encourages preparing for the ultimate return to Allah, cultivating sincere actions that will endure in the afterlife rather than transient worldly fame.
dhikr_usage_en: Say Ya Al-Aakhir to anchor your hopes in the eternal Divine, rather than the temporary and fleeting pleasures of this world.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Aakhir untuk menyandarkan harapan anda kepada Tuhan Yang Kekal Abadi, bukan pada kenikmatan dunia yang sementara dan fana.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Joined to Al-Awwal with 'and' in Al-Hadid 57:3, al-Biqa'i notes that Al-Aakhir affirms Allah is the Last without end, remaining eternally across all past and future times.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 256 / page_id 9933)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْءَاخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Zahir, yang ketinggian dan tanda-tanda kewujudan-Nya sangat nyata di atas segala sesuatu
proof_text: هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
aqeedah_belief: Belief that Allah is supreme, uppermost, and dominant over all. Nothing is above Him. His existence is clearly manifest through His magnificent signs in the universe, and He towers over His creation in power, status, and Essence.
salah_usage: Reflect on the vastness of the heavens and earth during standing (Qiyam), seeing them as signs of His manifest dominance.
dua_usage: Pray to Ya Adh-Dhaahir to make the truth clear and manifest, and to grant victory and dominance over falsehood.
dhikr_usage: Recite Ya Adh-Dhaahir to witness His power in every atom of the cosmos and remove doubt from your heart.
when_to_invoke: When seeking clarity and truth, when defending against false accusations, or when feeling defeated by worldly powers.
ghazali_insight: God is hidden when He is sought by sensory perception or using the resources of imagination, yet manifest when sought by way of inference using the resources of reason. He is hidden in His manifestations by the intense way in which He is manifest, as His very light acts as His veil.
description_en: Adh-Dhaahir denotes the One who is supreme and dominant, above whom there is absolutely nothing. Yet He is also the Manifest, whose existence, majesty, and wisdom are clearly visible in the incredible design of the cosmos. He is hidden from physical sight, but His presence is the most obvious reality to any intellect.
description_ms: Adh-Dhaahir bermaksud Allah Yang Maha Nyata, yang tanda-tanda kebesaran dan kewujudan-Nya sangat jelas terpampang di seluruh alam semesta. Nama ini juga bermakna Dia Maha Tinggi mengatasi segala kekuatan makhluk, tanpa ada sebarang kuasa yang mampu mengatasi-Nya. Memahami sifat ini menguatkan tauhid dan membebaskan mukmin daripada sebarang rasa gentar terhadap kekuasaan batil di dunia.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 134-137; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 221-225; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, pp. 256-257 / page_id 9933).
al_jalil_commentary: Teaches the believer to act with transparency and integrity, aligning their outward behavior with their inward faith, knowing that Allah's dominance is manifest over all.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Adh-Dhaahir to witness His power in every atom of the cosmos and remove doubt from your heart.
dhikr_usage_ms: Bacalah Ya Adh-Dhaahir untuk menyaksikan kekuasaan-Nya dalam setiap zarah di alam semesta dan menyingkirkan keraguan daripada hati.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Hadid 57:3, al-Biqa'i explains that Adh-Dhaahir means nothing is above Allah in dominance and evidence—even in His hiddenness from human senses, He is completely manifest through His signs and power.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, pp. 256-257 / page_id 9933)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْءَاخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Tersembunyi, yang amat dekat dan mengetahui segala rahsia yang paling dalam
proof_text: هُوَ الْأَوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
aqeedah_belief: Belief that Allah is the closest to everything, knowing the innermost secrets, thoughts, and intentions of all hearts. He cannot be perceived by the physical senses in this world, yet nothing is hidden from Him.
salah_usage: Guard your thoughts and focus during prayer, knowing that Al-Baatin is fully watching the movements of your heart, not just your limbs.
dua_usage: Supplicate Ya Al-Baatin to purify your secrets, forgive your hidden sins, and align your inner thoughts with His guidance.
dhikr_usage: Say Ya Al-Baatin to cultivate self-monitoring (Muraqabah) and clean the inner state from pride and envy.
when_to_invoke: When purifying one's heart from bad intentions, when dealing with private struggles, or when needing comfort that Allah knows your silent pain.
ghazali_insight: Allah is hidden (Batin) when sought by sensory perception or imagination, for He is too exalted to be attained by senses. Yet He is closer to the soul than its own self. Man's share is to cultivate beautiful inner qualities that are hidden from public eyes.
description_en: Al-Baatin represents the intimate closeness of Allah. He is the Knower of all secrets, closer to us than our jugular vein, yet He remains completely imperceptible to our physical eyes in this world. Understanding Al-Baatin forces the believer to realize that their private life, their secret thoughts, and their unspoken fears are completely laid bare before their Lord.
description_ms: Al-Baatin bererti Allah Yang Maha Tersembunyi, yang tidak dapat dijangkau oleh panca indera fizikal manusia di dunia ini, namun sangat dekat dengan hamba-Nya. Dialah yang mengetahui segala bisikan hati, rahsia tersembunyi, dan niat yang paling dalam. Nama agung ini melatih seorang muslim untuk sentiasa menjaga keikhlasan hati dan menjauhi maksiat lisan mahupun rahsia.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 134-137; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 226-230; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, pp. 256-257 / page_id 9934).
al_jalil_commentary: Emphasizes purifying the inner dimensions of the heart (Al-Sarayir) because Allah looks at the heart and the intention, not just the outward appearance and actions.
dhikr_usage_en: Say Ya Al-Baatin to cultivate self-monitoring (Muraqabah) and clean the inner state from pride and envy.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Baatin untuk memupuk kesedaran pengawasan diri (Muraqabah) serta membersihkan batin daripada kesombongan dan hasad dengki.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Hadid 57:3, al-Biqa'i notes that Al-Baatin means nothing is beneath or hidden from Allah's knowledge and power—His essence is veiled from finite grasp, while all hidden things of creation lie open before Him.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, pp. 256-257 / page_id 9934)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْءَاخِرُ وَٱلظَّٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Merancang dan Mewujudkan ciptaan daripada tiada kepada ada dengan keserasian yang sempurna
proof_text: هُوَ اللَّهُ الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِئُ الْمُصَوِّرُ ۖ لَهُ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَىٰ
aqeedah_belief: Belief that Allah brings creation from non-existence into actual existence in perfect alignment with His pre-decreed plans. He originates the creation with flawless compatibility and harmony, free from any defects or disproportion.
salah_usage: Thank Allah during Sujud for creating your body in perfect proportion and harmony, reflecting on the beauty of His design.
dua_usage: Pray to Ya Al-Baari' to heal your body, restore balance and harmony in your affairs, and free your life from distress.
dhikr_usage: Chant Ya Al-Baari' to marvel at the seamless order of nature and align your own actions with divine harmony.
when_to_invoke: When seeking healing from physical illnesses, when experiencing disruption in your life's harmony, or when initiating a creative or builder's task.
ghazali_insight: Al-Khaliq is the planner, Al-Bari' is the producer who brings things into existence according to the plan, and Al-Musawwir is the fashioner. Everything which comes forth from nothing to existence needs first of all to be planned; secondly, to be originated according to the plan; and thirdly, to be formed after being originated.
description_en: Al-Baari' is the One who executes the creation of things from absolute nothingness, ensuring that each part is perfectly matched and proportioned to its environment and purpose. He is the divine builder who transforms abstract plans into a concrete, living, and harmoniously functioning reality.
description_ms: Al-Baari' merujuk kepada Allah Yang Maha Mewujudkan ciptaan daripada tiada kepada ada dengan penuh keseimbangan dan keharmonian. Berbeza dengan Al-Khaliq (Yang Merancang), Al-Baari' adalah yang melunaskan perancangan tersebut menjadi realiti fizikal yang serasi dan sempurna tanpa sebarang kecacatan. Memahami nama ini melahirkan rasa syukur yang mendalam atas kejadian fizikal diri kita dan keindahan alam sekitar.
source_reference: Al-Ghazali, Al-Maqsad al-Asna, p. 68-72; Abdul Aziz Al-Jalil, ولله الأسماء الحسنى فادعوه بها, p. 70-75; Shaykh Uthaymeen, Al-Qawaa'id al-Muthlaa; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 477 / page_id 10184).
al_jalil_commentary: Teaches the believer to accept and love their physical form and appearance, knowing that Al-Baari' is the One who originated them in the absolute best and most suited shape.
dhikr_usage_en: Chant Ya Al-Baari' to marvel at the seamless order of nature and align your own actions with divine harmony.
dhikr_usage_ms: Ucapkan Ya Al-Baari' untuk mengagumi keteraturan alam ciptaan-Nya dan menyelaraskan setiap tindakan dengan keharmonian Ilahi.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Hashr 59:24, al-Biqa'i explains why 'Al-Baari'' (The Maker) follows 'Al-Khaliq': Allah does not merely plan creation, He brings it into concrete existence and refines it to receive its exact form.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 477 / page_id 10184)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُ ٱلْبَارِئُ ٱلْمُصَوِّرُ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

proof_text: Truly, He is The Source of Goodness, The Compassionate.
aqeedah_belief: Allah showers His apparent and hidden blessings upon His slaves. All His creation totally depends on Him at all times and cannot do without His absolute kindness. He multiplies the rewards of the righteous among the Muslims and forgives the wrongdoers among them, and His promise is true.
salah_usage: Let this Name soften the heart before takbir so your salah flows with compassion.
dua_usage: Call upon Al-Barr when pleading for forgiveness for yourself, family, and the ummah.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Barr dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.
when_to_invoke: Reach for this Name whenever you seek Allah's rahmah after shortcomings.
ghazali_insight: The absolute doer of good is the one from whom every good deed and beneficence comes. Man can be a doer of good only in the measure that he keeps himself occupied with doing good, especially towards his parents, teachers, and elders. As told of Moses, one attains exalted positions by refraining from envy and doing good to one's parents.
description_en: Al-Barr reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Barr mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.103; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 20 / page_id 9656).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the source of all righteousness, kindness, and goodness, whose grace encompasses all of creation. For the believer, this name inspires profound love and gratitude, and encourages them to seek righteousness, knowing that Allah is kind to His servants and true to His promises.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Barr in your morning and evening remembrance while giving thanks for countless blessings.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Barr dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In At-Tur 52:28, al-Biqa'i explains that 'Al-Barr' (The Benign) highlights Allah's vast generosity, where both His giving and His withholding are acts of mercy tailored for the believer's ultimate good.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 20 / page_id 9656)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."

proof_text: Surely, He is aware of and sees His servants.
aqeedah_belief: He is the One whose sight encompasses everything that is conceivable, hidden or apparent, no matter how hidden or small it may be.
salah_usage: Ask for hikmah after reciting Al-Fatihah so knowledge leads to action.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Basir when seeking guidance for decisions beyond your limited sight.
dhikr_usage: Zikir Ya Al-Basir ketika menuntut ilmu agar pemahaman disulami tawaduk.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you ask Allah to open understanding beyond data.
ghazali_insight: Al-Basir is the one who witnesses and sees everything, no matter how remote, even what is under the earth, without dependence on physical eyes. A servant's share in this name is to realize that God sees them and to use their own sight to gaze upon the signs and wonders of God's kingdom as an admonition, not underestimating His surveillance.
description_en: Al-Basir reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Basir mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.119; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 17, p. 309 / page_id 8864).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil states that unwavering belief that nothing is hidden from Allah's sight brings tranquility, patience, and acceptance to the believer when afflicted with harm from Allah's enemies. The believer is assured that Allah sees their plight and that what occurs is by His wisdom, which ultimately contains mercy and gentleness for them.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Basir when seeking knowledge so that understanding is guided by humility.
dhikr_usage_ms: Zikir Ya Al-Basir ketika menuntut ilmu agar pemahaman disulami tawaduk.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Paired with Al-Khabeer in Ash-Shura 42:27, al-Biqa'i notes that 'Al-Baseer' shows Allah sees both outward deeds and inward states, so He measures out provision in exact proportion to what keeps His servants upright.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 17, p. 309 / page_id 8864)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: ۞ وَلَوْ بَسَطَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ لَبَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَٰكِن يُنَزِّلُ بِقَدَرٍۢ مَّا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And if Allah had extended [excessively] provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends [it] down in an amount which He wills. Indeed He is, of His servants, Acquainted and Seeing.

english_meaning: The One Who guides His servants to repent and accepts their repentance
proof_text: Allah is Ever-Returning, Most Merciful.
aqeedah_belief: He is the One who helps His slaves repent and submit completely to Him after turning to Him, and then He accepts their repentance and pardons their sins.
salah_usage: Lengthen sujud for istighfar whenever you recall a slip.
dua_usage: Invoke Ya At-Tawwab when seeking cleansing from sins, big or small.
dhikr_usage: Basahkan lidah dengan Ya At-Tawwab sebelum tidur supaya hati dilapangkan.
when_to_invoke: Use it whenever you return to Allah seeking pardon.
ghazali_insight: Al-Tawwab, the Ever-Relenting, refers to God facilitating the causes of repentance in His servants time and again. He manifests His signs and conveys His counsel to the point where they experience fear and have recourse to repentance. Man's share in this quality is to accept time and again the excuses of those who do wrong among those entrusted to his care.
description_en: At-Tawwab reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: At-Tawwab mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.111; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 18, p. 381 / page_id 9512).
al_jalil_commentary: Belief in At-Tawwaab (The Accepter of Repentance) fosters love for Allah, who not only accepts repentance but guides His servant to it. It cultivates modesty (Haya') before a Lord who rejoices at His servant's return, which in turn motivates obedience and leaving sin.
dhikr_usage_en: Moisten your tongue with Ya At-Tawwab before sleep so that your heart finds relief and ease.
dhikr_usage_ms: Basahkan lidah dengan Ya At-Tawwab sebelum tidur supaya hati dilapangkan.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Closing Al-Hujurat 49:12 after forbidding suspicion, spying, and backbiting, al-Biqa'i explains why 'At-Tawwaab' is used: Allah repeatedly turns back in mercy even if a servant slips again, so no one should despair of repenting.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 18, p. 381 / page_id 9512)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثْمٌۭ ۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا۟ وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا ۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًۭا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is Accepting of repentance and Merciful.

proof_text: …The Almighty, the Compeller, the Supremely Great…
aqeedah_belief: He is the Most High, the Irresistible and the Sublime. Whatever He decrees will certainly come to pass without fail. He heals the broken-hearted and binds up their wounds, and brings comfort to the weak and to those who turn to Him and seek His refuge.
salah_usage: Lengthen qiyam and feel supported by the One who can never be overcome.
dua_usage: Invoke Ya Al-Jabbar when asking for courage to defend the truth.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Jabbar pada awal pagi supaya ketegasan bersandar kepada kudrat Allah.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it during you require strength to stand upon the truth.
ghazali_insight: The absolute compeller is God, for He compels each thing and nothing compels Him, and He has no competitor on either score. He is the one from whose grasp nothing escapes, yet the hands of men do not reach to the sanctuary of His presence. The compeller among men is one who is too high to be a follower, distinguished by his rank so his manner compels creatures to emulate him.
description_en: Al-Jabbar mends the broken, enforces justice, and His will prevails with mercy even when we resist.
description_ms: Al-Jabbar menyembuh yang patah, menegakkan keadilan, dan kehendak-Nya terlaksana dengan rahmah walau kita menentang.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.67; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 474 / page_id 10181).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the One who mends the broken, enriches the poor, and is the Compeller whose will is irresistible, as well as being the Most High. This name inspires humility and fear before God's might, while also fostering hope in Him as the one who can mend the heart's brokenness and provide for the needy.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Jabbar in the early morning so that firmness of purpose rests upon the power of Allah.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Jabbar pada awal pagi supaya ketegasan bersandar kepada kudrat Allah.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Hashr 59:23, al-Biqa'i contrasts 'Al-Jabbaar' with 'Al-Mutakabbir': Al-Mutakabbir governs outward majesty and humbles tyrants, while Al-Jabbaar holds absolute sway over inward realities, governing both outward and inward through gentleness and might.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 474 / page_id 10181)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَٰمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْجَبَّارُ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.

proof_text: Allah is the Best Guardian.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Haafidh commits one to affirming that Allah alone holds the heavens, the earth, and the cosmos in existence so they do not cease or slip away, as Al-Jalil explains regarding Quran 2:255, Quran 21:32, Quran 35:41, and Quran 15:17, and that He preserves the revealed Reminder (Quran 15:9). It entails believing that Allah enumerates every small and great deed of His servants without anything escaping His knowledge, as Al-Jalil explains regarding Quran 82:10, and that He preserves life through the sustenance He provides, as noted by Al-Zajjaj and Abu Ubaydah. Finally, it commits one to the belief that true protection belongs exclusively to Allah, such that whomever Allah protects is safeguarded and whomever He leaves without His protection is ruined, since weak creatures cannot protect even themselves.
dua_usage: Protect Allah's limits (commandments), and He will protect you.
when_to_invoke: One reaches for Al-Haafidh in reliance and self-watchfulness when seeking protection from deadly perils, evil ends, and Satan's plotting by detaching the heart from weak creatures, and when guarding one's deeds against nullifiers such as showing off (riya') knowing that Al-Haafidh enumerates every action.
ghazali_insight: Al-Hafiz is the perfect preserver who perpetuates the existence of things and safeguards opposing elements (like heat and cold in a body) from destroying each other. Man's share in this name is to preserve his own limbs and heart from the assault of anger and the enticement of desire.
description_en: Al-Haafidh—occurring in the Qur'an once in the singular (Quran 12:64) and twice in the plural (Quran 15:9; Quran 21:82)—means the Protector who continuously guards without forgetting, heedlessness, or ever being absent from what He preserves, as explained by Ibn Sidah, Al-Jawhari, and Al-Zajjaji. Al-Khattabi explains that as Al-Haafidh, Allah holds the heavens and the earth in existence so they do not perish (Quran 2:255; Quran 37:7), protects His servants from deadly perils and evil ends through guardian angels acting by His command (Quran 13:11), and safeguards His close allies from falling into sin and Satan's plotting.
description_ms: Al-Haafidh disebut dalam al-Quran sekali dalam bentuk tunggal (Quran 12:64) dan dua kali dalam bentuk jamak (Quran 15:9; Quran 21:82). Ibn Sidah, Al-Jawhari, dan Al-Zajjaji menjelaskan bahawa nama ini bermaksud Yang Maha Memelihara yang menjaga tanpa lupa, lalai, atau berpisah daripada jagaan-Nya. Menurut Al-Khattabi, Allah menahan langit dan bumi daripada musnah (Quran 2:255; Quran 37:7), melindungi hamba-Nya daripada kebinasaan melalui malaikat penjaga dengan perintah-Nya (Quran 13:11), serta memelihara para wali-Nya daripada dosa dan tipu daya syaitan.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.77; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 10, p. 153 / page_id 4670).
al_jalil_commentary: Shaykh al-Jalil explains that Al-Haafidh is the One who protects His servants from worldly perils and destructive evils. He perfectly records all deeds, words, and hidden intentions of His creation without anything escaping His knowledge. Furthermore, He grants special protection to His righteous allies by shielding them from sin and guarding them against the deceitful plots of Shaytan.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Yusuf 12:64, Ya'qub (AS) says 'Allah is the best Guardian (Haafidh)': al-Biqa'i notes that Allah's encompassing knowledge and power completely surpass every human safeguard.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 10, p. 153 / page_id 4670)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: قَالَ هَلْ ءَامَنُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا كَمَآ أَمِنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَخِيهِ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ فَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ حَٰفِظًۭا ۖ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: He said, "Should I entrust you with him except [under coercion] as I entrusted you with his brother before? But Allah is the best guardian, and He is the most merciful of the merciful."

proof_text: Allah is sufficient as a Reckoner.
aqeedah_belief: Allah is sufficient for those who rely on Him, is aware of His slaves and will take account of their actions and reward them or punish them accordingly in His immense wisdom and absolute knowledge. He is sufficient for the believers.
salah_usage: Mention this Name when asking Allah to keep you fair in every responsibility.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Hasib when resolving disputes so you uphold the rights of others.
dhikr_usage: Ulang Ya Al-Hasib sebelum membuat keputusan besar agar keputusan menepati keadilan.
when_to_invoke: Lean on it whenever you decide matters that affect others' rights.
ghazali_insight: Al-Haseeb is the one who suffices, for He is all that one needs. God alone is sufficient for everything, creating and providing all that is required for existence and permanence. The religious fruit for man is to know that God alone suffices for him, so he should want only God.
description_en: Al-Hasib reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Hasib mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.131; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 5, p. 199 / page_id 2050).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil explains Al-Haseeb has two meanings: The Sufficient and The Reckoner. As The Reckoner, belief in this name instills in the believer's heart fear and awe of Allah. This motivates self-accountability and preparation for the Day of Judgment by performing acts of obedience and avoiding prohibitions and the violation of people's rights.
dhikr_usage_en: Repeat Ya Al-Hasib before making major decisions so that your choices align with justice.
dhikr_usage_ms: Ulang Ya Al-Hasib sebelum membuat keputusan besar agar keputusan menepati keadilan.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In An-Nisa 4:6 regarding orphans' wealth, al-Biqa'i notes that 'Al-Haseeb' (The Reckoner) serves as a stern warning to guardians that Allah's wisdom and power hold every cent to exact account.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 5, p. 199 / page_id 2050)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَٱبْتَلُوا۟ ٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغُوا۟ ٱلنِّكَاحَ فَإِنْ ءَانَسْتُم مِّنْهُمْ رُشْدًۭا فَٱدْفَعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تَأْكُلُوهَآ إِسْرَافًۭا وَبِدَارًا أَن يَكْبَرُوا۟ ۚ وَمَن كَانَ غَنِيًّۭا فَلْيَسْتَعْفِفْ ۖ وَمَن كَانَ فَقِيرًۭا فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ ۚ فَإِذَا دَفَعْتُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ فَأَشْهِدُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ حَسِيبًۭا
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And test the orphans [in their abilities] until they reach marriageable age. Then if you perceive in them sound judgement, release their property to them. And do not consume it excessively and quickly, [anticipating] that they will grow up. And whoever, [when acting as guardian], is self-sufficient should refrain [from taking a fee]; and whoever is poor - let him take according to what is acceptable. Then when you release their property to them, bring witnesses upon them. And sufficient is Allah as Accountant.

proof_text: My Lord is guardian over all things.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Hafeedh commits one to affirming, as Ibn al-Qayyim states in his Nuniyyah, that Allah is Al-Hafeedh over creation and the Guarantor (Al-Kafeel) of their protection from every distressing matter. It entails believing the two truths detailed by As-Sa'di: first, that Allah's knowledge encompasses every servant's outward and inward states, the perfection or deficiency of their deeds, and the exact measures of their reward and punishment written in the Preserved Tablet; and second, that His guardianship spans both general sustenance for the righteous, the wicked, and animals alike (Quran 20:50) and special defense for believers against doubts, desires, and the plots of jinn and human enemies (Quran 22:38). It also commits one to believing, as As-Sa'di and Al-Jalil explain regarding Musnad Ahmad 1/263 (graded sahih by Ahmad Shakir), Musnad Ahmad 1/293, Jami at-Tirmidhi 2440 (graded sahih by Al-Albani), and Quran 50:32, that when a servant guards Allah's commands, prohibitions, and limits, Allah guards him in his person, religion, wealth, and children.
dua_usage: Know that He preserves your deeds and sustains the heavens and earth.
when_to_invoke: One reaches for Al-Hafeedh when confronting doubts, trials, desires, or the plots of jinn and human enemies that threaten one's faith, and when in solitude weighing one's physical movements, words, and inward thoughts (khawatir) by the scale of the Shari'ah out of shyness (haya') and watchfulness (muraqabah) before Allah, as explained by As-Sa'di and Ibn al-Qayyim.
ghazali_insight: Imam al-Ghazali explains that the servant's share in the name Al-Hafeedh involves safeguarding their own limbs and heart. Such a person protects their religion from the overpowering force of anger, the deception of desires, and the illusions of Satan. Through this vigilance, the servant avoids spiritual ruin.
description_en: Al-Hafeedh—occurring three times in the Qur'an (Quran 11:57; Quran 34:21; Quran 42:6) on the intensive fa'eel pattern—is explained by As-Sa'di as encompassing two meanings: preserving all outward and inward deeds of His servants in the Preserved Tablet (Al-Lawh Al-Mahfudh) and the scrolls of the noble recording angels, and guarding His servants from all that they dislike. As-Sa'di further explains that this guardianship includes both a general preservation of all creatures' physical structures and necessities (Quran 20:50) and a special guardianship for His close allies that defends their faith and certainty against doubts, trials, desires, and enemies from jinn and mankind (Quran 22:38).
description_ms: Al-Hafeedh disebut tiga kali dalam al-Quran (Quran 11:57; Quran 34:21; Quran 42:6) atas wazan fa'eel. As-Sa'di menjelaskan bahawa nama ini merangkumi dua makna: mencatatkan segala amalan zahir dan batin hamba di Luh Mahfuz serta dalam lembaran malaikat pencatat, dan menjaga hamba-Nya daripada perkara yang dibenci. Menurut As-Sa'di lagi, penjagaan ini terbahagi kepada penjagaan umum bagi keperluan semua makhluk (Quran 20:50) dan penjagaan khusus bagi para wali-Nya untuk mempertahankan iman mereka daripada syubhat, fitnah, syahwat, serta musuh daripada kalangan jin dan manusia (Quran 22:38).
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.77; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 9, p. 313 / page_id 4391).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the Preserver, who both records all the deeds of His servants and protects them from harm. Belief in this name inspires mindfulness (muraqabah) that all actions are recorded, as well as sincere reliance (tawakkul) on Him for protection from all evil, which is attained by 'preserving' His commands.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Hud 11:57, al-Biqa'i explains why 'my Lord is Hafeedh over all things' closes the warning to those who turn away: Allah's perfect knowledge, power, and preservation mean He can replace wrongdoers without suffering any harm.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 9, p. 313 / page_id 4391)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُم مَّآ أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ رَبِّى قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّونَهُۥ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَفِيظٌۭ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: But if they turn away, [say], "I have already conveyed that with which I was sent to you. My Lord will give succession to a people other than you, and you will not harm Him at all. Indeed my Lord is, over all things, Guardian."

proof_text: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me."
aqeedah_belief: Seek His specific kindness in your affairs.
dua_usage: Seek His specific kindness in your affairs.
when_to_invoke: Seek His specific kindness in your affairs.
description_en: The Benevolent
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 12, p. 208 / page_id 5854).

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Maryam 19:47, Ibrahim (AS) calls Allah 'Hafiyy' ('ever gracious to me'): al-Biqa'i notes this expresses Allah's continuous, tender generosity toward him, grounding his hope that his prayer for his father will be answered.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 12, p. 208 / page_id 5854)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّۭا
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.

proof_text: Exalted be Allah, the True King.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Haqq commits you to affirming that Allah alone possesses self-necessary, eternal existence while all creation perishes, and that He is the only true Lord and deity whereas everything worshipped besides Him is false, as Ibn Jarir at-Tabari and As-Sa'di explain from Quran 10:30 and Quran 22:62. As Ibn al-Qayyim explains regarding Quran 23:115 and Quran 23:116, affirming that Allah is the True King (Al-Malik Al-Haqq) requires believing that He did not create humanity in vain or leave them neglected without commands, prohibitions, messengers, and resurrection for reward and punishment. It further requires unwavering certainty in all unseen realities He has foretold and complete submission to His legislative rulings and painful decrees as pure truth, justice, and wisdom free of oppression or futility.
salah_usage: Open the night prayer (qiyam al-layl) with the prophetic supplication in Sahih al-Bukhari 1120 that praises Allah as Al-Haqq, while standing before Him in prayer with the reverent fear and readiness for His meeting that Al-Jalil explains must fill a heart certain of His true promise and reckoning.
dua_usage: Call upon Allah as Al-Haqq in the prophetic supplication for opening the night prayer in Sahih al-Bukhari 1120—which, as Al-Khattabi, As-Sa'di, and Al-Jalil explain, confesses that Allah and His word, meeting, Paradise, Hellfire, prophets, and the Hour are all established realities—and ask Him, as Al-Jalil states, to keep you steadfast upon the truth until you meet Him.
dhikr_usage: Zikir Ya Al-Haqq ketika menulis atau bercakap agar lidah menepati kebenaran.
when_to_invoke: Reach for Al-Haqq when rising to open the night prayer (Sahih al-Bukhari 1120), when painful calamities tempt the heart toward doubt or resentment against Allah's decree, or when you must rely on Him while standing for the truth as falsehood temporarily swells like foam, as Al-Jalil and Ibn al-Qayyim explain from Quran 13:17 and Quran 27:79.
ghazali_insight: Al-Haqq, the Truth, is the one who is the antithesis of falsehood. The absolutely true is the One truly existing in itself, from which every true thing gets its true reality. Therefore, the existent most deserving of being called true is God, and the knowledge most deserving of being called true is the knowledge of God.
description_en: Al-Haqq means the True One whose existence, essence, attributes, and divinity are necessarily established and completely free of falsehood, as Al-Khattabi, Ibn al-Athir, and As-Sa'di explain. Because He is Al-Haqq in Himself, everything originating from Him—His speech, decrees, revealed religion, promises, and the Day of Judgment—is true and certain to occur, leaving only misguidance outside His truth as As-Sa'di notes regarding Quran 10:32.
description_ms: Al-Haqq bermaksud Tuhan Yang Maha Benar yang kewujudan, zat, sifat, dan ketuhanan-Nya pasti sabit serta bebas sama sekali daripada kebatilan, sebagaimana dijelaskan oleh Al-Khattabi, Ibn al-Athir, dan As-Sa'di. Oleh sebab Dia ialah Al-Haqq pada zat-Nya, segala yang datang daripada-Nya termasuk firman, ketetapan, agama, janji, dan Hari Pembalasan adalah benar dan pasti berlaku, manakala apa yang di luar kebenaran-Nya hanyalah kesesatan seperti yang dinyatakan oleh As-Sa'di tentang Quran 10:32.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.31; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 13, p. 196 / page_id 6442).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Haqq is the True One, whose existence is absolute reality and from whom all truth proceeds. Acknowledging this compels the believer to humbly submit to the truth whenever it becomes clear, recognizing that all good lies in following it. Rejecting the truth after it has been clarified is the essence of arrogance and leads only to error and misery.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Haqq when writing or speaking so that your words adhere strictly to truth.
dhikr_usage_ms: Zikir Ya Al-Haqq ketika menulis atau bercakap agar lidah menepati kebenaran.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Al-Biqa'i explains why 'Al-Malik Al-Haqq' (23:116) immediately follows 'Did you think We created you in vain?' (23:115): Allah is the True Sovereign whose creation and accountability are real and purposeful, refuting any illusion that life has no return to Him.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 13, p. 196 / page_id 6442)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.

proof_text: …And they will realise that Allah is the [very] Truth, that makes all things manifest.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Mubeen commits you to affirming that Allah has established clear proofs of His oneness and perfection both within innate human dispositions and intellects and through revealed books and messengers, yet out of His mercy He does not punish anyone until messengers have been sent to explain the truth, as Al-Jalil explains from Quran 17:15 and Quran 4:165. It also requires believing that the Quran is the miraculously eloquent, spoken word of Allah Al-Mubeen—originating from Him and returning to Him—which provides a comprehensive explanation of creed, worship, conduct, and the Hereafter, as Salih al-Bulayhi explains regarding Quran 6:38 and Quran 17:12. Finally, as Ibn Ashur explains from Quran 24:23 and Quran 24:25, it commits you to believing that on the Day of Judgment Allah will expose the falsehood of hypocrites and slanderers with undeniable certainty.
dua_usage: Seek clarity in your religion and be clear and honest in your dealings.
when_to_invoke: Seek clarity in your religion and be clear and honest in your dealings.
description_en: As Al-Jalil, Al-Khattabi, and Az-Zajjaji explain, Al-Mubeen unites two meanings: Allah is the Manifest One whose existence and oneness without partner are evident through proofs in human nature, intellect, and revelation, and He is the Clarifier who makes the path of guidance and the deeds earning reward or punishment clear to His servants by word and deed. On the Day of Resurrection, as Ibn Jarir at-Tabari explains regarding Quran 24:25, He will manifest the reality of His promised punishment so clearly that every doubt held by the hypocrites in this world will vanish.
description_ms: Sebagaimana dijelaskan oleh Al-Jalil, Al-Khattabi, dan Az-Zajjaji, Al-Mubeen merangkumi dua makna: Allah ialah Tuhan Yang Maha Nyata yang kewujudan serta keesaan-Nya tanpa sekutu jelas melalui bukti pada fitrah, akal, dan wahyu, serta Dia ialah Tuhan Yang Maha Menjelaskan yang menerangkan jalan petunjuk dan amalan yang membawa pahala atau azab kepada hamba-Nya melalui firman dan perbuatan. Pada Hari Kiamat, seperti yang diterangkan oleh Ibn Jarir at-Tabari mengenai Quran 24:25, Dia akan menzahirkan hakikat azab yang dijanjikan-Nya sehingga hilang segala keraguan golongan munafik.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.93; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 13, p. 242 / page_id 6495).
al_jalil_commentary: Citing commentators who view it as a Divine Name, the author explains that Al-Mubeen is the Manifest or Clear One. The effect of this is realized on the Day of Judgment, when people will know with undeniable certainty that Allah is the Manifest Truth. On that day, His promises of reward and punishment become clear and all doubt is removed.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In An-Nur 24:25, al-Biqa'i explains that Allah is 'Al-Mubeen' (The Manifest/Evident) because nothing is clearer than His divinity, knowledge, power, and absolute uniqueness in all attributes of perfection.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 13, p. 242 / page_id 6495)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يُوَفِّيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ دِينَهُمُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ ٱلْمُبِينُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: That Day, Allah will pay them in full their deserved recompense, and they will know that it is Allah who is the perfect in justice.

proof_text: And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
aqeedah_belief: Allah's name Al-Hakeem is paired with Al-'Aleem, showing His wisdom is perfectly combined with absolute knowledge. It also appears alongside Al-Khabeer and At-Tawwab to reflect His perfect decrees. These pairings emphasize that His actions and judgments are always executed with complete wisdom.
salah_usage: Ask for hikmah after reciting Al-Fatihah so knowledge leads to action.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Hakim when seeking guidance for decisions beyond your limited sight.
dhikr_usage: Zikir Ya Al-Hakim ketika menuntut ilmu agar pemahaman disulami tawaduk.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you ask Allah to open understanding beyond data.
ghazali_insight: Al-Hakim, the Wise, is the one who possesses wisdom, which is equivalent to knowledge of superior things through the highest modes of knowing. He is the truly wise because He knows the most sublime things by the eternal everlasting knowledge whose extinction is inconceivable. Man's wisdom is found when his knowledge and discourse concern universal matters and the world to come.
description_en: Al-Hakim reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Hakim mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.43; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 15, p. 155 / page_id 7444).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Hakeem is the All-Wise, whose creative and legislative acts are perfect in wisdom. This belief instills complete submission to His religious commands, without feeling the need to question the wisdom of every detail. It also brings contentment with His universal decrees, fostering trust that even painful events contain a hidden good ordained by His perfect knowledge.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Hakim when seeking knowledge so that understanding is guided by humility.
dhikr_usage_ms: Zikir Ya Al-Hakim ketika menuntut ilmu agar pemahaman disulami tawaduk.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Al-Biqa'i states that 'Al-Hakeem' (The All-Wise) fits Ibrahim 14:4 because Allah leaves astray or guides in accordance with His perfect wisdom, granting true wisdom to those who repent and worship Him.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 15, p. 155 / page_id 7444)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا بِلِسَانِ قَوْمِهِۦ لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمْ ۖ فَيُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And We did not send any messenger except [speaking] in the language of his people to state clearly for them, and Allah sends astray [thereby] whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

proof_text: Allah is Ever-Forgiving, All-Forbearing.
aqeedah_belief: Allah is so patient and forbearing that He does not punish His slaves for any sin they commit; rather, He gives them the opportunity to make amends and turn to Him in repentance. He forgives them, in His infinite mercy, even though He can punish them for the sins they commit.
salah_usage: Lengthen sujud for istighfar whenever you recall a slip.
dua_usage: Invoke Ya Al-Halim when seeking cleansing from sins, big or small.
dhikr_usage: Basahkan lidah dengan Ya Al-Halim sebelum tidur supaya hati dilapangkan.
when_to_invoke: Use it whenever you return to Allah seeking pardon.
ghazali_insight: Al-Haleem is the one who observes disobedience and opposition to His command, yet anger does not incite Him nor haste move Him to take vengeance, even though He is fully capable. Man's share in this attribute is evident, as mildness is one of the fine qualities of men.
description_en: Al-Halim reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Halim mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.105; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 5, p. 102 / page_id 1941).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil explains that Allah's forbearance (hilm) is not from weakness but from complete self-sufficiency and power. This quality leads Him to forgive His servants and accept their repentance. Recognizing His forbearance, especially when paired with His richness (Al-Ghaniyy) and greatness (Al-'Adheem), should inspire believers to learn from His forbearance and not be quick to anger or harm.
dhikr_usage_en: Moisten your tongue with Ya Al-Halim before sleep so that your heart finds relief and ease.
dhikr_usage_ms: Basahkan lidah dengan Ya Al-Halim sebelum tidur supaya hati dilapangkan.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Ali 'Imran 3:155, al-Biqa'i explains why 'Al-Haleem' (The Forbearing) closes the pardon of those who fled at Uhud: Allah does not hasten to punish out of wrath, sparing them harsh treatment despite their slip.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 5, p. 102 / page_id 1941)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا۟ مِنكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْتَقَى ٱلْجَمْعَانِ إِنَّمَا ٱسْتَزَلَّهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بِبَعْضِ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ ۖ وَلَقَدْ عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌۭ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Indeed, those of you who turned back on the day the two armies met, it was Satan who caused them to slip because of some [blame] they had earned. But Allah has already forgiven them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Forbearing.

english_meaning: The One Who is deservedly praised
proof_text: Surely, He is Praiseworthy, All-Glorious.
aqeedah_belief: He is worthy of all praise for all His actions, statements, attributes, names, legislation and decree. He is worthy of all praise under all circumstances, and He is worthy of all thanks and praise due to His perfect attributes and abundant kindness to His creation.
salah_usage: Perform sujud syukur whenever Allah completes a blessing for you.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Hamid while thanking Allah for favours and asking to use them well.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Alhamdulillah dan Ya Al-Hamid sambil menghitung nikmat satu persatu.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you give thanks for blessings entrusted to you.
ghazali_insight: Al-Hamid is the one who is praised and extolled, both by virtue of His own praise for Himself from eternity and by His servants' praise for Him forever. The one praised among men is he whose beliefs, character, and actions are all praised, but only God is praised absolutely.
description_en: Al-Hamid reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Hamid mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.51; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 9, p. 333 / page_id 4413).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Hameed is the Praiseworthy, who is deserving of all praise for His perfect names, attributes, and actions, which are all based on either grace or justice. The author explains that He is Mahmud (praised) in all situations, whether in ease or hardship, because He is Wise and His actions are free from error. This implies that the believer's duty is to praise Him in all circumstances, trusting in the wisdom behind His decrees.
dhikr_usage_en: Say Alhamdulillah and Ya Al-Hamid while reflecting upon blessings one by one.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Alhamdulillah dan Ya Al-Hamid sambil menghitung nikmat satu persatu.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Hud 11:73, after giving Sarah glad tidings in old age, al-Biqa'i notes why 'Hameed Majeed' closes the ayah: Allah's immense kindness and blessings prove He deserves all praise for His boundless generosity and glory.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 9, p. 333 / page_id 4413)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ رَحْمَتُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَٰتُهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَمِيدٌۭ مَّجِيدٌۭ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: They said, "Are you amazed at the decree of Allah? May the mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, people of the house. Indeed, He is Praiseworthy and Honorable."

proof_text: Allah, there is no god by He, the Ever Living, the All-Sustainer..
aqeedah_belief: He is the One who will remain and will never die. His Life is perfect in every sense, which requires all perfect attributes and negates all their opposites in every sense. This perfect attribute requires that neither sleep nor slumber overtake Him.
salah_usage: Remember this Name when reciting "Rabbi inni lima anzalta" to anchor hope in Allah.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Hayy while praying for loved ones through illness, birth, or passing.
dhikr_usage: Zikir Ya Al-Hayy ketika merenung perjalanan hidup supaya hati reda pada ketentuan.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you navigate seasons of birth, loss, and renewal.
ghazali_insight: Al-Hayy, the Living, is both agent and perceiver, for one who does not act or perceive at all is dead. The perfect and absolute living thing is one under whose perception all perceived things are arranged, as are all existing things under its activity. For every living thing other than He, its life is commensurate with its perception and its activity, which are circumscribed within narrow limits.
description_en: Al-Hayy reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Hayy mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.13; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, p. 6690).
al_jalil_commentary: To know Allah as "The Ever-Living" is to recognize His perfect and absolute life, which necessitates all other attributes of perfection. This understanding leads the believer to place their complete and sincere trust in Him alone, as He is the only one who never dies, sleeps, or falters.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Hayy when reflecting on life's journey so that the heart accepts divine decree with contentment.
