dhikr_usage_ms: Zikir Ya Al-Hayy ketika merenung perjalanan hidup supaya hati reda pada ketentuan.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Al-Biqa'i explains why Al-Furqan 25:58 commands reliance specifically 'upon the Living who does not die' (Al-Hayy): unlike any created patron who eventually perishes, trusting the Ever-Living lifts the full weight off the servant both during life and after death.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, p. 6690)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allah] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, Acquainted -

english_meaning: The Self-Subsisting One Upon Whom everything depends
proof_text: Allah, there is no god by He, the Ever Living, the All-Sustainer..
aqeedah_belief: He is the Self-Sufficient Master who is not in need of anyone; everything exists because of Him and everything other than Him needs Him and totally depends on Him.
salah_usage: Remember this Name when reciting "Rabbi inni lima anzalta" to anchor hope in Allah.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Qayyum while praying for loved ones through illness, birth, or passing.
dhikr_usage: Zikir Ya Al-Qayyum ketika merenung perjalanan hidup supaya hati reda pada ketentuan.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you navigate seasons of birth, loss, and renewal.
ghazali_insight: Al-Qayyum is the one who subsists in Himself absolutely, needing nothing else for His existence, and by whom every other thing subsists. Man's access to this attribute is in proportion to his detachment from everything that is not God.
description_en: Al-Qayyum reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Qayyum mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.15; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 4, pp. 1358, 1539).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the Self-Subsisting by whom all things are maintained; He needs nothing, while everything is in absolute need of Him. Believing this leads the servant to disavow their own strength, recognize their utter dependence on Allah, and turn to Him for all their needs.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Qayyum when reflecting on life's journey so that the heart accepts divine decree with contentment.
dhikr_usage_ms: Zikir Ya Al-Qayyum ketika merenung perjalanan hidup supaya hati reda pada ketentuan.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Al-Biqa'i explains why Al-Qayyoom ('The Self-Subsisting, Sustainer of all') is paired with Al-Hayy in 2:255 and 3:2: even a living king may need a minister because he cannot manage alone, so Al-Qayyoom negates any need or helper—every existing thing stands only through Him.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 4, pp. 1358, 1539)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.

proof_text: He said, 'The All-Knowing and All-Aware informed me of it.'
aqeedah_belief: He is fully aware of everything: apparent, hidden, all the secrets, and what is yet more hidden.
salah_usage: Ask for hikmah after reciting Al-Fatihah so knowledge leads to action.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Khabir when seeking guidance for decisions beyond your limited sight.
dhikr_usage: Zikir Ya Al-Khabir ketika menuntut ilmu agar pemahaman disulami tawaduk.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you ask Allah to open understanding beyond data.
ghazali_insight: Al-Khabir is the one from whom no secret information is hidden, being aware of every atom's movement and every soul's stirring. Man's share in this name lies in being aware of the hidden things in his own world, his heart and body, guarding against his soul's deceit.
description_en: Al-Khabir reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Khabir mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.55; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 20, p. 187 / page_id 10450).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the one whose knowledge encompasses the inner realities and hidden intricacies of all things. This awareness should instill a state of watchfulness (muraqabah) in the believer, motivating them to guard their actions and thoughts and to submit to God's laws, which are based on His perfect awareness of what is best for His servants.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Khabir when seeking knowledge so that understanding is guided by humility.
dhikr_usage_ms: Zikir Ya Al-Khabir ketika menuntut ilmu agar pemahaman disulami tawaduk.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In At-Tahrim 66:3, al-Biqa'i notes that 'Al-Khabeer' (The All-Aware) highlights Allah's intimate knowledge of hidden conversations, explaining how He informed the Prophet (SAW) of private details.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 20, p. 187 / page_id 10450)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ ٱلنَّبِىُّ إِلَىٰ بَعْضِ أَزْوَٰجِهِۦ حَدِيثًۭا فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَتْ بِهِۦ وَأَظْهَرَهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ عَرَّفَ بَعْضَهُۥ وَأَعْرَضَ عَنۢ بَعْضٍۢ ۖ فَلَمَّا نَبَّأَهَا بِهِۦ قَالَتْ مَنْ أَنۢبَأَكَ هَٰذَا ۖ قَالَ نَبَّأَنِىَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And [remember] when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement; and when she informed [another] of it and Allah showed it to him, he made known part of it and ignored a part. And when he informed her about it, she said, "Who told you this?" He said, "I was informed by the Knowing, the Acquainted."

english_meaning: The Creator and Maker of everything
proof_text: He is Allah, the Creator, the Originator, the Fashioner…
aqeedah_belief: Al-Khaaliq is the One who creates things out of nothing and with no precedents. The name Al-Khallaaq is the intensive form of Al-Khaaliq, which indicates that He increases in creation what He pleases and in a perfect manner.
salah_usage: Praise Allah for your limbs and senses each time you enter sujud.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Khaliq when reflecting on Allah's workmanship in yourself and others.
dhikr_usage: Zikirkan Ya Al-Khaliq ketika menyaksikan alam agar syukur terhadap ciptaan bertambah.
when_to_invoke: Call it whenever you ponder Allah's design in creation and self.
ghazali_insight: Al-Khaliq, the Creator, refers to the one who plans everything which comes forth from nothing into existence. God is creator inasmuch as He is the planner, producer inasmuch as He initiates existence, and fashioner inasmuch as He arranges the forms of things invented. Unlike human building which requires multiple craftsmen, God Himself is planner, originator, and decorator in one.
description_en: Al-Khaliq originates every detail with wisdom, measuring needs precisely before giving them form.
description_ms: Al-Khaliq mencipta setiap perincian dengan hikmah, mengukur keperluan sebelum memberi bentuk.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.69; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 477 / page_id 10184).
al_jalil_commentary: Shaykh al-Jalil notes that belief in Al-Khaaliq necessitates acknowledging His divine wisdom, recognizing that His creation is entirely free from aimlessness. It requires full submission to His legislation, as the Creator alone perfectly knows the needs of His creation. Furthermore, witnessing the magnificent precision of the universe fills the believer's heart with profound awe for Allah.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Khaliq when observing nature so that gratitude for His creation deepens.
dhikr_usage_ms: Zikirkan Ya Al-Khaliq ketika menyaksikan alam agar syukur terhadap ciptaan bertambah.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Hashr 59:24, al-Biqa'i explains that 'Al-Khaaliq' refers to the True Creator who perfectly measures and determines everything before bringing it into existence, unlike created beings whose planning is limited.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 477 / page_id 10184)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُ ٱلْبَارِئُ ٱلْمُصَوِّرُ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

english_meaning: The Creator Who creates again and again
proof_text: Truly, your Lord is the Creator (al-Khallaaq), the All-Knowing.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Khallaaq commits you to affirming that Allah is literally, not metaphorically, the Creator whose act of creating is eternal and continual whenever and however He wills, as Ibn al-Qayyim and Al-Jalil explain from Quran 3:47, Quran 28:68, and Quran 39:38, and that He is the Resurrector who recreates physical bodies after death (Quran 36:81). In opposition to philosophers who claim the world is eternal or deny divine knowledge of particulars, this Name requires believing that Allah precedes every creature without beginning and knows every minute detail of the billions of beings He creates, as Al-Jalil explains from Quran 15:86 and Quran 67:14. As Ibn al-Qayyim further states, it commits you to affirming that the Creator is completely distinct and transcendent above His creation without any indwelling, union, or commingling.
dua_usage: Recognize His continuous creative power in every moment.
when_to_invoke: Recognize His continuous creative power in every moment.
description_en: Al-Khallaaq is the intensive form of Al-Khaaliq, meaning the Creator who creates again and again in vast abundance—bringing billions of creatures into existence out of nothing in a single moment and increasing in creation whatever He pleases in a perfect manner, as Al-Jalil and Shaykh Uthaymeen explain regarding Quran 15:86 and Quran 36:81. Paired in both Qur'anic occurrences with Al-Aleem (the All-Knowing), this Name highlights that His continual, abundant creation and His resurrection of physical bodies proceed from all-encompassing knowledge.
description_ms: Al-Khallaaq ialah bentuk kata penguat bagi Al-Khaaliq yang bermaksud Tuhan Yang Maha Pencipta berulang kali dengan amat banyak, iaitu yang mewujudkan berbilion makhluk daripada tiada dalam satu saat serta menambah ciptaan-Nya mengikut kehendak-Nya dengan sempurna, sebagaimana dijelaskan oleh Al-Jalil dan Syeikh Uthaymeen mengenai Quran 15:86 dan Quran 36:81. Gandingan Nama ini dengan Al-Aleem (Yang Maha Mengetahui) dalam kedua-dua ayat tersebut menegaskan bahawa penciptaan-Nya yang berterusan serta kebangkitan semula jasad manusia berlaku dengan ilmu yang meliputi segala sesuatu.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.69; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 11, p. 85 / page_id 5101).

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Hijr 15:86, al-Biqa'i explains why the intensive form 'Al-Khallaaq' is used: Allah continuously creates time after time with inexhaustible power, proving He can resurrect creation on the Hour just as He first created it.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 11, p. 85 / page_id 5101)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.

proof_text: Allah is Most Compassionate and Most Merciful to mankind.
aqeedah_belief: He bestows mercy upon His servants and is compassionate towards them. The , attribute of ra fah (compassion), from which this name is derived, is the highest form of mercy (rahmah), and He bestows it upon all His creation in this world and upon some of them in the hereafter.
salah_usage: Let this Name soften the heart before takbir so your salah flows with compassion.
dua_usage: Call upon Ar-Ra'uf when pleading for forgiveness for yourself, family, and the ummah.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Ar-Ra'uf dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.
when_to_invoke: Reach for this Name whenever you seek Allah's rahmah after shortcomings.
ghazali_insight: Al-Ra'uf, the All-Pitying, is the one who possesses pity, which is an intensification of mercy. Its meaning is the same as the Merciful but is more emphatic in its expression of divine compassion. It signifies the utmost extent of mercy that embraces those in need with profound tenderness, conveying a sense of deep empathy that seeks to completely fulfill the necessities of creation.
description_en: Ar-Ra'uf reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Ar-Ra'uf mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.99; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 2, p. 215 / page_id 717).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the One whose mercy is the most tender and kind; it is said to be a mercy that contains no hardship, unlike general mercy which can sometimes come through trial. Among the effects of His Ra'fa (kindness) are His acceptance of repentance, His sending of scripture for guidance, and His preserving the deeds of the faithful.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Ar-Ra'uf in your morning and evening remembrance while giving thanks for countless blessings.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Ar-Ra'uf dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Baqarah 2:143, al-Biqa'i notes that 'Ar-Ra'oof' expresses the most intense, gentle compassion (ra'fah), reassuring believers that Allah never wastes the faith or prayers of those who strive toward Him.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 2, p. 215 / page_id 717)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَٰكُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَسَطًۭا لِّتَكُونُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ عَلَيْكُمْ شَهِيدًۭا ۗ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا ٱلْقِبْلَةَ ٱلَّتِى كُنتَ عَلَيْهَآ إِلَّا لِنَعْلَمَ مَن يَتَّبِعُ ٱلرَّسُولَ مِمَّن يَنقَلِبُ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيْهِ ۚ وَإِن كَانَتْ لَكَبِيرَةً إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُضِيعَ إِيمَٰنَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And thus we have made you a just community that you will be witnesses over the people and the Messenger will be a witness over you. And We did not make the qiblah which you used to face except that We might make evident who would follow the Messenger from who would turn back on his heels. And indeed, it is difficult except for those whom Allah has guided. And never would Allah have caused you to lose your faith. Indeed Allah is, to the people, Kind and Merciful.

proof_text: The Most Gracious has taught the Qur'an.
aqeedah_belief: These two names indicate (a) Allah's comprehensive mercy which He shows to all His creation without exception by creating them and providing for them, and (b) the particular mercy that He has exclusively for the believers, both in this life and in the hereafter.
salah_usage: Let this Name soften the heart before takbir so your salah flows with compassion.
dua_usage: Call upon Ar-Rahman when pleading for forgiveness for yourself, family, and the ummah.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Ar-Rahman dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.
when_to_invoke: Reach for this Name whenever you seek Allah's rahmah after shortcomings.
ghazali_insight: Al-Rahman, the Infinitely Good, designates perfect mercy that pours out benefaction to those in need. This mercy is inclusive inasmuch as it embraces both deserving and undeserving alike, encompassing this world and the next. Perfect mercy consists in looking after the one receiving mercy for their own sake, fulfilling their necessities and giving special gifts over and above them.
description_en: Allah's boundless mercy envelops every creature and supplies life, sustenance, and guidance before they even ask.
description_ms: Rahmat Allah yang tiada had meliputi setiap makhluk dan memberi hidup, rezeki, serta petunjuk sebelum kita meminta.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.11; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 142 / page_id 9801).
al_jalil_commentary: This name signifies Allah's all-encompassing mercy that extends to every created thing, encouraging a servitude of hope and attachment to Him. Contemplating this boundless mercy prevents the believer from despairing, knowing that Allah's mercy is vast enough to forgive all sins.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Ar-Rahman in your morning and evening remembrance while giving thanks for countless blessings.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Ar-Rahman dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Opening Surah Ar-Rahman (55:1), al-Biqa'i notes that 'Ar-Rahmaan' highlights Allah's immense, all-encompassing mercy in teaching the Qur'an as His greatest favor upon creation.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 142 / page_id 9801)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: The Most Merciful

proof_text: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
aqeedah_belief: These two names indicate (a) Allah's comprehensive mercy which He shows to all His creation without exception by creating them and providing for them, and (b) the particular mercy that He has exclusively for the believers, both in this life and in the hereafter.
salah_usage: Let this Name soften the heart before takbir so your salah flows with compassion.
dua_usage: Call upon Ar-Rahim when pleading for forgiveness for yourself, family, and the ummah.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Ar-Rahim dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.
when_to_invoke: Reach for this Name whenever you seek Allah's rahmah after shortcomings.
ghazali_insight: Al-Rahim, the Merciful, similarly derives from mercy but reflects the divine intention to fulfill the needs of the needy. The mercy of God is perfect inasmuch as it wants to fulfill the needs of those in need and successfully meets them. The perfection of this mercy depends entirely on the perfection of its fruits in alleviating the needs of creation without suffering in the merciful one.
description_en: Ar-Rahim highlights the special, sustaining mercy reserved for believers that purifies sins and raises ranks in both worlds.
description_ms: Ar-Rahim menonjolkan rahmat khusus untuk orang beriman yang membersihkan dosa dan mengangkat darjat di dunia dan akhirat.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.11; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 2, p. 281 / page_id 786).
al_jalil_commentary: This name denotes Allah's specific mercy for the believers, which they receive through guidance and rewards. A primary effect of knowing this is for the servant to cultivate mercy in their own character and extend it to Allah's creation, especially their parents, children, and the needy.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Ar-Raheem in your morning and evening remembrance while giving thanks for countless blessings.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Ar-Rahim dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Al-Biqa'i explains (notably on 2:163) that 'Ar-Raheem' paired with 'Ar-Rahmaan' signifies the special, everlasting mercy Allah reserves for His faithful servants and close allies.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 2, p. 281 / page_id 786)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ۖ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.

proof_text: Provide for us; for You are the best of providers.
aqeedah_belief: Allah is the Guarantor of provision who sustains every living soul, encompassing all creation with His mercy. He provides for both the believer and the disbeliever, driving sustenance even to the weak who have no means to earn. The name Ar-Razzaaq is exclusive to Him alone, affirming His abundant and continuous provision.
salah_usage: Raise your hands after salah accepting whatever provision Allah decrees.
dua_usage: Say Ya Ar-Razzaq when asking Allah to sustain your family and community with halal rizq.
dhikr_usage: Ingatlah Ya Ar-Razzaq ketika menyusun urusan harian supaya hati bergantung kepada Pemberi rezeki.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you feel uncertain about rizq and resources.
ghazali_insight: Al-Razzaq, the Provider, is the one who created the means of sustenance, conveys them to His creatures, and creates the ways of enjoying them. Sustaining is of two kinds: outward nourishment for the body, and inward sustenance consisting of things known and revealed for the heart. Man's share is to know that God alone deserves this attribute, expecting sustenance only from Him.
description_en: Ar-Razzaq reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Ar-Razzaq mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.89; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, pp. 7882, 9630).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the Great Provider, who has taken it upon Himself to provide for every living creature. Believing in Him as the sole Provider engenders sincere trust (tawakkul) in Him, gives peace of mind concerning one's sustenance, and causes one to abandon unlawful means of seeking livelihood.
dhikr_usage_en: Remember Ya Ar-Razzaq when organizing daily affairs so that your heart relies entirely upon the Provider of sustenance.
dhikr_usage_ms: Ingatlah Ya Ar-Razzaq ketika menyusun urusan harian supaya hati bergantung kepada Pemberi rezeki.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: At Adh-Dhariyat 51:58 and Fatir 35:3 (p. 7882), al-Biqa'i notes why 'Huwa Ar-Razzaaq' is stated with emphasis: knowing Allah is the sole Provider severs hope in creatures and even in one's own effort, directly producing sincerity (ikhlas) and curing provision anxiety.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, pp. 7882, 9630)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.

proof_text: Allah is ever Watchful over all things.
aqeedah_belief: He is the One whose hearing, seeing and knowledge encompass everything and the One from whom nothing is hidden.
salah_usage: Confess hidden faults in sujud knowing Allah already sees them.
dua_usage: Say Ya Ar-Raqib when entrusting your loved ones to Allah's protection.
dhikr_usage: Hadamkan Ya Ar-Raqib sewaktu bermuhasabah agar perbuatan sentiasa diperhatikan-Nya.
when_to_invoke: Use it while you need to remember Allah witnesses every deed.
ghazali_insight: Al-Raqib, the All-Observant, is one who knows and protects with a constant and persistent gaze. It refers to a surveillance so absolute that if one to whom it was forbidden knew about it, he would never approach the forbidden thing. Man's watchfulness is praiseworthy when he directs it to his Lord, guarding his heart against the deceptions of his own soul and Satan.
description_en: Ar-Raqib reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Ar-Raqib mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.123; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 15, p. 389 / page_id 7702).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil explains that worshipping Allah through His name Ar-Raqeeb (The Watchful) yields the fruit of muraqabah (watchfulness of Allah) in one's heart, both in secret and in public. When a servant is certain that Allah hears their words, sees their place, and knows what is hidden in their hearts, they strive to protect their heart, hearing, sight, and limbs from anything that displeases Him.
dhikr_usage_en: Internalize Ya Ar-Raqeeb during self-reflection so you remain conscious that all deeds are observed by Him.
dhikr_usage_ms: Hadamkan Ya Ar-Raqib sewaktu bermuhasabah agar perbuatan sentiasa diperhatikan-Nya.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Ahzab 33:52, al-Biqa'i explains that 'Ar-Raqeeb' (The Watchful) shows Allah closely observes every boundary and command so intimately that nothing escapes His vigilance.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 15, p. 389 / page_id 7702)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: لَّا يَحِلُّ لَكَ ٱلنِّسَآءُ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَلَآ أَن تَبَدَّلَ بِهِنَّ مِنْ أَزْوَٰجٍۢ وَلَوْ أَعْجَبَكَ حُسْنُهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِينُكَ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ رَّقِيبًۭا
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Not lawful to you, [O Muhammad], are [any additional] women after [this], nor [is it] for you to exchange them for [other] wives, even if their beauty were to please you, except what your right hand possesses. And ever is Allah, over all things, an Observer.

english_meaning: the Impeccable One or Flawless One
proof_text: He is Allah; there is none worthy of worship except for Him; the Sovereign, the Holy, the Source of Peace, the Granter of Security...
aqeedah_belief: Allah is free of any imperfection in His Being, names, attributes and actions. He is also the One who grants peace and security to all his creation.
salah_usage: End each salah with salam that spreads Allah's peace through your home.
dua_usage: Say Ya As-Salam when asking Allah to calm fear and grant protection.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Salam sebelum tidur agar malam diisi sakinah.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever your heart longs for sakinah amidst worry.
ghazali_insight: Al-Salam, the Flawless, is the one whose essence is free from defect, whose attributes escape imperfection, and whose actions are untarnished by evil. There is nothing flawless in existence which is not attributed to Him and originates from Him. A servant approaches this attribute by coming to God with a heart free from deceit and limbs unblemished by forbidden actions.
description_en: As-Salam grants complete safety and is free from any injustice, gifting hearts with wholeness when they surrender to Him.
description_ms: As-Salam memberi keselamatan mutlak dan bebas dari kezaliman, menghadiahkan hati yang tenang apabila berserah kepada-Nya.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.27; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 470 / page_id 10177).
al_jalil_commentary: As-Salaam is The One who is free from all defects and the very source of all peace and security. A believer who seeks true peace for themself, their family, or society will find it only through faith in Him and adherence to His laws. This understanding motivates the believer to be an agent of peace, spreading greetings and refraining from all forms of harm against others.
dhikr_usage_en: Say Ya Salam before sleep so that the night is filled with tranquility.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Salam sebelum tidur agar malam diisi sakinah.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Hashr 59:23, al-Biqa'i explains why 'As-Salaam' precedes 'Al-Mu'min': Allah is the source of all peace and safety outwardly—sparing the sinner from immediate wrath and the obedient from harshness—while Al-Mu'min secures inward safety.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 470 / page_id 10177)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَٰمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْجَبَّارُ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.

proof_text: He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
aqeedah_belief: Allah hears and is aware of all secrets without exception. He hears everything people say and whatever His creation utters. Nothing is hidden from Him, and He is the All-Hearing who answers the prayer of those who pray to Him.
salah_usage: Ask for hikmah after reciting Al-Fatihah so knowledge leads to action.
dua_usage: Say Ya As-Sami when seeking guidance for decisions beyond your limited sight.
dhikr_usage: Zikir Ya As-Sami ketika menuntut ilmu agar pemahaman disulami tawaduk.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you ask Allah to open understanding beyond data.
ghazali_insight: As-Sami' is the one from whose perception nothing audible is removed, hearing even the most hidden secrets without a physical ear. Man's share is to realize God hears him and so watch his tongue, and to use his own hearing to listen to the word of God.
description_en: As-Sami reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: As-Sami mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.117; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 17, p. 260 / page_id 8812).
al_jalil_commentary: Belief in As-Samee' (The All-Hearing) should lead one to be mindful of Allah in all that the tongue utters, whether in secret or public, instilling fear of Him and guarding the tongue from foul speech. It also leads to patience when harmed by others' words, knowing that Allah hears them and will judge justly, bringing comfort and tranquility to the believer's heart.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya As-Sami when seeking knowledge so that understanding is guided by humility.
dhikr_usage_ms: Zikir Ya As-Sami ketika menuntut ilmu agar pemahaman disulami tawaduk.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Ash-Shura 42:11, al-Biqa'i notes that 'As-Samee'' after 'There is nothing like unto Him' affirms absolute perfection in hearing—perceiving the subtlest words and realities without any likeness to created hearing.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 17, p. 260 / page_id 8812)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا وَمِنَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ۖ يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِيهِ ۚ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِۦ شَىْءٌۭ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: [He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him, and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.

proof_text: Allah is Grateful and Ever Forbearing.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Ash-Shaakir commits a Muslim to affirming that although Allah is completely self-sufficient and no servant has an obligatory claim upon Him by virtue of deeds, He has graciously bound Himself to accept and multiply even small, pure acts of obedience without measure, as Al-Sa'di and Ibn al-Qayyim state. As Ibn al-Qayyim explains regarding Surah An-Nisa 4:147, this attribute refutes the false doctrine that Allah burdens servants beyond their capacity and punishes them for it, since His appreciation makes it impossible for Him to punish the grateful believer in vain or waste the reward of one who does good. It also entails believing that Allah Himself creates the blessing, the servant's gratitude, and the resulting reward, praising His grateful servants among the angels in the Highest Assembly.
salah_usage: Knowing Allah as Ash-Shaakir motivates adding supererogatory prayers onto obligatory ones (as Al-Jalil explains on Surah Al-Baqarah 2:158), lengthening one's standing in prayer out of gratitude following the Prophet's practice in Sahih al-Bukhari 1130 and Sahih Muslim 2819, and concluding every prayer with the supplication taught to Mu'adh ibn Jabal in Sunan Abi Dawud 1522 (graded sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 1347).
dua_usage: Because Allah as Ash-Shaakir is the Creator of both gratitude and the grateful servant and no believer can thank Him without His aid, Al-Jalil and Ibn al-Qayyim direct the servant to supplicate Him with the prophetic prayers in Sunan Abi Dawud 1522 and Jami' at-Tirmidhi (both graded sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 1347 and 1337) while asking Him to accept and multiply small voluntary deeds.
when_to_invoke: Reach for Ash-Shaakir when performing voluntary acts of worship beyond obligatory duties, when you are unable to do much and fear your small sincere deed is too little, or when giving up something for Allah's sake trusting that He will replace it with something better, as Al-Jalil, Al-Khattabi, and Ibn al-Qayyim explain.
description_en: As Al-Jalil explains regarding Surah Al-Baqarah 2:158, Ash-Shaakir is the Appreciative One who accepts and rewards believers' voluntary acts of devotion beyond obligatory duties because He knows who is truly sincere in drawing near to Him. Ibn al-Qayyim further explains from Surah An-Nisa 4:147 that His appreciation refuses to let any sincere effort go to waste or to punish the grateful believer in vain.
description_ms: Seperti yang dijelaskan oleh Al-Jalil mengenai Surah Al-Baqarah 2:158, Ash-Shaakir ialah Tuhan Yang Maha Menghargai yang menerima serta memberi ganjaran atas amalan sunat hamba melebihi kewajipan fardu kerana Dia mengetahui siapa yang benar-benar ikhlas mendekatkan diri kepada-Nya. Ibn al-Qayyim turut menjelaskan daripada Surah An-Nisa 4:147 bahawa penghargaan-Nya menolak sama sekali penyiaan usaha yang ikhlas atau penyeksaan terhadap mukmin yang bersyukur tanpa sebab.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.115; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 2, p. 272 / page_id 776).
al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Ash-Shakir (The Appreciative) motivates the believer to embody the quality of gratitude and shun ingratitude and denial of blessings. This includes showing gratitude not only to Allah but also to the people through whom Allah's blessings are delivered, such as one's parents.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Baqarah 2:158, al-Biqa'i explains that 'Ash-Shaakir' (The Appreciative) reassures believers performing Sa'y that Allah recognizes every sincere deed and generously multiplies its reward.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 2, p. 272 / page_id 776)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلصَّفَا وَٱلْمَرْوَةَ مِن شَعَآئِرِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَمَنْ حَجَّ ٱلْبَيْتَ أَوِ ٱعْتَمَرَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِ أَن يَطَّوَّفَ بِهِمَا ۚ وَمَن تَطَوَّعَ خَيْرًۭا فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَاكِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. So whoever makes Hajj to the House or performs 'umrah - there is no blame upon him for walking between them. And whoever volunteers good - then indeed, Allah is appreciative and Knowing.

english_meaning: The One most ready to appreciate and reward abundantly
proof_text: Allah is Grateful and Ever Forbearing.
aqeedah_belief: He frequently blesses and rewards His obedient servants abundantly and is pleased with little gratitude from His servants in return for His countless blessings.
salah_usage: Perform sujud syukur whenever Allah completes a blessing for you.
dua_usage: Say Ya Ash-Shakur while thanking Allah for favours and asking to use them well.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Alhamdulillah dan Ya Ash-Shakur sambil menghitung nikmat satu persatu.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you give thanks for blessings entrusted to you.
ghazali_insight: Al-Shakur, the Grateful, is the one who rewards the practice of a few pious deeds many-fold, giving limitless happiness in the life to come for the actions of a few days. Only God is absolutely grateful, because His multiplication of the reward is unrestricted and unlimited. The best form of gratitude for the blessings of God is to put them to use in obeying Him.
description_en: Ash-Shakur reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Ash-Shakur mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.115; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 20, p. 136 / page_id 10392).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil describes Ash-Shakoor as the one who rewards a small amount of obedience with a great reward and is pleased with a little gratitude. Believing in this name should lead one to adorn themselves with the quality of gratitude and avoid its opposite, ingratitude (kufr).
dhikr_usage_en: Say Alhamdulillah and Ya Ash-Shakur while reflecting upon blessings one by one.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Alhamdulillah dan Ya Ash-Shakur sambil menghitung nikmat satu persatu.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In At-Taghabun 64:17, al-Biqa'i explains why the intensive 'Ash-Shakoor' closes the promise to multiply charity: Allah profusely appreciates even the smallest offering made for His sake, rewarding it many times over.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 20, p. 136 / page_id 10392)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: إِن تُقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا يُضَٰعِفْهُ لَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ شَكُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: If you loan Allah a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allah is Most Appreciative and Forbearing.

proof_text: Allah is sufficient as a witness.
aqeedah_belief: He is the One who is aware of everything and knows it in detail, the One from whom nothing the weight of an atom on earth or in heaven is hidden.
salah_usage: Recite Surah Al-Kafirun often so your speech remains sincere.
dua_usage: Use Ya Ash-Shahid when asking Allah to help you stand for the haqq.
dhikr_usage: Zikir Ya Ash-Shahid ketika menulis atau bercakap agar lidah menepati kebenaran.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you need courage to speak and uphold haqq.
ghazali_insight: Ash-Shahid's meaning refers to knowledge with a specific addition: if knowledge is linked to external, visible things, He is the Universal Witness. He is also the one who will bear witness for or against mankind on the day of resurrection based on what He has seen of their actions.
description_en: Ash-Shahid reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Ash-Shahid mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.121; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 5, p. 515 / page_id 2413).
al_jalil_commentary: Belief that Allah is Ash-Shaheed (The Witness) over creation on the Day of Judgment makes the believer wary of wronging others or violating their rights. It also compels the believer to strive for sincerity and piety in their words and deeds, knowing Allah witnesses what is in their hearts and accepts only what is done purely for Him and is correct.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Ash-Shahid when writing or speaking so that your words adhere strictly to truth.
dhikr_usage_ms: Zikir Ya Ash-Shahid ketika menulis atau bercakap agar lidah menepati kebenaran.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In An-Nisa 4:79, al-Biqa'i notes that 'Allah suffices as Witness (Shaheed)' over the Prophet's truthfulness, testifying through the miraculous coherence and wisdom of His revelation.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 5, p. 515 / page_id 2413)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: مَّآ أَصَابَكَ مِنْ حَسَنَةٍۢ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَمَآ أَصَابَكَ مِن سَيِّئَةٍۢ فَمِن نَّفْسِكَ ۚ وَأَرْسَلْنَٰكَ لِلنَّاسِ رَسُولًۭا ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۭا
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: What comes to you of good is from Allah, but what comes to you of evil, [O man], is from yourself. And We have sent you, [O Muhammad], to the people as a messenger, and sufficient is Allah as Witness.

english_meaning: The Perfect Lord and Master upon Whom the whole of creation depends
proof_text: Allah, the Eternal (As-Samad).
aqeedah_belief: He is the Master with absolute sovereignty to whom all His creatures turn for their needs and for whatever happens to them, and to whom all hearts turn, hoping for His mercy and fearing His punishment.
salah_usage: Recite Surah Al-Ikhlas daily so focus remains on Allah alone.
dua_usage: Ask Ya As-Samad to remove distractions that compete with worship.
dhikr_usage: Tasbihkan Ya As-Samad agar setiap perancangan kembali kepada tujuan Ilahi.
when_to_invoke: Use it whenever you focus worship solely on Allah.
ghazali_insight: Al-Samad, the Eternal, is the one to whom one turns in need and the one who is intended in our desires, for ultimate dominion culminates in Him. The absolutely eternal is the one to whom one turns in every need. God bestows a share of this attribute upon those He appoints as models to secure the needs of His creatures by their word and action.
description_en: As-Samad reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: As-Samad mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.87; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, pp. 11687-11692).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the Eternal and Absolute One upon whom all of creation depends for all of their needs, while He is in need of none. This understanding leads the believer to turn to Him alone in total reliance for all requests and to glorify Him for His perfect self-sufficiency and complete attributes.
dhikr_usage_en: Glorify Ya As-Samad so that every plan aligns with divine purpose.
dhikr_usage_ms: Tasbihkan Ya As-Samad agar setiap perancangan kembali kepada tujuan Ilahi.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Al-Biqa'i explains why 'Allah' is repeated in 'Allahu As-Samad' (112:2) and why 112:3 ('He neither begets nor is born') follows without a conjunction: 112:3 directly unpacks both classical meanings of As-Samad—the Master to whom all turn in need, and the Self-Contained without hollowness or division.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, pp. 11687-11692)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born,

english_meaning: The All-Knower of the seen and the unseen
bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Mengetahui Hal Ghaib dan Nyata
proof_text: (combined Aleem/Aalim/Allaam entry) 2:115
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-'Aalim commits a Muslim to affirming that Allah has eternally known what was, what is, and what will be before it comes into being, as well as how non-existent things would have been had they existed, without ever being subject to forgetfulness or ignorance, as Ibn Manzur and Ibn al-Qayyim state. As Al-Sa'di explains, Allah's knowledge encompasses necessary truths (His own essence and attributes), impossibilities (including what would hypothetically result if they existed, as he explains regarding Surah Al-Anbiya 21:22 and Surah Al-Mu'minun 23:91), and all possible beings across the upper and lower worlds. It also entails believing that He alone possesses the keys of the unseen (as Al-Jalil explains regarding Surah Al-An'am 6:59) and knows every accountable person's inward faith or disbelief, deeds, and ultimate recompense from creation through resurrection.
dua_usage: Guard your thoughts and intentions.
when_to_invoke: Guard your thoughts and intentions.
description_en: Al-'Aalim is the All-Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, derived as the active participle of knowledge and appearing thirteen times in the Qur'an—ten times annexed to both the unseen and the witnessed (such as Surah At-Tawbah 9:94) and three times to the unseen alone (such as Surah Al-Jinn 72:26), as Al-Jalil and Al-Zajjaji explain. As Al-Tabari and Ibn Manzur state, this Name signifies that Allah eternally knows all that was and all that will be before its existence, without prior instruction, exclusively encompassing the unseen realities hidden from creation.
description_ms: Al-'Aalim ialah Tuhan Yang Maha Mengetahui hal ghaib dan nyata, yang berasal daripada bentuk kata nama pelaku bagi ilmu serta muncul tiga belas kali dalam al-Quran—sepuluh kali disandarkan kepada perkara ghaib dan nyata (seperti Surah At-Tawbah 9:94) dan tiga kali kepada perkara ghaib sahaja (seperti Surah Al-Jinn 72:26), seperti yang dijelaskan oleh Al-Jalil dan Al-Zajjaji. Menurut Al-Tabari dan Ibn Manzur, nama ini bermaksud Allah mengetahui secara azali segala yang telah dan akan berlaku sebelum kewujudannya tanpa pengajaran, serta meliputi perkara ghaib yang tersembunyi daripada makhluk.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.47; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 2, p. 124 / page_id 622).
al_jalil_commentary: Treated alongside Al-'Aleem, Al-'Aalim is The Knower whose knowledge is absolute. Certainty that Allah is aware of one's outer state and inner reality cultivates a profound sense of God-consciousness (murāqabah). This motivates the believer to maintain righteousness in both public and private, and to purify the heart from hidden ills that people cannot see.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Baqarah 2:115, al-Biqa'i explains that closing with Allah's all-encompassing knowledge ('Aleem) affirms no deed or intention of any servant turning to Him is ever hidden, so He rewards each one perfectly.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 2, p. 124 / page_id 622)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَشْرِقُ وَٱلْمَغْرِبُ ۚ فَأَيْنَمَا تُوَلُّوا۟ فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And to Allah belongs the east and the west. So wherever you [might] turn, there is the Face of Allah. Indeed, Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing.

proof_text: …And know that Allah is All-Mighty, All-Wise.
aqeedah_belief: He is the All-Strong, All-Dominant who reigns supreme over His creatures. He has subjugated all His creatures, all of whom have humbled themselves before Him and have totally submitted to His authority.
salah_usage: Lengthen qiyam and feel supported by the One who can never be overcome.
dua_usage: Invoke Ya Al-Aziz when asking for courage to defend the truth.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Aziz pada awal pagi supaya ketegasan bersandar kepada kudrat Allah.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it during you require strength to stand upon the truth.
ghazali_insight: Al-'Aziz, the Eminent, is one who is so significant that few exist like him, yet he is also one for whom there is intense need and to whom access proves difficult. Only God fulfills all three meanings to perfection: nothing is rarer than the One whose like is impossible, all things need Him in every respect, and reaching Him is impossible.
description_en: Al-Aziz is unconquerable strength; He honours whom He wills and humbles whom He wills, always with justice.
description_ms: Al-Aziz memiliki kekuatan yang tidak dapat dikalahkan; Dia memuliakan sesiapa yang dikehendaki dan merendahkan yang dikehendaki dengan adil.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.61; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 4, p. 70 / page_id 1399).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the Invincible, the Unreachable, the All-Conquering, possessing all meanings of might and honor. For the believer, this name is a source of their own honor, freeing them from dependency on or fear of creation and instilling the certainty that all might belongs to Allah alone.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Aziz in the early morning so that firmness of purpose rests upon the power of Allah.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Aziz pada awal pagi supaya ketegasan bersandar kepada kudrat Allah.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Closing Ibrahim's (AS) sign of the four birds (2:260), al-Biqa'i explains why 'Azeez' is paired with 'Hakeem': witnessing creation obey Allah's call reveals His invincible might ('Izzah), while 'Hakeem' tempers that awe with His wisdom in bringing things from one state to another.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 4, p. 70 / page_id 1399)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِۦمُ رَبِّ أَرِنِى كَيْفَ تُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۖ قَالَ أَوَلَمْ تُؤْمِن ۖ قَالَ بَلَىٰ وَلَٰكِن لِّيَطْمَئِنَّ قَلْبِى ۖ قَالَ فَخُذْ أَرْبَعَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلطَّيْرِ فَصُرْهُنَّ إِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ ٱجْعَلْ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ جَبَلٍۢ مِّنْهُنَّ جُزْءًۭا ثُمَّ ٱدْعُهُنَّ يَأْتِينَكَ سَعْيًۭا ۚ وَٱعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And [mention] when Abraham said, "My Lord, show me how You give life to the dead." [Allah] said, "Have you not believed?" He said, "Yes, but [I ask] only that my heart may be satisfied." [Allah] said, "Take four birds and commit them to yourself. Then [after slaughtering them] put on each hill a portion of them; then call them - they will come [flying] to you in haste. And know that Allah is Exalted in Might and Wise."

english_meaning: The Tremendous One or the Magnificent
proof_text: He is the Sublime, the Tremendous.
aqeedah_belief: This name comprises all attributes of greatness, majesty and glory. He is the Greatest and Tremendous in His Being, names and attributes, and thus none of His creation deserves to be exalted with the heart, the tongue and all body parts as He should be.
salah_usage: Visualise all creation bowing with you when mentioning this majestic Name.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Azim to humble the ego whenever praise comes your way.
dhikr_usage: Bertasbih dengan Ya Al-Azim selepas solat agar kemuliaan kembali kepada-Nya.
when_to_invoke: Reach for it whenever you must humble yourself before Allah's greatness.
ghazali_insight: Al-'Adheem is the one whose essence is absolutely tremendous, exceeding every intellectual limit to the point where comprehending His essence is inconceivable. Among men, prophets and scholars are tremendous, but only in relation to those below them; only God is absolutely tremendous.
description_en: Al-Azim reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Azim mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.35; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 4, page_id 1364).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil highlights the perfection that results from pairing Al-'Adheem (The Great) with Al-Haleem (The Forbearing). His forbearance comes from a position of strength and greatness, not weakness. Unlike human kings who may lack forbearance due to their perceived greatness, Allah's greatness is adorned with His forbearance, which is a further state of perfection.
dhikr_usage_en: Glorify Allah with Ya Al-Azim after prayer so that all majesty and greatness are returned to Him.
dhikr_usage_ms: Bertasbih dengan Ya Al-Azim selepas solat agar kemuliaan kembali kepada-Nya.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Closing Ayat al-Kursi (2:255), al-Biqa'i notes that 'Al-'Adheem' (The Supreme) pairs with 'Al-'Aliyy' to show His greatness lies in absolute elevation beyond human comprehension, echoing the verse's opening with Allah's all-encompassing Name.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 4, page_id 1364)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌۭ وَلَا نَوْمٌۭ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍۢ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.

english_meaning: The One Who pardons again and again
proof_text: Allah is Ever-Pardoning, Ever-Forgiving.
aqeedah_belief: He is the One who constantly pardons the sins of His servants, overlooking transgressions and erasing their traces completely. He refrains from punishing many sins as long as the servant does not associate partners with Him. Were it not for His vast pardon, the earth would have swallowed its inhabitants.
salah_usage: Lengthen sujud for istighfar whenever you recall a slip.
dua_usage: Invoke Ya Al-Afuww when seeking cleansing from sins, big or small.
dhikr_usage: Basahkan lidah dengan Ya Al-Afuww sebelum tidur supaya hati dilapangkan.
when_to_invoke: Use it whenever you return to Allah seeking pardon.
ghazali_insight: Al-Afu, the Effacer of Sins, is the one who erases sins and overlooks acts of disobedience. This name is more expressive than the All-Forgiving, as erasing is more effectual than mere concealment. Man's share is to excuse everyone who harms him, doing good for them instead, just as God does good to the disobedient rather than bringing them swiftly to punishment.
description_en: Al-Afuww reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Afuww mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.109; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 5, p. 288 / page_id 2154).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil explains that Al-'Afuww (The Pardoner) is more profound than Al-Ghafoor (The Forgiver), as pardoning implies complete effacement of the sin, whereas forgiveness implies covering it. The effect of believing in this name is to ask Allah for His pardon for one's sins and wrongdoings, as taught in the Prophetic supplication for Laylat al-Qadr.
dhikr_usage_en: Moisten your tongue with Ya Al-Afuww before sleep so that your heart finds relief and ease.
dhikr_usage_ms: Basahkan lidah dengan Ya Al-Afuww sebelum tidur supaya hati dilapangkan.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In An-Nisa 4:43, al-Biqa'i explains that 'Al-'Afuww' (The Pardoner) signifies erasing the punishment of sin, specifically fitting the gradual legislation around prayer and purity where Allah chooses ease and pardon over hardship.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 5, p. 288 / page_id 2154)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأَنتُمْ سُكَٰرَىٰ حَتَّىٰ تَعْلَمُوا۟ مَا تَقُولُونَ وَلَا جُنُبًا إِلَّا عَابِرِى سَبِيلٍ حَتَّىٰ تَغْتَسِلُوا۟ ۚ وَإِن كُنتُم مَّرْضَىٰٓ أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ أَوْ جَآءَ أَحَدٌۭ مِّنكُم مِّنَ ٱلْغَآئِطِ أَوْ لَٰمَسْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ فَلَمْ تَجِدُوا۟ مَآءًۭ فَتَيَمَّمُوا۟ صَعِيدًۭا طَيِّبًۭا فَٱمْسَحُوا۟ بِوُجُوهِكُمْ وَأَيْدِيكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَفُوًّا غَفُورًا
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: O you who have believed, do not approach prayer while you are intoxicated until you know what you are saying or in a state of janabah, except those passing through [a place of prayer], until you have washed [your whole body]. And if you are ill or on a journey or one of you comes from the place of relieving himself or you have contacted women and find no water, then seek clean earth and wipe over your faces and your hands [with it]. Indeed, Allah is ever Pardoning and Forgiving.

proof_text: Allah is All-Encompassing, All-Knowing.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-'Aleem commits a Muslim to rejecting both the Qadariyyah, who denied Allah's foreknowledge of events before they occur, and the philosophers, who claimed Allah knows universals but not particulars—a falsehood that Ibn al-Qayyim explains is refuted by Surah Al-Fatihah because a Lord ignorant of His servants' particular details could neither be praised, merciful, sovereign, nor judge on the Day of Judgment. It requires affirming that Allah knew and recorded all decrees and calamities in the Preserved Tablet before creating them, as Al-Jalil explains regarding Surah At-Tawbah 9:51 and Surah Al-Hadid 57:22-23. Furthermore, as Al-Jalil notes on Surah An-Nisa 4:35, when Al-'Aleem is mentioned alone it encompasses both outward and inward realities, whereas when paired with Al-Khabeer it signifies encompassing knowledge of the manifest world alongside Al-Khabeer's knowledge of hidden inward secrets.
dua_usage: As Al-Jalil explains, call upon Al-'Aleem in affliction by humbling yourself before Him, directing your complaint to Him, and casting your need at His door with brokenness, acute necessity, and good expectation that He knows your suffering across night or day and will bring relief at the most suitable time (Surah Yusuf 12:83).
when_to_invoke: Reach for Al-'Aleem when relief is delayed during severe grief or loss—as Ya'qub relied on Al-'Aleem Al-Hakeem as consolation upon losing his three sons in Surah Yusuf 12:83—when enduring affliction unseen by others, or when confronting the secret plots of enemies and hypocrites that human knowledge cannot encompass (as Al-Jalil explains on Surah An-Nisa 4:45 and Surah Al-Anfal 8:60).
ghazali_insight: Al-'Aleem's perfection of knowledge lies in comprehending everything—manifest and hidden, small and large—with an infinite knowledge that is the source of all things known. Man's distinction is due to knowledge, and the most beneficial knowledge is knowledge of God.
description_en: Al-'Aleem is the All-Knowing whose comprehensive knowledge encompasses every outward and inward reality, every particular detail of His creation, and every fleeting thought in the human heart. As Al-Jalil explains, this Name is paired with Al-Hakeem in about thirty-seven Qur'anic places (such as Surah Al-Baqarah 2:32 and Surah Yusuf 12:83) because Allah's legislative rulings and His choice of the most suitable time for relief rest upon His complete knowledge of His servants' states and best interests.
description_ms: Al-'Aleem ialah Tuhan Yang Maha Mengetahui yang ilmu-Nya meliputi setiap hakikat zahir dan batin, setiap perincian makhluk-Nya, serta setiap lintasan fikiran di dalam hati manusia. Seperti yang dijelaskan oleh Al-Jalil, nama ini digandingkan dengan Al-Hakeem di kira-kira tiga puluh tujuh tempat dalam al-Quran (seperti Surah Al-Baqarah 2:32 dan Surah Yusuf 12:83) kerana hukum syariat Allah dan pemilihan waktu terbaik bagi kelegaan berasaskan ilmu-Nya yang menyeluruh tentang keadaan serta maslahat hamba-Nya.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.47; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 2, p. 124 / page_id 622).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-'Aleem is the All-Knowing, whose knowledge encompasses everything, public and private, large and small. A firm belief in His complete awareness instills a constant sense of being watched by God (murāqabah), which pushes the servant toward righteousness in all actions. It is a powerful tool for purifying the heart of hidden diseases like envy, pride, and insincerity, which are unseen by people but fully known to Him.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Baqarah 2:115, al-Biqa'i notes that 'Al-'Aleem' (The All-Knowing) affirms nothing of a doer's actions or intentions is hidden from Allah, so He rewards every sincere turn toward Him with exact knowledge.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 2, p. 124 / page_id 622)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَشْرِقُ وَٱلْمَغْرِبُ ۚ فَأَيْنَمَا تُوَلُّوا۟ فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And to Allah belongs the east and the west. So wherever you [might] turn, there is the Face of Allah. Indeed, Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing.

proof_text: He is the Most High, the Magnificent.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-'Aliyy requires affirming all three categories of Allah's absolute elevation (uluww), as Al-Sa'di states that denying any of them is a grave deviation: the elevation of His Essence established over His Throne above creation (Quran 10:3, Quran 20:5), the elevation of His subjugation over all servants (Quran 6:18), and the elevation of His status free of any equal (Quran 16:60, Quran 112:1-4). As Ibn al-Qayyim explains regarding Quran 2:255, Allah's effortless preservation of the upper and lower worlds flows from the loftiness of His Essence as Al-'Aliyy. Furthermore, Al-Sa'di affirms that Allah's absolute loftiness as Al-'Aliyy never contradicts His closeness, for He is Exalted in His nearness and Near in His elevation.
salah_usage: As Ibn al-Qayyim explains regarding the prostration report on Quran 87:1 (narrated by Musnad Ahmad 4/155 and Sunan Abi Dawud 869; graded weak by Al-Albani in Da'if Abi Dawud 184), remembering the loftiness of Al-'Aliyy in sujud directly contrasts the worshipper's physical descent face-down on the ground with his Lord's absolute elevation above all creation.
dua_usage: Humble yourself before His highness.
when_to_invoke: A believer reaches for Al-'Aliyy when holding authority over someone weaker—such as a husband tempted to wrong his wife without cause, as Al-Qasimi explains on Quran 4:34—or when a caller to truth fears a figure of high worldly status and hesitates to enjoin good and forbid evil.
ghazali_insight: Al-'Aliyy is the one above whose rank there is no rank, and all other ranks are inferior to Him. This 'height' is one of rational grading based on causality and perfection, not physical place; God is at the highest grade of all beings.
description_en: Al-'Aliyy means the One Who possesses absolute loftiness above Whom nothing exists, encompassing the elevation of His Essence above the Throne, the elevation of His supreme attributes, and the elevation of His dominance over creation. Because of this loftiness, Ibn 'Ashur explains on Quran 42:51 that human souls receive His speech only through intermediaries, and Al-Qasimi explains on Quran 4:34 that no person of higher rank may wrong someone weaker since Allah stands higher above them.
description_ms: Al-'Aliyy bermaksud Tuhan yang memiliki ketinggian mutlak yang tiada sesuatu pun di atas-Nya, iaitu ketinggian Zat-Nya di atas Arasy, ketinggian sifat-Nya, dan ketinggian penguasaan-Nya ke atas makhluk. Kerana ketinggian ini, Ibn 'Ashur menjelaskan pada Quran 42:51 bahawa manusia hanya menerima kalam-Nya melalui perantaraan, dan Al-Qasimi menjelaskan pada Quran 4:34 bahawa orang yang berkedudukan tinggi tidak boleh menzalimi orang yang lemah kerana Allah lebih tinggi di atas mereka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.39; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 3/4, page_id 1364).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-'Aliyy is The High, The Exalted, possessing absolute highness in His essence above creation, in His power over all things, and in His perfect attributes. This belief humbles the soul before Him and serves as a warning against arrogance and injustice on earth. The believer remembers that no matter how high a person rises in status or power, Allah the Exalted is always infinitely higher.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: At the close of Ayat al-Kursi (2:255), after stating that preserving the heavens and earth never burdens Him, al-Biqa'i notes why 'He is Al-Aliyy Al-Azeem' is added with 'and': His loftiness and greatness are not limited to what was just described—no rank exists except below His.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 3/4, page_id 1364)

proof_text: Allah is the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
aqeedah_belief: He is the One who forgives sins and accepts the repentance of all those who turn to Him; He conceals the sins of His servants, shows never-ending compassion to them and lavishes kindness on them. The word Al-Ghaffaar points to His immense and constant forgiveness of sins.
salah_usage: Lengthen sujud for istighfar whenever you recall a slip.
dua_usage: Invoke Ya Al-Ghaffar when seeking cleansing from sins, big or small.
dhikr_usage: Basahkan lidah dengan Ya Al-Ghaffar sebelum tidur supaya hati dilapangkan.
when_to_invoke: Use it whenever you return to Allah seeking pardon.
ghazali_insight: Al-Ghaffar, He who is full of forgiveness, is the one who makes manifest what is beautiful and conceals what is ugly. He conceals sins by letting a cover fall over them in this world and refraining from requiting them in the next. Man's share in this name lies in concealing concerning others what should be concealed regarding himself, making public only what is best.
description_en: Al-Ghaffar forgives repeatedly and hides faults when servants sincerely return to Him.
description_ms: Al-Ghaffar sentiasa mengampuni dan menutup aib apabila hamba kembali dengan ikhlas.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.107; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 16, p. 454 / page_id 8390).
al_jalil_commentary: Believing in Allah as Al-Ghaffaar instills hope and cuts off despair from His mercy, making the believer turn to Him after sinning. It opens the door of repentance for those who have transgressed, and motivates one to do good deeds as a means of attaining His vast forgiveness.
dhikr_usage_en: Moisten your tongue with Ya Al-Ghaffar before sleep so that your heart finds relief and ease.
dhikr_usage_ms: Basahkan lidah dengan Ya Al-Ghaffar sebelum tidur supaya hati dilapangkan.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Az-Zumar 39:5, after 'Al-'Azeez' (The Almighty), al-Biqa'i explains why 'Al-Ghaffaar' (The Repeatedly Forgiving) follows: lest sinners despair at His overwhelming might and delay turning back, He invites them with repeated forgiveness that erases sins.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 16, p. 454 / page_id 8390)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.

proof_text: Allah is the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
aqeedah_belief: He is the One who forgives sins and accepts the repentance of all those who turn to Him; He conceals the sins of His servants, shows never-ending compassion to them and lavishes kindness on them. The word Al-Ghaffaar points to His immense and constant forgiveness of sins.
salah_usage: Lengthen sujud for istighfar whenever you recall a slip.
dua_usage: Invoke Ya Al-Ghafur when seeking cleansing from sins, big or small.
dhikr_usage: Basahkan lidah dengan Ya Al-Ghafur sebelum tidur supaya hati dilapangkan.
when_to_invoke: Use it whenever you return to Allah seeking pardon.
ghazali_insight: Al-Ghafur, the All-Forgiving, denotes a perfection and completeness of forgiveness that reaches the highest level. It bespeaks an amplitude that goes beyond repeated forgiveness, conveying its excellence and completeness. It signifies the one who perfectly conceals sins, forgiving in a way that manifests absolute grace.
description_en: Al-Ghafur reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Ghafur mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.107; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 16, p. 535 / page_id 8481).
al_jalil_commentary: Belief in this name inspires love for Allah and hope in His mercy, preventing despair when one sins and encouraging one to turn back to Him. It motivates the believer to perform good deeds, which are a cause for forgiveness, and to adopt the character of forgiving others and concealing their faults.
dhikr_usage_en: Moisten your tongue with Ya Al-Ghafur before sleep so that your heart finds relief and ease.
dhikr_usage_ms: Basahkan lidah dengan Ya Al-Ghafur sebelum tidur supaya hati dilapangkan.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Az-Zumar 39:53 ('Do not despair of Allah's mercy'), al-Biqa'i explains why 'Huwa Al-Ghafoor Ar-Raheem' closes the verse: His profound forgiveness wipes out both the sin and its trace without reproach, followed by mercy and honor.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 16, p. 535 / page_id 8481)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: ۞ قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."

english_meaning: The Independent One Who is free of all needs
proof_text: Glory be to Him! He is self-sufficient.
aqeedah_belief: Allah is not in need of His creation. He does not stand in need of anyone at all, while His creation is in need of Him.
salah_usage: Raise your hands after salah accepting whatever provision Allah decrees.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Ghaniyy when asking Allah to sustain your family and community with halal rizq.
dhikr_usage: Ingatlah Ya Al-Ghaniyy ketika menyusun urusan harian supaya hati bergantung kepada Pemberi rezeki.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you feel uncertain about rizq and resources.
ghazali_insight: Al-Ghaniyy is the Rich One, who has no connection with or dependence upon another for His being or attributes. A human is always poor in relation to God, but can be called 'rich' figuratively if he becomes free from need for everything but God.
description_en: Al-Ghaniyy reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Ghaniyy mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.133; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 9, p. 159 / page_id 4214).
al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Allah as Al-Ghaniyy (The Rich, The Self-Sufficient) brings about richness of the heart and soul. This leads to a sense of independence from people, self-esteem, and refraining from coveting what they possess, as one directs all needs to the One whose treasures are infinite.
dhikr_usage_en: Remember Ya Al-Ghaniyy when organizing daily affairs so that the heart relies upon the Provider of sustenance.
dhikr_usage_ms: Ingatlah Ya Al-Ghaniyy ketika menyusun urusan harian supaya hati bergantung kepada Pemberi rezeki.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Yunus 10:68, refuting the claim that Allah took a child, al-Biqa'i notes why 'Huwa Al-Ghaniyy' is the proof: Allah is utterly self-sufficient and free of parts or peers, owning all in the heavens and earth and needing no offspring.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 9, p. 159 / page_id 4214)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ وَلَدًۭا ۗ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۖ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنْ عِندَكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍۭ بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَتَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: They have said, "Allah has taken a son." Exalted is He; He is the [one] Free of need. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth. You have no authority for this [claim]. Do you say about Allah that which you do not know?

english_meaning: The Judge and Opener Who distinguishes the truth from falsehood
proof_text: And He is the All-Knowing Superb Arbiter.
aqeedah_belief: He judges between His servants, opens the doors of sustenance and mercy for them, as well as the doors closed in their faces and thus makes things easy for them.
salah_usage: Let this Name soften the heart before takbir so your salah flows with compassion.
dua_usage: Call upon Al-Fattah when pleading for forgiveness for yourself, family, and the ummah.
