dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Fattah dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.
when_to_invoke: Reach for this Name whenever you seek Allah's rahmah after shortcomings.
ghazali_insight: Al-Fattah, the Opener, is the one by whose providence whatever is closed is opened, and by whose guidance whatever is unclear is disclosed. At times He opens kingdoms for His prophets, and at other times He lifts the veils from the hearts of His holy men. Man's share is to facilitate by his knowledge what creatures find difficult in religious and worldly affairs.
description_en: Al-Fattah reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Fattah mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.91; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 15, p. 502 / page_id 7827).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the Opener of all doors of mercy, provision, and guidance, and the Judge who decides between His servants with truth. This fosters love and attachment to Him alone, as He holds the keys to all that is closed, and trust in His ultimate judgment and victory for the believers.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Fattah during morning and evening dhikr while expressing gratitude for countless blessings.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Fattah dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Saba' 34:26, al-Biqa'i explains that 'Al-Fattaah' (The Supreme Judge/Opener) shows Allah's absolute ability to open and settle what is closed to all others, paired with 'Al-'Aleem' to guarantee flawless judgment on the Day of Gathering.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 15, p. 502 / page_id 7827)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: قُلْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَنَا رَبُّنَا ثُمَّ يَفْتَحُ بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُوَ ٱلْفَتَّاحُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Say, "Our Lord will bring us together; then He will judge between us in truth. And He is the Knowing Judge."

proof_text: (combined Qaadir/Qadeer/Muqtadir)
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Qaadir commits a Muslim to affirming that nothing in the heavens or the earth can escape Allah or frustrate His plan, and that every strength or ability within human beings is solely a grant from Him rather than an independent power. As explained in Al-Jalil, witnessing disasters or enemies overpowering believers never implies any deficiency in Allah's ability to remove hardship or crush disbelievers; rather, His withholding of immediate action proceeds from His wisdom in testing believers and granting respite to disbelievers.
dua_usage: As illustrated by Al-Jalil's citation of the Istikharah supplication in Sahih al-Bukhari 6382, one calls upon Allah in light of Al-Qaadir by asking Him to decree and empower one's affair through His ability while confessing one's own lack of independent power.
dhikr_usage: Berdasarkan panduan Al-Jalil yang merujuk Sahih Muslim 4875, seorang mukmin menghayati nama Al-Qaadir dalam zikir dengan melafazkan ungkapan pelepasan diri daripada sebarang daya dan kekuatan peribadi melainkan dengan keupayaan Allah.
when_to_invoke: A believer reaches for Al-Qaadir when seeking Allah's decree in Istikharah over an affair (Sahih al-Bukhari 6382), when witnessing collective disasters or enemies overpowering Muslims while trusting His power to remove them, or when tempted by personal capability to wrong someone weaker.
ghazali_insight: Al-Qadir, the All-Powerful, is the one who creates each existent individually without needing assistance from anyone else. Power is equivalent to the intention by which a thing comes into existence according to a determinate plan of will and knowledge. The All-Powerful does what He wills, or does not act if He so wills, and is not conditioned to will necessarily.
description_en: Al-Qaadir is the active participle denoting the One Who possesses mastery and ability to do whatever He wills—including sending punishment from above or beneath and dividing people into factions as in Quran 6:65—without ever being touched by incapacity or fatigue. As Al-Raghib al-Asfahani explains, human ability is always restricted to specific acts and accompanied by incapacity in others, whereas Al-Qaadir alone possesses absolute ability free from incapacity in every respect.
description_ms: Al-Qaadir ialah kata nama pelaku yang bermaksud Tuhan yang memiliki penguasaan dan keupayaan untuk melakukan apa sahaja yang dikehendaki-Nya, termasuk menurunkan azab dari atas atau bawah seperti dalam Quran 6:65, tanpa sebarang kelemahan atau keletihan. Seperti yang dijelaskan oleh Al-Raghib al-Asfahani, keupayaan manusia sentiasa terbatas pada perkara tertentu dan disertai kelemahan pada perkara lain, manakala Al-Qaadir sahaja yang memiliki keupayaan mutlak yang bebas daripada sebarang kelemahan.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.65; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 7, p. 143 / page_id 3011).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the Able, the one who possesses the power to do a thing. This name and its more intensive forms (Al-Qadeer, Al-Muqtadir) foster complete trust and reliance on Allah, who is capable of all things, and instill a fear of oppressing others by reminding the believer of Allah's ultimate power over them.
dhikr_usage_en: Based on the guidance of Al-Jalil referencing Sahih Muslim 4875, a believer internalizes the name Al-Qaadir in dhikr by declaring disavowal of any personal might and power except through the capability of Allah.
dhikr_usage_ms: Berdasarkan panduan Al-Jalil yang merujuk Sahih Muslim 4875, seorang mukmin menghayati nama Al-Qaadir dalam zikir dengan melafazkan ungkapan pelepasan diri daripada sebarang daya dan kekuatan peribadi melainkan dengan keupayaan Allah.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-An'am 6:65, al-Biqa'i notes why 'Al-Qaadir' is used rather than an intensive form: the idolaters did not deny Allah's power, only His sole right to worship, so the Name affirms His exclusive capability to send punishment from above or beneath.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 7, p. 143 / page_id 3011)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلْقَادِرُ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابًۭا مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ أَوْ مِن تَحْتِ أَرْجُلِكُمْ أَوْ يَلْبِسَكُمْ شِيَعًۭا وَيُذِيقَ بَعْضَكُم بَأْسَ بَعْضٍ ۗ ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ نُصَرِّفُ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَفْقَهُونَ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Say, "He is the [one] Able to send upon you affliction from above you or from beneath your feet or to confuse you [so you become] sects and make you taste the violence of one another." Look how We diversify the signs that they might understand.

proof_text: And He is the One, the All-Dominant.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Qaahir commits a Muslim to affirming Allah's elevation in essence, status, and subjugation above His servants as stated in Quran 6:18 and Quran 6:61, and recognizing that the Subduer can only be One since an unsubdued rival would negate His absolute dominance. Because all worldly causes and creatures are themselves subdued—shown when a person desires children, health, or wealth yet is prevented by Allah's decree—none of them possesses independent power over provision or lifespan. Furthermore, as Ibn al-Qayyim states, it is forbidden to name earthly kings Al-Qaahir, because absolute dominance belongs exclusively to Allah.
dua_usage: Humble your ego before His power.
when_to_invoke: A believer reaches for Al-Qaahir when blocked from personal desires by involuntary decrees—such as childlessness, illness, or poverty—or when fearing that subdued creatures could threaten one's provision or lifespan.
description_en: Al-Qaahir means the Invincible Subduer Who seizes and tames from above—just as a handler tames an unruly camel, as Al-Zajjaj explains—so that every neck, tyrant, and creature yields under His dominance without any defense. Unlike the subjugation of human tyrants driven by lust and aggression, Al-Jalil explains regarding Quran 6:18 that Allah pairs Al-Qaahir with Al-Hakim and Al-Khabir to assure the fearful heart that His irresistible dominance operates strictly for reform and wisdom.
description_ms: Al-Qaahir bermaksud Tuhan Yang Maha Menundukkan dari atas—seperti seseorang menjinakkan unta sebagaimana dijelaskan oleh Al-Zajjaj—sehingga setiap makhluk dan pemerintah yang zalim tunduk di bawah penguasaan-Nya tanpa mampu melawan. Berbeza dengan paksaan manusia zalim yang didorong oleh nafsu dan permusuhan, Al-Jalil menjelaskan pada Quran 6:18 bahawa Allah menggandingkan Al-Qaahir dengan Al-Hakim dan Al-Khabir bagi menenangkan hati bahawa penguasaan-Nya berlaku mengikut hikmah dan kebaikan.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.63; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 7, p. 39 / page_id 2895).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the One who subjugates and holds dominion over His creation, who is supreme above them. This Name, along with Al-Qahhaar, instills glorification of Allah, fear of Him alone, and the affirmation of His absolute highness (fawqiyyah) above all of creation.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-An'am 6:18, al-Biqa'i explains that 'Al-Qaahir' (The Irresistible Subduer) affirms Allah executes all He wills while preventing others from thwarting Him, paired with 'Al-Hakeem' to show His dominance is always exercised with flawless wisdom.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 7, p. 39 / page_id 2895)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْقَاهِرُ فَوْقَ عِبَادِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And He is the subjugator over His servants. And He is the Wise, the Acquainted [with all].

proof_text: …The Sovereign Lord, the Holy, the Exalted in Mighty, the All-Wise.
aqeedah_belief: He is free of any imperfection, and evil is not attributed to Him, for all perfect and sublime attributes belong to Him.
salah_usage: Before takbir, breathe in and ask Allah to remove ego residue.
dua_usage: Use Ya Al-Quddus when begging Allah to purify your body, heart, and surroundings.
dhikr_usage: Baca Subbuhun Quddusun selepas wudu agar ibadah bermula dengan kesucian.
when_to_invoke: Call it whenever you wish to cleanse your intentions and worship.
ghazali_insight: Al-Quddus, the Holy, is the one who is free from every attribute which a sense might perceive, or imagination may conceive. God transcends attributes taken from human perfection as much as He does those reflecting human imperfections. The holiness of the servant lies in freeing his knowledge and will from tangible and imagined things, focusing instead on eternal divine things.
description_en: Al-Quddus is utterly free from defect and fills creation with what is pure, so believers seek His sanctity to purify their hearts and environments.
description_ms: Al-Quddus bebas sepenuhnya daripada cacat dan mengalirkan kesucian ke dalam ciptaan; hamba memohon kesucian-Nya untuk hati dan suasana.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.23; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 20, p. 46 / page_id 10291).
al_jalil_commentary: The author explains that Allah, The Holy, is a King free from any of the flaws that afflict earthly kings, such as tyranny, injustice, or being swayed by personal desires and favoritism. This belief leads the servant to recognize Allah's perfect and just sovereignty, which is utterly sanctified and beyond the imperfections of worldly rulers.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Subbuhun Quddus after ablution (wudu) so that worship begins with purity.
dhikr_usage_ms: Baca Subbuhun Quddusun selepas wudu agar ibadah bermula dengan kesucian.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Jumu'ah 62:1, al-Biqa'i notes that 'Al-Quddoos' (The Most Holy) declares Allah free from every imperfection or limitation, reminding believers to purify their own speech and deeds from hypocrisy and emptiness.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 20, p. 46 / page_id 10291)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يُسَبِّحُ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْمَلِكِ ٱلْقُدُّوسِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allah, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

proof_text: Say, 'He is able to send punishment upon you from above you or from beneath your feet.'
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Qadeer commits a Muslim to affirming that Allah alone possesses absolute power free of all incapacity and fatigue, whereas every created being's ability is limited, bestowed by Him, and mixed with weakness and mortality. As As-Sa'di and Ibn Al-Qayyim explain, His complete power brings all things into existence, governs life, death, and resurrection, turns hearts, and holds every creature within His grasp so that none can escape or frustrate Him. Furthermore, as Al-Jalil and As-Sa'di explain regarding Quran 4:149 and Quran 60:7, when Allah pardons great sins or delays crushing oppressors and enemies, He does so out of complete power and wisdom rather than inability.
dua_usage: As Al-Jalil explains using the Istikharah supplication in Sahih al-Bukhari 6382 and As-Sa'di's commentary on Quran 4:149 and Quran 60:7, you call upon Al-Qadeer by asking Him to empower you through His power while confessing your own inability, and by asking Him through His complete power to pardon grave sins and turn hostile hearts toward affection.
dhikr_usage: Seperti yang dijelaskan oleh Al-Jalil melalui rujukan Sahih Muslim 4875, seorang mukmin mengingati Al-Qadeer dalam zikir harian dengan melepaskan diri daripada rasa memiliki daya atau kekuatan sendiri serta mengingati kuasa Allah ke atas dirinya apabila terdorong untuk melakukan kezaliman.
when_to_invoke: You reach for Al-Qadeer when witnessing personal calamities, collective disasters, or enemies overpowering Muslims, when seeking reconciliation between hostile hearts as As-Sa'di explains under Quran 60:7, or when your own strength tempts you to wrong others in their blood, wealth, or honor.
ghazali_insight: Al-Qadir and Al-Muqtadir both refer to the one who possesses power, but the All-Determiner is more emphatic. Power means the intention by which a thing comes into existence according to a determinate plan of will and knowledge. The absolutely powerful is He who creates each existent individually without needing assistance from anyone else.
description_en: Al-Qadeer is an intensive form of power denoting the One whose ability is complete and who does whatever He wills in the exact measure required by His wisdom, neither exceeding it nor falling short. Because His power is untouched by incapacity or weariness and encompasses bringing beings into existence, governing them, and turning hearts, none but Allah may be described by this Name.
description_ms: Al-Qadeer ialah bentuk kata yang membawa maksud kesempurnaan kuasa, iaitu Tuhan yang melakukan apa sahaja yang dikehendaki-Nya mengikut kadar hikmah-Nya tanpa lebih mahupun kurang. Oleh sebab kuasa-Nya bebas daripada sebarang kelemahan atau kepenatan serta merangkumi penciptaan makhluk, pentadbiran mereka, dan pembalikan hati, hanya Allah sahaja yang layak disifatkan dengan Nama ini.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.65; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 15, p. 129 / page_id 7414).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the One of perfect and complete power, by which He brought all existence into being, manages it, perfects it, and will resurrect it for judgment. This attribute should inspire trust in His wisdom, even during calamities, as He who has power over all things can easily relieve any hardship.
dhikr_usage_en: As explained by Al-Jalil referencing Sahih Muslim 4875, a believer remembers Al-Qadeer in daily dhikr by relinquishing any sense of possessing independent power or strength, and recalling Allah's power over oneself whenever tempted to commit wrongdoing.
dhikr_usage_ms: Seperti yang dijelaskan oleh Al-Jalil melalui rujukan Sahih Muslim 4875, seorang mukmin mengingati Al-Qadeer dalam zikir harian dengan melepaskan diri daripada rasa memiliki daya atau kekuatan sendiri serta mengingati kuasa Allah ke atas dirinya apabila terdorong untuk melakukan kezaliman.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Closing Ar-Rum 30:54 on human weakness and strength, al-Biqa'i explains why 'Al-Aleem' precedes 'Al-Qadeer': Allah's knowledge directs the causes He wills, and 'Al-Qadeer' ensures no one can thwart His causes or delay what He decrees by a single moment.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 15, p. 129 / page_id 7414)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن ضَعْفٍۢ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍۢ قُوَّةًۭ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍۢ ضَعْفًۭا وَشَيْبَةًۭ ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْقَدِيرُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Allah is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent.

english_meaning: The One Who is near to the servants
proof_text: …surely I am very near; I answer the prayer of the supplicant when he calls on Me.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Qareeb commits a Muslim to affirming what As-Sa'di explains as two kinds of divine nearness: a general nearness to every creature through His encompassing knowledge, awareness, and observation, and a special nearness to His worshippers and supplicants that entails His love, support, acceptance, and answer, while Ibn Taymiyyah and Ibn Al-Qayyim restrict His nearness to this special nearness and explain Quran 50:16 and Quran 56:85 as the nearness of His angels. As Ibn Al-Qayyim explains using Sahih al-Bukhari 2992 and Sahih Muslim 2704, Allah's nearness does not contradict His highness above His Throne, for He is near in His highness and high in His nearness. This belief also requires rejecting all created intermediaries between the servant and Allah, since Al-Qareeb hears and answers supplicants directly without chamberlains.
salah_usage: Awareness of Al-Qareeb shapes your salah primarily in prostration and obligatory prayers, as Ibn Al-Qayyim and Al-Jalil explain through Quran 96:19, Sahih Muslim 482, and Sahih al-Bukhari 6502 that a servant draws closest to his Lord while prostrating and by performing the obligatory acts of worship.
dua_usage: As Ibn Al-Qayyim explains under Quran 2:186, Quran 7:55, and Quran 19:3, you call upon Al-Qareeb directly without intermediaries by lowering your voice in quiet, private conversation rather than shouting as if addressing someone distant.
dhikr_usage: Berdasarkan penjelasan Ibn Al-Qayyim dan Al-Jalil terhadap hadis Sahih al-Bukhari 2992 dan Sahih Muslim 2704, seorang mukmin mengamalkan kesedaran terhadap Al-Qareeb ketika berzikir dan bertakbir dengan merendahkan suara serta tidak memekik kerana Tuhan yang diseru itu Maha Mendengar lagi Maha Dekat.
when_to_invoke: You reach for Al-Qareeb when calling upon Allah in secret during acute distress, in the last depth of the night, or when tempted to despair or seek created intermediaries to carry your needs to Him.
description_en: Al-Qareeb is the One who is near to all creation through His knowledge, hearing, and constant observation, and specially near to those who worship and call upon Him with His kindness, support, and answer. Knowing that He is Al-Qareeb frees the believer from relying on created intermediaries and inspires quiet, intimate supplication directly to Him.
description_ms: Al-Qareeb ialah Tuhan yang dekat dengan semua makhluk melalui ilmu, pendengaran, dan pemerhatian-Nya yang berterusan, serta dekat secara khusus dengan hamba yang menyembah dan berdoa kepada-Nya melalui pertolongan dan perkenan-Nya. Keyakinan bahawa Dia ialah Al-Qareeb membebaskan seorang mukmin daripada bergantung pada perantara makhluk dan mendorongnya berdoa secara perlahan serta langsung kepada-Nya.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.125; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 9, p. 319 / page_id 4398).
al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Al-Qareeb (The Near) has two effects. The belief in His general nearness to all creation via His knowledge and observation inspires fear, watchfulness, and modesty. The belief in His special nearness to His worshippers inspires hope, prevents despair, and leads one to supplicate to Him with intimacy, turning away from intermediaries.
dhikr_usage_en: Based on the explanation of Ibn Al-Qayyim and Al-Jalil regarding Sahih al-Bukhari 2992 and Sahih Muslim 2704, a believer practices awareness of Al-Qareeb during dhikr and takbir by lowering the voice and not shouting, for the Lord being invoked is All-Hearing and Ever Near.
dhikr_usage_ms: Berdasarkan penjelasan Ibn Al-Qayyim dan Al-Jalil terhadap hadis Sahih al-Bukhari 2992 dan Sahih Muslim 2704, seorang mukmin mengamalkan kesedaran terhadap Al-Qareeb ketika berzikir dan bertakbir dengan merendahkan suara serta tidak memekik kerana Tuhan yang diseru itu Maha Mendengar lagi Maha Dekat.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Hud 11:61, after commanding 'ask His forgiveness, then turn to Him in repentance,' al-Biqa'i notes why Prophet Salih closes with 'Indeed, my Lord is Qareeb Mujeeb': sinners who see Allah's respite might doubt His closeness, so the Name reassures every sincere caller that He is near without motion or distance and answers unlike false idols.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 9, p. 319 / page_id 4398)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: ۞ وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَٰلِحًۭا ۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ ۖ هُوَ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى قَرِيبٌۭ مُّجِيبٌۭ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And to Thamud [We sent] their brother Salih. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. He has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive."

proof_text: …He is the All-Strong, the All-Mighty.
aqeedah_belief: He is the All-Powerful whose complete power cannot be overcome or escaped by anyone. His commands and decrees are flawlessly executed throughout His creation, and He is severe in punishing those who reject His signs. Unlike the limited strength of created beings, His perfect power is never subject to weakness or inability.
salah_usage: Lengthen qiyam and feel supported by the One who can never be overcome.
dua_usage: Invoke Ya Al-Qawiyy when asking for courage to defend the truth.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Qawiyy pada awal pagi supaya ketegasan bersandar kepada kudrat Allah.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it during you require strength to stand upon the truth.
ghazali_insight: Al-Qawiyy, the Strong, indicates perfect and utmost power. Al-Matin (the Firm) indicates the intensification of that strength. God is the Strong One because He possesses the utmost and most perfect power.
description_en: Al-Qawiyy reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Qawiyy mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.57; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 17, p. 286 / page_id 8840).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the One of perfect, complete strength who is never overcome by inability. Faith in this name should produce humility before God's might, sincere reliance (tawakkul) upon Him alone, and a sense of honor and fearlessness towards creation, knowing their power is nothing compared to Allah's.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Qawiyy in the early morning so that resolve is anchored in the power of Allah.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Qawiyy pada awal pagi supaya ketegasan bersandar kepada kudrat Allah.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Ash-Shura 42:19, after stating Allah provides for whomever He wills—raising the weak and humbling the strong—al-Biqa'i notes why 'Huwa Al-Qawiyy Al-Azeez' closes the ayah: distributing provision with total sovereignty requires complete strength and invincible might belonging to Him alone.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 17, p. 286 / page_id 8840)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَطِيفٌۢ بِعِبَادِهِۦ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Allah is Subtle with His servants; He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.

english_meaning: The Overwhelming Subduer Who is never overcome
proof_text: …And He is the One, the All-Dominant.
aqeedah_belief: He is the One before whom everyone, including tyrants, is humbled. He is also the One who prevails over all His creation and to whom everyone and everything submits.
salah_usage: Lengthen qiyam and feel supported by the One who can never be overcome.
dua_usage: Invoke Ya Al-Qahhar when asking for courage to defend the truth.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Qahhar pada awal pagi supaya ketegasan bersandar kepada kudrat Allah.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it during you require strength to stand upon the truth.
ghazali_insight: Al-Qahhar is the Dominator who breaks the backs of the powerful among His enemies and subdues them. There is no existing thing that is not subject to the domination of His power and powerless in His grasp. Whoever conquers the passions of their own soul and conquers Satan truly shares in this attribute, living for their spirit rather than their body.
description_en: Al-Qahhar subdues tyrants and personal nafs alike, bending everything toward His wise decree.
description_ms: Al-Qahhar menundukkan penzalim dan nafsu diri, menggiring segala sesuatu ke arah ketetapan-Nya yang bijaksana.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.63; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, pp. 4849, 9570).
al_jalil_commentary: The All-Dominating, who vanquishes the powerful and subdues all of creation through death. As this absolute power belongs only to the One, belief in this name necessitates singling Him out for all worship and reliance, and fearing Him alone as all creation is subdued under His power.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Qahhar in the early morning so that resolve is anchored in the power of Allah.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Qahhar pada awal pagi supaya ketegasan bersandar kepada kudrat Allah.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Al-Biqa'i explains why Ar-Ra'd 13:16 pairs 'Al-Wahid' with 'Al-Qahhaar' via the proof of mutual hindrance (burhan al-tamanu'): absolute subjugation belongs to One alone. By contrast, at Qaf 50:33 (p. 9570), 'Ar-Rahman' is used instead of 'Al-Qahhaar' so awe is paired with hope.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, pp. 4849, 9570)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلْ أَفَٱتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ نَفْعًۭا وَلَا ضَرًّۭا ۚ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ أَمْ هَلْ تَسْتَوِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتُ وَٱلنُّورُ ۗ أَمْ جَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ خَلَقُوا۟ كَخَلْقِهِۦ فَتَشَٰبَهَ ٱلْخَلْقُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّٰرُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Say, "Who is Lord of the heavens and earth?" Say, "Allah." Say, "Have you then taken besides Him allies not possessing [even] for themselves any benefit or any harm?" Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Or is darkness equivalent to light? Or have they attributed to Allah partners who created like His creation so that the creation [of each] seemed similar to them?" Say, "Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, the Prevailing."

proof_text: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Kabeer commits a Muslim to affirming what Al-Khattabi, At-Tabari, and As-Sa'di explain: that Allah is incomparably great in His essence, status, and attributes, such that everything else stands below Him, every great thing shrinks before His majesty, and He transcends all resemblance to created beings. As As-Sa'di explains under Quran 34:23, part of His greatness is that His judgment prevails over all creation and even the souls of the arrogant and polytheists are compelled to submit to Him. Consequently, as Al-Qasimi explains under Quran 4:34, no human superiority in strength or status places a person above accountability before Al-Kabeer, who stands above the strong and avenges the weak whom they wrong.
salah_usage: As Al-Jalil explains, Al-Kabeer shapes your salah from its very beginning to its end, as the prayer is called through the repeated takbir in the adhan and iqamah, entered by pronouncing the opening takbir that makes outside actions unlawful, and structured around repeating the takbir at every transition from one pillar of the prayer to the next.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Kabir to humble the ego whenever praise comes your way.
dhikr_usage: Seperti yang dijelaskan oleh Al-Jalil dan Ibn Taymiyyah berdasarkan Quran 2:185 dan Quran 22:37, seorang mukmin mengamalkan Nama Al-Kabeer dalam zikir dengan melafazkan takbir pada malam Hari Raya Aidilfitri sehingga selesai solat raya, ketika menyembelih haiwan korban dan melontar jamrah semasa haji, ketika memulakan tawaf dan sa'i, serta ketika menaiki kenderaan dalam musafir atau mendaki tempat yang tinggi sebagai tanda syukur atas nikmat hidayah, rezeki, dan kemenangan.
when_to_invoke: You reach for Al-Kabeer when a powerful person threatens your livelihood or life, when you are tempted to abuse your authority over someone weaker such as a spouse as Al-Qasimi explains under Quran 4:34, or when Allah grants you guidance, provision, or victory.
ghazali_insight: Al-Kabir is the Great One who possesses greatness identical with the perfection of essence and existence. This perfection resolves to two things: His enduring in an everlasting and eternal manner, and His existence being the source from which every existing thing emanates. The truly great one among men is the scholar whose perfections flow out to guide others.
description_en: Al-Kabeer is the Incomparably Great One in His essence and attributes, before whose majesty every great thing becomes small and whom nothing in creation resembles or surpasses. Recognizing Him as Al-Kabeer fills the heart with veneration that dispels fear of powerful creatures and deters a person from using worldly rank to oppress those who are weaker.
description_ms: Al-Kabeer ialah Tuhan Yang Maha Besar pada zat dan sifat-Nya, yang menjadikan segala sesuatu yang besar tampak kecil di hadapan keagungan-Nya serta tiada makhluk yang menyerupai atau mengatasi-Nya. Mengenal-Nya sebagai Al-Kabeer memenuhi hati dengan pengagungan yang menghilangkan rasa takut terhadap ancaman makhluk yang berkuasa dan menghalang seseorang daripada menggunakan kedudukannya untuk menzalimi golongan yang lemah.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, p. 4821).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Kabeer is The Great, the one described with such majesty and grandeur that everything else is small in comparison. The author states that the effects of believing in this name are the same as for Al-Mutakabbir and Al-'Adheem: it fills the heart with humility, prompting submission to God's truth and law, and fosters humble and just treatment of others.
dhikr_usage_en: As explained by Al-Jalil and Ibn Taymiyyah based on Quran 2:185 and Quran 22:37, a believer practices the Name Al-Kabeer in dhikr by reciting takbir on the night of Eid al-Fitr until the completion of Eid prayer, when slaughtering sacrificial animals and stoning the jamarat during Hajj, when commencing tawaf and sa'i, and when boarding a vehicle during travel or ascending high places as an expression of gratitude for guidance, provision, and victory.
dhikr_usage_ms: Seperti yang dijelaskan oleh Al-Jalil dan Ibn Taymiyyah berdasarkan Quran 2:185 dan Quran 22:37, seorang mukmin mengamalkan Nama Al-Kabeer dalam zikir dengan melafazkan takbir pada malam Hari Raya Aidilfitri sehingga selesai solat raya, ketika menyembelih haiwan korban dan melontar jamrah semasa haji, ketika memulakan tawaf dan sa'i, serta ketika menaiki kenderaan dalam musafir atau mendaki tempat yang tinggi sebagai tanda syukur atas nikmat hidayah, rezeki, dan kemenangan.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Al-Biqa'i explains why Ar-Ra'd 13:9 places 'Al-Kabeer Al-Muta'aalee' right after 'Knower of the unseen and the seen': knowledge and wisdom only reach perfection when joined with complete power and greatness, before which every created greatness dwindles.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, p. 4821)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْكَبِيرُ ٱلْمُتَعَالِ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.

english_meaning: The Bountiful, The Generous One Abundant in good
proof_text: Allah is Grateful and Ever Forbearing.
aqeedah_belief: He frequently blesses and rewards His obedient servants abundantly and is pleased with little gratitude from His servants in return for His countless blessings.
salah_usage: Let this Name soften the heart before takbir so your salah flows with compassion.
dua_usage: Call upon Al-Karim when pleading for forgiveness for yourself, family, and the ummah.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Karim dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.
when_to_invoke: Reach for this Name whenever you seek Allah's rahmah after shortcomings.
ghazali_insight: Imam al-Ghazali observes that the name Al-Kareem combines the profound meanings of several other divine attributes, including the Majestic, the Bestower, and the Generous. By synthesizing these qualities, it points to a comprehensive grace and an endless capacity for giving. This unity of attributes reflects the boundless nobility of God's essence.
description_en: Al-Karim reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Karim mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.113; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 21, p. 302 / page_id 11155).
al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Al-Kareem (The Generous) should inspire modesty (Haya') and humility in the believer's heart. Allah's immense generosity, which continues despite His servants' disobedience, should cause the believer to feel shy before Him and turn away from what displeases Him. It also impels the believer to adopt the character of generosity towards others, as Allah is Generous and loves the generous among His servants.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Karim during morning and evening dhikr while expressing gratitude for countless blessings.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Karim dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Infitar 82:6 ('What has deceived you concerning your Lord, Al-Kareem?'), al-Biqa'i explains that 'Al-Kareem' highlights both Allah's immense grace and a solemn warning: His forbearance gives respite, not license to violate His sanctity.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 21, p. 302 / page_id 11155)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,

proof_text: …And He is the All-Subtle, the All-Aware.
aqeedah_belief: He has knowledge of all things, subtle and hidden, and He shows His immense mercy to His slaves in very subtle ways known to no one but Him.
salah_usage: Let this Name soften the heart before takbir so your salah flows with compassion.
dua_usage: Call upon Al-Latif when pleading for forgiveness for yourself, family, and the ummah.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Latif dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.
when_to_invoke: Reach for this Name whenever you seek Allah's rahmah after shortcomings.
ghazali_insight: Al-Lateef is the Benevolent one who knows the subtle and hidden aspects of beneficial things and conveys them with gentleness rather than harshness. A man's share in this name is to be gentle with God's servants and guide them to good without rebuke or fanaticism.
description_en: Al-Latif reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Latif mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.41; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, pp. 3100, 4744).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Lateef is the Subtle and Kind, whose knowledge perceives all secrets and who delivers His mercy through hidden and gentle means. Faith in His subtlety (luṭf) brings tranquility to the believer's heart, especially in hardship. The believer trusts that even disliked events may be a hidden kindness from their Lord, leading to contentment and delegation of their affairs to Him.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Latif during morning and evening dhikr while expressing gratitude for countless blessings.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Latif dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Al-Biqa'i explains why Al-An'am 6:103 follows 'vision cannot encompass Him' with 'He is Al-Lateef Al-Khabeer': Divine lutf is manifesting a thing through its opposite—hiding wisdom inside outward hardship, as in Yusuf's enslavement becoming his path to kingship (12:100, p. 4744).
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, pp. 3100, 4744)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: لَّا تُدْرِكُهُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ وَهُوَ يُدْرِكُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Vision perceives Him not, but He perceives [all] vision; and He is the Subtle, the Acquainted.

english_meaning: The True and Trustworthy, The Granter of security
proof_text: …The Holy, the Source of peace, the Granter of security, the Ever Watchful, the Almighty, the Compeller, the Supremely Great…
aqeedah_belief: He is the One who testifies to His own Oneness and Attributes, providing the greatest and most absolute testimony. He also confirms the truthfulness of His messengers through clear signs and by granting them victory. Furthermore, He is the source of safety, granting ultimate peace and security to His believing servants.
salah_usage: Renew your shahadah during tashahhud by remembering this Name.
dua_usage: Call Ya Al-Mu'min when asking Allah to guard hearts from fear and hypocrisy.
dhikr_usage: Zikir Ya Al-Mu'min ketika kegusaran muncul supaya jiwa kembali tenteram.
when_to_invoke: Call upon it whenever you fear for your iman or safety.
ghazali_insight: Al-Mu'min is the Faithful One to whom security and safety are ascribed, because He conveys the means to attain them and blocks the paths of dangers. Security and safety are only conceivable in locations of fear, and the absolute Faithful One is God, from whose direction alone true security emanates. A person's share in this attribute lies in all creatures being safe from them.
description_en: Al-Mu'min instills iman, grants security against fear, and guarantees that His promises never fail the believers.
description_ms: Al-Mu'min menanam iman, memberi keselamatan daripada ketakutan, dan memastikan janji-Nya tidak mengecewakan orang beriman.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.29; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 471 / page_id 10178).
al_jalil_commentary: Faith in this Name cultivates love for Allah, in whose refuge the fearful find safety and in whose worship the believer finds tranquility. It also leads to having a sound heart towards God's servants, securing them from one's aggression and harm, embodying the prophetic description of a believer as one whom people trust with their lives and property.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Mu'min when anxiety arises so that the soul returns to tranquility.
dhikr_usage_ms: Zikir Ya Al-Mu'min ketika kegusaran muncul supaya jiwa kembali tenteram.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Hashr 59:23, al-Biqa'i explains that 'Al-Mu'min' (The Granter of Security) follows 'As-Salaam' because every real safety and sanctuary—inward and outward—originates solely from Allah, who creates the means of security and averts fear.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 471 / page_id 10178)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَٰمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْجَبَّارُ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Tinggi lagi Maha Luhur
proof_text: …the All-Great, the Exalted.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Muta'aalee commits a Muslim to affirming it as an independent Name proven in Surah Ar-Ra'd 13:9, distinct in form and meaning from Al-'Aliyy and Al-A'laa even though all three share the attribute of divine highness. It requires believing that Allah is eternally exalted above the fabrications of slanderers, the doubts of the bewildered, and the heresy of deviants, while encompassing every category of absolute highness—highness of essence, of status and attributes, and of conquering power—such that denying any aspect of His highness is grave misguidance. As Dr. Shahadah explains, the meaning of this Name and its attribute of highness is clear and unambiguous (muhkam), whereas the true modality (kayfiyyah) of His attributes is known only to Allah.
dua_usage: Exalt Him above any defect or human limitation
when_to_invoke: Exalt Him above any defect or human limitation
ghazali_insight: Al-Muta'ali, the Exalted, has the same meaning as Al-'Ali (the High), indicating that His rank is above all other ranks. The form of the name Al-Muta'ali is more intensified, signifying ultimate exaltation.
description_en: In Lisan al-'Arab, Al-Azhari defines Al-Muta'aalee as the One exalted above the fabrications of slanderers and transcendent above the doubts and whisperings of the bewildered. Established in Surah Ar-Ra'd 13:9, this distinct morphological form sets Al-Muta'aalee apart from Al-'Aliyy and Al-A'laa by declaring Allah eternally elevated above the deviance of heretics and greater than any praise offered to Him.
description_ms: Dalam Lisan al-'Arab, Al-Azhari menjelaskan bahawa Al-Muta'aalee ialah Tuhan yang Maha Suci daripada tuduhan palsu para pendusta serta lintasan keraguan orang yang bingung. Nama yang sabit dalam Surah Ar-Ra'd 13:9 ini mempunyai bentuk lafaz tersendiri yang membezakannya daripada Al-'Aliyy dan Al-A'laa kerana menegaskan ketinggian Allah melampaui kesesatan golongan mulhid serta mengatasi segala pujian.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.39; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, p. 4821).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Muta'aalee, The Supremely Exalted, is discussed alongside Al-'Aliyy, sharing the meaning of transcendence over creation in essence, power, and rank. Believing in this name instills humility and warns against becoming arrogant or oppressive. It reminds the servant that God is exalted above all, and no matter how high one may seem, they are always under the authority of the One who is higher.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Al-Biqa'i notes why Ar-Ra'd 13:9 uses the emphatic 'tafa'ul' form 'Al-Muta'aalee' rather than the simpler 'Al-'Aliyy': it stresses that none can approach the zenith of Allah's loftiness in His essence, attributes, or acts.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, p. 4821)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْكَبِيرُ ٱلْمُتَعَالِ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Grand, the Exalted.

english_meaning: The One Supreme in Glory, The justly and rightfully proud
proof_text: …The Almighty, the Compeller, the Supremely Great.
aqeedah_belief: He is the Supreme Being to whom supremacy belongs. He is exalted far above the attributes of His creation and destroys the tyrants among them. No one should be called by this name except Allah, Exalted and Glorified be He.
salah_usage: Visualise all creation bowing with you when mentioning this majestic Name.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Mutakabbir to humble the ego whenever praise comes your way.
dhikr_usage: Bertasbih dengan Ya Al-Mutakabbir selepas solat agar kemuliaan kembali kepada-Nya.
when_to_invoke: Reach for it whenever you must humble yourself before Allah's greatness.
ghazali_insight: Al-Mutakabbir is the Proud One who regards everything as unworthy of consideration in relation to Himself, seeing greatness and majesty only in regard to Himself. He looks upon others as a king looks upon his servants, an assessment that is absolutely inconceivable of anyone but God. The proud among men is the knower who despises every worldly passion.
description_en: Al-Mutakabbir possesses absolute greatness; any pride for creation must dissolve in the face of His majesty.
description_ms: Al-Mutakabbir memiliki keagungan mutlak; segala rasa bangga makhluk mesti luluh di hadapan kebesaran-Nya.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.33; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, pp. 473-474 / page_id 10180).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Mutakabbir is the truly Great, who is transcendent above all flaws and the arrogance of His creation. Faith in His supreme greatness instills profound humility in the believer's heart. This leads them to readily submit to the truth that comes from God and to treat fellow believers with modesty, avoiding injustice and looking down upon them.
dhikr_usage_en: Glorify with Ya Al-Mutakabbir after prayer so that all grandeur is attributed back to Him.
dhikr_usage_ms: Bertasbih dengan Ya Al-Mutakabbir selepas solat agar kemuliaan kembali kepada-Nya.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Hashr 59:23, al-Biqa'i pairs 'Al-Mutakabbir' with 'Al-Jabbaar': Allah alone holds supreme outward majesty, humbling tyrants and manifesting creation's total dependence on Him while He needs nothing.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, pp. 473-474 / page_id 10180)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَٰمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْجَبَّارُ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.

proof_text: Truly, Allah is the Lord of power, the All-Strong.
aqeedah_belief: He is the possessor of the ultimate strength and ability, and who endures neither hardship, nor weariness.
salah_usage: Lengthen qiyam and feel supported by the One who can never be overcome.
dua_usage: Invoke Ya Al-Matin when asking for courage to defend the truth.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Matin pada awal pagi supaya ketegasan bersandar kepada kudrat Allah.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it during you require strength to stand upon the truth.
ghazali_insight: Al-Matin represents the Firm One, indicating an intensification of strength. While strength indicates perfect power, God is the Firm One insofar as He has intense strength. He possesses the utmost power, is perfect in it, and maintains absolute firmness in all His actions and decrees.
description_en: Al-Matin reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Matin mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.59; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 18, p. 482 / page_id 9630).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the One of extreme and unwavering strength, whose power is unbreakable and who is never touched by fatigue in His actions. As with Al-Qawiyy, this understanding instills complete reliance on Allah, as His power and ability are limitless, particularly in His capacity as the Sustainer (Ar-Razzaq) for all creation.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Matin in the early morning so that resolve is anchored in the power of Allah.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Matin pada awal pagi supaya ketegasan bersandar kepada kudrat Allah.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Closing Adh-Dhariyat 51:58, al-Biqa'i notes that 'Al-Mateen' (The Steadfast/Firm) affirms Allah's power is unrelenting and never weakens, guaranteeing both His uninterrupted provision and His decisive retribution against wrongdoers.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 18, p. 482 / page_id 9630)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.

proof_text: Indeed, my Lord is Ever Near, ready to answer.
aqeedah_belief: Allah favourably responds to the supplications and requests of His slaves. He answers their supplications and grants their requests.
salah_usage: Let this Name soften the heart before takbir so your salah flows with compassion.
dua_usage: Call upon Al-Mujib when pleading for forgiveness for yourself, family, and the ummah.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Mujib dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.
when_to_invoke: Reach for this Name whenever you seek Allah's rahmah after shortcomings.
ghazali_insight: Al-Mujeeb is the one who responds to the requests of those who ask, the call of those who call on Him, and the plight of the poor, even granting favors before the entreaty. A man's share is to be responsive to his Lord's commands and to assist every beggar who asks of him, if able.
description_en: Al-Mujib reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Mujib mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.127; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 9, p. 319 / page_id 4398).
al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Al-Mujeeb (The Responder) is a source of comfort, as demonstrated by His response to the prophets. However, a delayed response to a believer's prayer is also a test of patience from which lessons should be learned. The delay may be a trial, a protection from a harmful outcome, or a means by which Allah keeps the servant at the door of supplication and reliance.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Mujib during morning and evening dhikr while expressing gratitude for countless blessings.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Mujib dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Hud 11:61, al-Biqa'i notes that 'Al-Mujeeb' (The Responsive) reassures those who sincerely turn to Allah in repentance that He answers every caller directly—unlike false idols—without needing distance, motion, or intermediaries.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 9, p. 319 / page_id 4398)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: ۞ وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَٰلِحًۭا ۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ ۖ هُوَ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى قَرِيبٌۭ مُّجِيبٌۭ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And to Thamud [We sent] their brother Salih. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. He has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive."

english_meaning: The One Perfect in Glory and Honour
proof_text: He is Praiseworthy, All-Glorious.
aqeedah_belief: He has all perfect attributes and whatever is related to them. He is the Greatest and all His actions are great. His generosity is boundless, and everyone and everything glorify Him because of His greatness.
salah_usage: Visualise all creation bowing with you when mentioning this majestic Name.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Majeed to humble the ego whenever praise comes your way.
dhikr_usage: Bertasbih dengan Ya Al-Majeed selepas solat agar kemuliaan kembali kepada-Nya.
when_to_invoke: Reach for it whenever you must humble yourself before Allah's greatness.
ghazali_insight: Al-Majid represents the Magnificent, carrying the same fundamental meaning as the All-Glorious, but in a paradigm that is even more emphatic. It signifies the one who is noble in essence, beautiful in actions, and bountiful in gifts and favors. This immense perfection emphasizes that true majesty flows exclusively from His divine nature.
description_en: Al-Majeed reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Majeed mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.53; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 9, p. 333 / page_id 4413).
al_jalil_commentary: Shaykh al-Jalil explains that Al-Majeed denotes the One possessing vast generosity, abundant perfect attributes, and continuous noble actions. The essence of His glory entails the believer's acknowledgment of His absolute sovereignty and ultimate judgment. Glorifying Him requires the heart to be filled with deep veneration, complete submission, and recognition of His boundless perfection.
dhikr_usage_en: Glorify with Ya Al-Majeed after prayer so that all glory is attributed back to Him.
dhikr_usage_ms: Bertasbih dengan Ya Al-Majeed selepas solat agar kemuliaan kembali kepada-Nya.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Hud 11:73, al-Biqa'i explains that 'Al-Majeed' (The Most Glorious) grounds the abundant blessings upon Ibrahim's (AS) household: His boundless nobility and generosity naturally call forth praise ('Hameed Majeed').
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 9, p. 333 / page_id 4413)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ رَحْمَتُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَٰتُهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَمِيدٌۭ مَّجِيدٌۭ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: They said, "Are you amazed at the decree of Allah? May the mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, people of the house. Indeed, He is Praiseworthy and Honorable."

proof_text: …And Allah encompasses the unbelievers.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Muheet—a Name occurring eight times in the Qur'an, including Surah Al-Baqarah 2:19, Surah Aal-'Imran 3:120, Surah An-Nisa 4:126, and Surah Al-Buruj 85:20—commits a Muslim to affirming that Allah encompasses all things in knowledge, power, judgment, wisdom, mercy, and subjugation, enumerating everything without ever forgetting. As Ibn al-Qayyim explains, reason, innate nature, and all divine scriptures establish that Allah is high above His creation and established over His Throne above the heavens while encompassing the entire universe. Furthermore, as Al-Zajjaji and the exegetes explain regarding Surah At-Talaq 65:12 and Surah Al-Baqarah 2:19, nothing exits Allah's knowledge of its true reality or resists His will, and the disbelievers can neither frustrate Him nor escape His punishment.
dua_usage: Know there is no escape from Him except to Him.
when_to_invoke: You reach for Al-Muheet when confronting the plots and strength of hostile enemies after taking practical means to repel their harm, when tempted by your own power to wrong others, or when guarding every passing thought, word, glance, and step under His all-encompassing watch.
description_en: As Al-Tabari, Al-Zajjaji, Al-Khattabi, and As-Sa'di explain, Al-Muheet is the One who encompasses all creation in His knowledge, power, mercy, wisdom, and subjugation, enclosing all sides of existence so that nothing exits His will or escapes His grasp. This Name matters because realizing that nothing subtle or great is outside Allah's encompassing knowledge and power instills watchfulness over every passing thought, word, glance, and step, prevents a person from abusing their own strength to wrong others, and removes fear of enemies' plots.
description_ms: Menurut Al-Tabari, Al-Zajjaji, Al-Khattabi, dan As-Sa'di, Al-Muheet bermaksud Tuhan yang meliputi seluruh makhluk dengan ilmu, kekuasaan, rahmat, hikmah, dan penguasaan-Nya sehingga tiada sesuatu pun yang terlepas daripada kehendak atau genggaman-Nya. Nama ini penting kerana kesedaran bahawa tiada perkara kecil atau besar yang tersembunyi daripada liputan Allah melahirkan sifat malu dalam setiap lintasan hati, tutur kata, pandangan, dan langkah, menghalang seseorang daripada menzalimi orang lain, serta menghilangkan rasa takut terhadap tipu daya musuh.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.129; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 1, p. 123 / page_id 110).
al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Allah as Al-Muheet (The Encompassing) instills fear, modesty, and mindfulness in every thought, word, and step, because His knowledge encompasses all things. It also fosters fear of wronging others, as His power encompasses everything and none can escape Him. For the believer facing enemies, it brings reassurance and diminishes their perceived strength, as Allah encompasses them and their plots.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Baqarah 2:19, al-Biqa'i explains that 'Al-Muheet' (The All-Encompassing) shows Allah completely surrounds the disbelievers with His power and knowledge—no caution or escape can shield them from His decree.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 1, p. 123 / page_id 110)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: أَوْ كَصَيِّبٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فِيهِ ظُلُمَٰتٌۭ وَرَعْدٌۭ وَبَرْقٌۭ يَجْعَلُونَ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِم مِّنَ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقِ حَذَرَ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ مُحِيطٌۢ بِٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Or [it is] like a rainstorm from the sky within which is darkness, thunder and lightning. They put their fingers in their ears against the thunderclaps in dread of death. But Allah is encompassing of the disbelievers.

proof_text: He is Allah, the Creator, the Originator, the Fashioner.
aqeedah_belief: Allah brings into existence whatever He wills in the manner He wills it. He shapes and fashions His creatures in different forms and shapes in His infinite wisdom.
salah_usage: Praise Allah for your limbs and senses each time you enter sujud.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Musawwir when reflecting on Allah's workmanship in yourself and others.
dhikr_usage: Zikirkan Ya Al-Musawwir ketika menyaksikan alam agar syukur terhadap ciptaan bertambah.
when_to_invoke: Call it whenever you ponder Allah's design in creation and self.
ghazali_insight: Al-Musawwir is the Fashioner who arranges the forms of invented things in the finest way. While creation requires planning and origination, the Fashioner is responsible for organizing the ultimate forms and features of what has been brought into existence. God Himself is the planner, originator, and decorator of all creation.
description_en: Al-Musawwir assigns unique forms, talents, and identities—none accidental, all purposeful.
description_ms: Al-Musawwir menetapkan rupa, bakat, dan identiti yang unik—tiada yang kebetulan, semuanya penuh tujuan.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.73; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 478 / page_id 10185).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the Fashioner who shapes and forms each of His creations with a unique and distinct image by which it is known. This inspires gratitude for being created in the best of forms and warns against attempting to imitate this divine act by making images of living beings.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Musawwir when observing nature so that gratitude for creation deepens.
dhikr_usage_ms: Zikirkan Ya Al-Musawwir ketika menyaksikan alam agar syukur terhadap ciptaan bertambah.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Completing the triad in Al-Hashr 59:24 after 'Al-Khaaliq' (planning) and 'Al-Baari'' (bringing forth), al-Biqa'i explains that 'Al-Musawwir' (The Fashioner) marks the final perfection of form and proportion, placing every detail in its rightful place.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 478 / page_id 10185)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُ ٱلْبَارِئُ ٱلْمُصَوِّرُ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ يُسَبِّحُ لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

proof_text: Say, 'He is able to send punishment upon you from above you or from beneath your feet.'
aqeedah_belief: Allah possesses ultimate and perfect ability over all things, represented by His names Al-Qaadir, Al-Qadeer, and Al-Muqtadir. While Al-Qaadir denotes His capability and Al-Qadeer emphasizes its completeness, Al-Muqtadir is the most intensive form, stressing His supreme, invincible power. Nothing can frustrate His decree.
salah_usage: Lengthen qiyam and feel supported by the One who can never be overcome.
dua_usage: Invoke Ya Al-Muqtadir when asking for courage to defend the truth.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Muqtadir pada awal pagi supaya ketegasan bersandar kepada kudrat Allah.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it during you require strength to stand upon the truth.
ghazali_insight: Al-Muqtadir is the All-Determiner, an even more emphatic expression of possessing absolute power than the All-Powerful. This power represents the intention by which a thing comes into existence according to a determinate plan of will and knowledge. He executes His will entirely on His own without needing assistance from anyone else.
description_en: Al-Muqtadir reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Muqtadir mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.65; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 12, p. 68 / page_id 5698).
al_jalil_commentary: This is the most emphatic form of power, indicating one whose ability is absolute and who is never frustrated or rendered incapable. This inspires sincere reliance upon Him, as only the One with such power is worthy of it, and it warns the believer against oppression, reminding them of God's perfect ability to enact justice.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Muqtadir in the early morning so that resolve is anchored in the power of Allah.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Muqtadir pada awal pagi supaya ketegasan bersandar kepada kudrat Allah.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Closing the parable of worldly life in Al-Kahf 18:45, al-Biqa'i notes that 'Al-Muqtadir' (The Omnipotent) affirms Allah's absolute, enduring power over creating, dismantling, and recreating the world.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 12, p. 68 / page_id 5698)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا كَمَآءٍ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَٱخْتَلَطَ بِهِۦ نَبَاتُ ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَصْبَحَ هَشِيمًۭا تَذْرُوهُ ٱلرِّيَٰحُ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرًا
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And present to them the example of the life of this world, [its being] like rain which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it and [then] it becomes dry remnants, scattered by the winds. And Allah is ever, over all things, Perfect in Ability.

proof_text: Allah has power over everything.
aqeedah_belief: He has power over all things and is the One who provides sustenance. Allah decrees the needs of His creation, in His immense knowledge, and then provides them with whatever they need according to His will and thus preserves them with whatever He grants them.
salah_usage: Raise your hands after salah accepting whatever provision Allah decrees.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Muqit when asking Allah to sustain your family and community with halal rizq.
dhikr_usage: Ingatlah Ya Al-Muqit ketika menyusun urusan harian supaya hati bergantung kepada Pemberi rezeki.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you feel uncertain about rizq and resources.
ghazali_insight: Al-Muqeet is the creator of nutriments who delivers them to bodies as food and to hearts as knowledge, similar to the Provider (al-Razzaq) but more specific to sustenance. It can also mean the one who takes things over, signifying a combination of power and knowledge.
description_en: Al-Muqit reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Muqit mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.137; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 5, p. 350 / page_id 2227).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil explains that one meaning of Al-Muqeet (The Sustainer) relates to providing sustenance. An effect of this belief is to turn to Allah alone for one's livelihood and especially for the 'sustenance of the hearts' (qūt al-qulūb). This includes spiritual nourishment like faith, guidance, sincerity, and humility, which is the true sustenance; if a person attains it, they are not harmed by what they miss of bodily nourishment.
dhikr_usage_en: Remember Ya Al-Muqit when organizing daily affairs so that the heart relies upon the Provider of sustenance.
dhikr_usage_ms: Ingatlah Ya Al-Muqit ketika menyusun urusan harian supaya hati bergantung kepada Pemberi rezeki.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In An-Nisa 4:85 on intercession, al-Biqa'i explains that 'Al-Muqeet' (The Sustainer/Overseer) means Allah guards, witnesses, and precisely calculates every soul's share—delivering the exact reward or consequence it earned.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 5, p. 350 / page_id 2227)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: مَّن يَشْفَعْ شَفَٰعَةً حَسَنَةًۭ يَكُن لَّهُۥ نَصِيبٌۭ مِّنْهَا ۖ وَمَن يَشْفَعْ شَفَٰعَةًۭ سَيِّئَةًۭ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كِفْلٌۭ مِّنْهَا ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مُّقِيتًۭا
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Whoever intercedes for a good cause will have a reward therefrom; and whoever intercedes for an evil cause will have a burden therefrom. And ever is Allah, over all things, a Keeper.

proof_text: …The Sovereign Lord (Al-Malik) the Holy One...
aqeedah_belief: He is the absolute King who holds the heavens and the earth in His grip, possessing true and supreme dominion over all affairs of Lordship. No kingship exists above His, and He disposes of all creation perfectly without any resistance. His absolute kingship necessitates His perfect power and authority to command, reward, and punish.
salah_usage: Enter rukuk recognising no authority compares to the Lord of the Throne.
dua_usage: Whisper Ya Al-Malik when submitting your affairs to Allah's ruling.
dhikr_usage: Zikirkan Ya Al-Malik ketika memohon agar hati tunduk kepada Raja segala makhluk.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you need to remember all dominion belongs to Allah.
ghazali_insight: Al-Malik is the absolute King who, in His essence and attributes, has no need of any existing thing, while every existing thing needs Him. Nothing can dispense with Him concerning its essence, attributes, existence, or survival. A king among people is one who rules his own heart, appetites, and anger, relying on God alone.
description_en: Al-Malik owns and governs every atom; His sovereignty is unchallengeable and He disposes affairs exactly as He wills.
description_ms: Al-Malik memiliki dan mentadbir setiap zarah; kekuasaan-Nya mutlak dan semua urusan berlaku menurut kehendak-Nya.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.49; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 468 / page_id 10175).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Malik is the Absolute King and true Sovereign to whom all dominion belongs. Recognizing this reality leads the believer to direct all forms of worship—love, fear, and hope—to Him alone, as only the true King is worthy of it. It also means submitting to His right to rule through His divine law, rejecting all other sources of judgment.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Malik when supplicating so that the heart humbles itself before the Sovereign of all creation.
dhikr_usage_ms: Zikirkan Ya Al-Malik ketika memohon agar hati tunduk kepada Raja segala makhluk.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Opening the list of Names in Al-Hashr 59:23 after 'There is no deity except Him,' al-Biqa'i explains that 'Al-Malik' (The Sovereign) declares Allah the sole true King—free of any need, whose will comes to pass instantly without reliance on others.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 468 / page_id 10175)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَٰمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْجَبَّارُ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.

bahasa_meaning: Raja Yang Maha Berkuasa lagi Maha Agung
proof_text: …in the presence of a Sovereign (Al-Maleek) who is Perfect in Ability.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Maleek, established in Surah Al-Qamar 54:54-55, commits a Muslim to affirming that true and absolute dominion over the heavens and the earth belongs solely to Allah, above whom there is no sovereign and whose disposal over creation faces no resistance, as Ibn Jarir al-Tabari and Ibn Kathir explain. As Ibn al-Qayyim states, true sovereignty necessitates all attributes of perfection—including life, knowledge, power, will, hearing, sight, speech, and voluntary action—meaning that those who strip Allah of His attributes render His creatures more complete than the Creator. It further requires believing that Allah is established over the Throne of His dominion, purposefully governing His servants by sending messengers, revealing scriptures, giving and withholding, honoring and abasing, and rewarding and punishing in perfect wisdom and justice while possessing treasuries that never diminish through giving.
dua_usage: The creature cannot be conceived of as being king absolutely, for he cannot dispense with everything; indeed he God the most high, and would be even if he were able to dispense with all but Him. will
when_to_invoke: The creature cannot be conceived of as being king absolutely, for he cannot dispense with everything; indeed he God the most high, and would be even if he were able to dispense with all but Him. will always be needy with regard to Nor can one conceive of a cre
ghazali_insight: The name Al-Malik designates the King who is entirely independent in His essence and attributes, having no need of any existing thing. Conversely, every existing thing completely depends on Him for its existence and survival. True earthly kingship is attained only when a person masters their own soul and relies exclusively on God.
description_en: Appearing once in the Qur'an in Surah Al-Qamar 54:54-55 paired with Al-Muqtadir, the Name Al-Maleek points to Allah's absolute and glorious sovereignty as the Possessor of dominion who holds exclusive power of disposal over all creation. It matters because it contrasts Allah's true, self-sustaining kingship and inexhaustible treasuries with the temporary, borrowed rule of worldly monarchs who rely on guards and whose wealth diminishes when they spend.
description_ms: Nama Al-Maleek disebut sekali dalam al-Quran pada Surah Al-Qamar 54:54-55 bersama nama Al-Muqtadir, dan menunjukkan kedaulatan Allah yang mutlak lagi agung sebagai Pemilik kekuasaan yang mengurus seluruh makhluk secara tunggal. Nama ini penting kerana membezakan pemerintahan Allah yang hakiki serta perbendaharaan-Nya yang tidak pernah berkurang daripada kekuasaan raja-raja dunia yang bersifat pinjaman, memerlukan pengawal, dan susut apabila dibelanjakan.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.49; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 140 / page_id 9799).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Maleek is the Omnipotent Sovereign, an intensive form of Al-Malik, denoting perfect and absolute power and dominion.
