Believing in Him as the ultimate Sovereign frees the heart from fearing or depending on created beings. This fosters complete reliance on the One who holds absolute power and control over everything that exists.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Qamar 54:55 ('in the presence of a Sovereign, Omnipotent King'), al-Biqa'i links 'Maleek Muqtadir' directly into the opening of Surah Ar-Rahman: as if one asks who this mighty King is, the next surah answers 'Ar-Rahman'—combining absolute sovereignty with all-embracing mercy.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 140 / page_id 9799)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.

english_meaning: The Patron Lord or the Master and Supporter
bahasa_meaning: Tuan Yang Maha Menguasai dan Pelindung
proof_text: Allah is your Protector — an excellent Protector and an excellent Helper!
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Mawlaa commits a Muslim to affirming that Allah is the Master, Creator, and true Deity of all creatures—believers and disbelievers alike—while reserving His special patronage of love, guidance, and victory exclusively for the pious believers. As Ash-Shanqiti explains in reconciling Surah Al-An'am 6:62 and Surah Yunus 10:30 with Surah Muhammad 47:11, Allah is the Mawlaa of disbelievers only in the sense that He owns them and disposes of them as He wills, whereas they have no Mawlaa to aid or protect them. This belief also requires singling Allah out for worship, allying with and loving His believing servants, disavowing His enemies, and holding certainty that disbelievers will ultimately perish because their bond with Allah is severed.
dua_usage: As Ibn Jarir at-Tabari explains regarding the supplication at the end of Surah Al-Baqarah 2:286, believers call upon Al-Mawlaa by affirming their faith and obedience to His commands and prohibitions as His party, then asking Him by His exclusive patronage to grant them victory over those who deny His oneness, worship false deities, and obey Satan.
when_to_invoke: A believer reaches for Al-Mawlaa when tempted to seek protection from disbelievers or when facing enemies who plot ruin and harbor malice, holding fast instead to Allah alone as Patron and Master, as Ibn Jarir at-Tabari explains regarding Surah Aal 'Imran 3:150.
description_en: Al-Mawlaa means the Patron Lord and Master, derived on the maf'al pattern from taking charge of an affair, encompassing both His universal ownership over all creation and His exclusive patronage of love, enabling grace, and victory for the believers. Understanding this dual meaning matters because it calls every creature to worship Him alone as their rightful Sovereign while assuring obedient believers of His special support against those severed from Him.
description_ms: Al-Mawlaa bermaksud Tuan dan Pelindung yang menguasai urusan makhluk. Nama ini merangkumi pemilikan mutlak Allah ke atas seluruh ciptaan serta perlindungan khas melalui kasih sayang, taufik, dan pertolongan-Nya untuk orang beriman. Memahami dua makna ini penting kerana ia menuntut setiap makhluk menyembah-Nya semata-mata sebagai Tuan yang sebenar sambil meyakinkan orang yang taat akan sokongan khas-Nya terhadap golongan yang terputus hubungan daripada-Nya.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.79; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 13, p. 104 / page_id 6327).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the Master and Protector; His mastership is general over all creation, but His protective support is special for the believers. Knowing Allah is their Mawla gives believers confidence and certainty in His ultimate victory for them, as they are connected to Him while the disbelievers have no true protector.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Hajj 22:78, after commanding believers to 'hold fast to Allah,' al-Biqa'i explains why 'He is your Mawlaa—excellent is the Mawlaa!' follows as the reason: He alone takes full charge of your affairs, and whoever Allah takes charge of, He suffices in every concern.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 13, p. 104 / page_id 6327)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَجَٰهِدُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦ ۚ هُوَ ٱجْتَبَىٰكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍۢ ۚ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ هُوَ سَمَّىٰكُمُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ مِن قَبْلُ وَفِى هَٰذَا لِيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ ۚ فَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱعْتَصِمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And strive for Allah with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [It is] the religion of your father, Abraham. Allah named you "Muslims" before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. So establish prayer and give zakah and hold fast to Allah. He is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.

english_meaning: The Trustworthy and Ever Watchful Witness
proof_text: …The Source of Peace, the Granter of Security, the Ever Watchful...
aqeedah_belief: He is the One who watches over His creatures and is fully aware of all their actions, sustenance and the terms He has fixed for them in this life. He knows all their affairs, has power over all of them, has a record of everyone's deeds and is aware of them and encompasses them from all sides.
salah_usage: Confess hidden faults in sujud knowing Allah already sees them.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Muhaymin when entrusting your loved ones to Allah's protection.
dhikr_usage: Hadamkan Ya Al-Muhaymin sewaktu bermuhasabah agar perbuatan sentiasa diperhatikan-Nya.
when_to_invoke: Use it while you need to remember Allah witnesses every deed.
ghazali_insight: Al-Muhaymin is the Guardian who tends to His creatures regarding their actions, their sustenance, and the time of their death. He exercises this complete command through His cognizance, His possession, and His absolute protection. A servant shares in this attribute by carefully supervising their own heart and reforming their inner states.
description_en: Al-Muhaymin watches, protects, and records everything with perfect care; He safeguards believers' journeys and intentions.
description_ms: Al-Muhaymin memerhati, melindung dan merekod segala sesuatu dengan penjagaan sempurna; Dia memelihara perjalanan serta niat hamba.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.75; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 471 / page_id 10178).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the Guardian who watches over His creation, witnessing their deeds, providing for them, and determining their lifespans. Faith in this name fosters constant mindfulness (muraqabah) of Allah in secret and public, leading to fear and glorification of Him, as nothing is hidden from His watch.
dhikr_usage_en: Internalize Ya Al-Muhaymin during self-reflection so that deeds are performed with mindfulness of His watchful gaze.
dhikr_usage_ms: Hadamkan Ya Al-Muhaymin sewaktu bermuhasabah agar perbuatan sentiasa diperhatikan-Nya.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Hashr 59:23, al-Biqa'i explains that 'Al-Muhaymin' (The Guardian/Overseer) conveys all-encompassing, experiential oversight of both outward and inward realities—maintaining every creature's sustenance, deeds, and lifespan with nothing hidden.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 19, p. 471 / page_id 10178)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَٰمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْجَبَّارُ ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: He is Allah, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.

proof_text: …and He is the best of helpers.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in An-Naseer commits a Muslim to certainty that none can overcome whomever Allah helps and none can aid whomever He forsakes (Surah Aal 'Imran 3:160), and that true divine help belongs only to the angels and the believers, whereas a disbeliever who prevails temporarily is merely given mastery as a trial rather than helped by Allah (Surah An-Nisa 4:90). As Ibn Jarir at-Tabari explains regarding Surah Ghafir 40:51, Allah's promise to grant victory to His messengers and believers in this world is fulfilled either by giving them triumph during their lives, saving them while destroying their enemies, or avenging them against their killers after their deaths. As Al-Jalil cites from Sayyid Qutb, any delay in victory is for divine wisdom—such as purifying the believers' struggle solely for Allah's word (Sahih al-Bukhari 123; Sahih Muslim 1904) or exposing falsehood completely—before Allah's inevitable triumph arrives.
dua_usage: As Al-Jalil explains regarding the Prophetic supplications in Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3474 (graded hasan sahih by at-Tirmidhi) and Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3508 (graded hasan gharib by at-Tirmidhi) as well as the prayer of the devout in Surah Aal 'Imran 3:146-147, one calls upon An-Naseer by disavowing one's own power and strength and asking Him for steadfastness and victory over evil and those who transgress.
when_to_invoke: As Al-Jalil explains, a servant reaches for An-Naseer in every blink of an eye when needing Allah's victory and aid against one's own base desires, against devils from mankind and jinn, against the trials of doubts and temptations, and against disbelieving enemies and transgressors.
description_en: An-Naseer means the Helper who aids His prophets and believing servants against their enemies and exacts retribution from those who oppose them. As As-Sa'di explains regarding Surah An-Nisa 4:45, while Al-Waliyy brings about good in His servants' affairs, An-Naseer specifically removes evil by warning believers of their enemies' plots and granting them victory over them.
description_ms: An-Naseer bermaksud Yang Maha Penolong yang membantu para nabi dan hamba-Nya yang beriman menghadapi musuh serta membalas golongan yang menentang mereka. Seperti yang dijelaskan oleh As-Sa'di tentang Surah An-Nisa 4:45, jika Al-Waliyy mendatangkan kebaikan dalam urusan hamba-Nya, An-Naseer pula menghapuskan kejahatan dengan memperingatkan orang beriman tentang tipu daya musuh dan memberikan kemenangan ke atas mereka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.81; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 13, p. 104 / page_id 6327).
al_jalil_commentary: Shaykh al-Jalil explains that An-Naseer is the ultimate Helper who grants true victory to His allies against their enemies. A primary fruit of believing in this Name is developing unwavering trust in Allah's divine support for the believers. Consequently, the believer remains fearless in the face of opposition, combining practical efforts with complete reliance on Him alone.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Paired with Al-Mawlaa in Al-Hajj 22:78 ('and excellent is An-Naseer!'), al-Biqa'i notes that Allah's guardianship guarantees victory: He grants triumph over every adversary so believers can establish the religion openly, and whom He aids cannot be overcome.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 13, p. 104 / page_id 6327)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَجَٰهِدُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦ ۚ هُوَ ٱجْتَبَىٰكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍۢ ۚ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ هُوَ سَمَّىٰكُمُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ مِن قَبْلُ وَفِى هَٰذَا لِيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ ۚ فَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱعْتَصِمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And strive for Allah with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [It is] the religion of your father, Abraham. Allah named you "Muslims" before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. So establish prayer and give zakah and hold fast to Allah. He is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.

proof_text: He is the One, the Supreme and Irresistible.
aqeedah_belief: He is, and has always been, one, without anyone else with Him. He is unique and there is no one like Him in His being, just as He is unique in His attributes, actions and Lordship. He is the only One who deserves to be worshipped.
salah_usage: Recite Surah Al-Ikhlas daily so focus remains on Allah alone.
dua_usage: Ask Ya Al-Wahid to remove distractions that compete with worship.
dhikr_usage: Tasbihkan Ya Al-Wahid agar setiap perancangan kembali kepada tujuan Ilahi.
when_to_invoke: Use it whenever you focus worship solely on Allah.
ghazali_insight: Al-Wahid is the Unique One who can neither be divided nor duplicated. He is one in the sense that it is impossible for His essence to be arranged into parts, much like a point has no parts. Furthermore, He has no equal, standing as the absolute and eternal unity without any conceivable partner.
description_en: Al-Wahid reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Wahid mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.9; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 10, p. 290 / page_id 4821).
al_jalil_commentary: Acknowledging Allah as "The One" brings tranquility to the believer's heart, as it knows there is only a single source for life, strength, and provision. This understanding unifies one's focus and effort, providing a clear and steady path through life without the turmoil of divided loyalties.
dhikr_usage_en: Glorify with Ya Al-Wahid so that every plan aligns with divine purpose.
dhikr_usage_ms: Tasbihkan Ya Al-Wahid agar setiap perancangan kembali kepada tujuan Ilahi.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Ar-Ra'd 13:16, al-Biqa'i explains why 'Al-Waahid' (The One) is paired with 'Al-Qahhaar': Allah's sole Lordship over creation and His irresistible dominance over all things prove His absolute oneness without partner.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 10, p. 290 / page_id 4821)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ ۚ قُلْ أَفَٱتَّخَذْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ لِأَنفُسِهِمْ نَفْعًۭا وَلَا ضَرًّۭا ۚ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ أَمْ هَلْ تَسْتَوِى ٱلظُّلُمَٰتُ وَٱلنُّورُ ۗ أَمْ جَعَلُوا۟ لِلَّهِ شُرَكَآءَ خَلَقُوا۟ كَخَلْقِهِۦ فَتَشَٰبَهَ ٱلْخَلْقُ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ قُلِ ٱللَّهُ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّٰرُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Say, "Who is Lord of the heavens and earth?" Say, "Allah." Say, "Have you then taken besides Him allies not possessing [even] for themselves any benefit or any harm?" Say, "Is the blind equivalent to the seeing? Or is darkness equivalent to light? Or have they attributed to Allah partners who created like His creation so that the creation [of each] seemed similar to them?" Say, "Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, the Prevailing."

proof_text: It is We who give life and cause to die, and We are the Inheritor.
aqeedah_belief: The One who will ever remain after the creation perishes. He is the One who will repossess whatever He has granted them after their death. He is, and has always been, the owner of everything which He bequeaths to whomever He wills and gives to whomever He likes.
salah_usage: Reflect on this Name during fajr to accept Allah's control of every season.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Warith when your timeline shifts so you submit to His wisdom.
dhikr_usage: Ucap Ya Al-Warith setiap kali jadual berubah agar hati tenang dengan takdir-Nya.
when_to_invoke: Use it whenever you reflect on beginnings and endings Allah controls.
ghazali_insight: Al-Warith is the Inheritor to whom all possessions return after their temporary possessors disappear. He is the one who endures eternally after the creation vanishes, as all things inevitably return to Him as their final end. True spiritual perception recognizes that absolute possession belongs to God alone at every moment.
description_en: Al-Warith reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Warith mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.21; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 11, p. 40 / page_id 5045).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the One who remains after all creation has passed away, inheriting everything. This belief prevents the believer from being deceived by the fleeting nature of the world and motivates them to seek the eternal inheritance of Paradise by doing good deeds.
dhikr_usage_en: Say Ya Al-Warith whenever plans change so that the heart remains at peace with His decree.
dhikr_usage_ms: Ucap Ya Al-Warith setiap kali jadual berubah agar hati tenang dengan takdir-Nya.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Hijr 15:23, al-Biqa'i notes that 'We are the Inheritors (Al-Waarithoon)' declares Allah's permanence after all creation perishes—affirming His oneness and sole authority over life and death.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 11, p. 40 / page_id 5045)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.

proof_text: Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing.
aqeedah_belief: He embraces everything in mercy and knowledge, His sustenance reaches all His creation without exception and no one is capable of praising Him as much as He has praised Himself.
salah_usage: Raise your hands after salah accepting whatever provision Allah decrees.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Wasi when asking Allah to sustain your family and community with halal rizq.
dhikr_usage: Ingatlah Ya Al-Wasi ketika menyusun urusan harian supaya hati bergantung kepada Pemberi rezeki.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you feel uncertain about rizq and resources.
ghazali_insight: Al-Waasi', the Vast, derives from an expansiveness linked to knowledge when it comprehends a multitude of objects, and to charity when it extends to all. God is the absolutely vast because His knowledge has no shore and the things He can do have no end.
description_en: Al-Wasi reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Wasi mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.45; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 2, p. 124 / page_id 622).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Waasi' is the All-Encompassing, whose mercy, provision, and knowledge are without limits. Believing in this name opens a wide door of hope for the servant, especially when facing hardship or the whispers of Satan that encourage miserliness and despair. It fosters trust in Allah's endless bounty and encourages generosity, knowing that His resources are never depleted.
dhikr_usage_en: Remember Ya Al-Wasi when organizing daily affairs so that the heart relies upon the All-Encompassing Provider of sustenance.
dhikr_usage_ms: Ingatlah Ya Al-Wasi ketika menyusun urusan harian supaya hati bergantung kepada Pemberi rezeki.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Baqarah 2:115 ('Wherever you turn, there is the Face of Allah'), al-Biqa'i notes that 'Al-Waasi'' (The All-Encompassing) expresses Allah's boundless dominion and capacity, reassuring believers He encompasses and rewards sincere devotion everywhere.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 2, p. 124 / page_id 622)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَشْرِقُ وَٱلْمَغْرِبُ ۚ فَأَيْنَمَا تُوَلُّوا۟ فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And to Allah belongs the east and the west. So wherever you [might] turn, there is the Face of Allah. Indeed, Allah is all-Encompassing and Knowing.

english_meaning: The Loving One and the Beloved One
proof_text: Surely, my Lord is Most Merciful, Most Loving.
aqeedah_belief: Allah loves His prophets, messengers and obedient servants who also love him. He is the most beloved, who deserves to be loved with all our hearts and better than ourselves, better than our children, and better than everyone and everything else we love and cherish.
salah_usage: Let this Name soften the heart before takbir so your salah flows with compassion.
dua_usage: Call upon Al-Wadud when pleading for forgiveness for yourself, family, and the ummah.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Wadud dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.
when_to_invoke: Reach for this Name whenever you seek Allah's rahmah after shortcomings.
ghazali_insight: Al-Wadud is the Loving-Kind One who wishes all creatures well, bestowing favors and praises upon them from the outset. While mercy presupposes a needy recipient, His loving-kindness consists in intending honor and blessing without requiring weakness in the receiver. A person reflects this trait by desiring for others whatever they desire for themselves.
description_en: Al-Wadud reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Wadud mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.101; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 9, p. 361 / page_id 4446).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil notes that the name Al-Wadood is mentioned in conjunction with Al-Ghafoor (The Forgiving). He indicates that the reason for this pairing was discussed in the section for Al-Wadood, implying that Allah's love is connected to His forgiveness for those who turn to Him.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Wadud during morning and evening dhikr while expressing gratitude for countless blessings.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Wadud dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Hud 11:90, Shu'ayb (AS) urges his people to repent because 'my Lord is Raheem Wadood': al-Biqa'i notes that 'Al-Wadood' (The Most Loving) shows Allah does not merely forgive the repentant—He actively honors and loves them by keeping them on His pleasing path.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 9, p. 361 / page_id 4446)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى رَحِيمٌۭ وَدُودٌۭ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is Merciful and Affectionate."

proof_text: Sufficient for us is Allah, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs.
aqeedah_belief: He is the true Disposer of Affairs to whom believers fully delegate their matters, knowing He perfectly sustains and supports them. Unlike human representatives, His ultimate care and administration encompass all of existence. True believers trust completely in Him for protection, declaring Him absolutely sufficient as their guardian.
salah_usage: Let every taslim release burdens into Allah's care.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Wakil when entrusting your plans to Allah's decree.
dhikr_usage: Selitkan Ya Al-Wakil dalam zikir pagi agar hati bergantung kepada Allah sahaja.
when_to_invoke: Use it whenever you place full trust in Allah's decree.
ghazali_insight: Al-Wakeel is the one to whom matters are entrusted. God is the absolute Trustee, to whom all things are entrusted, who is fully capable of carrying them out, and in whom hearts place their trust by His very nature, not by appointment from another.
description_en: Al-Wakil reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Wakil mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.83; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Qur'an 3:173 (definite Al-Wakeel); indefinite mentions 4:81, 6:102, 12:66, 33:3, 39:62; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 5, p. 130 / page_id 1973).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the Trustee to whom all affairs are entrusted, the One who is sufficient for and manages all of creation. This inspires sincere reliance (tawakkul) on Him for all needs, both worldly and spiritual, bringing peace to the heart in the knowledge that a perfect, powerful Guardian is in control.
dhikr_usage_en: Include Ya Al-Wakil in morning dhikr so that the heart relies solely upon Allah.
dhikr_usage_ms: Selitkan Ya Al-Wakil dalam zikir pagi agar hati bergantung kepada Allah sahaja.

secondary_quran_refs.translation: And sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.
secondary_quran_refs.note: Indefinite form (wakilan); cited in Assayyid booklet p.83 and Nazm al-Durar.

secondary_quran_refs.translation: And He is Disposer of all things.
secondary_quran_refs.note: Indefinite form (wakilun); cited by Shaykh al-Jalil.

secondary_quran_refs.translation: And rely upon Allah; and sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.
secondary_quran_refs.note: Indefinite form (wakilan); cited by Shaykh al-Jalil.

secondary_quran_refs.translation: Allah is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.
secondary_quran_refs.note: Indefinite form (wakilun); cited by Shaykh al-Jalil.

secondary_quran_refs.translation: Allah, over what we say, is Witness.
secondary_quran_refs.note: Indefinite form (wakilun); cited by Shaykh al-Jalil.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Ali 'Imran 3:173 ('Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal-Wakeel'), al-Biqa'i explains why 'ni'mal-Wakeel' ('and excellent is the Disposer of affairs') is added: among earthly agents some prove blameworthy, so the verse praises Allah as the flawless Trustee to whom all matters are entrusted, recalling Ibrahim (AS) and the Prophet (SAW).
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 5, p. 130 / page_id 1973)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ قَالَ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوا۟ لَكُمْ فَٱخْشَوْهُمْ فَزَادَهُمْ إِيمَٰنًۭا وَقَالُوا۟ حَسْبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ ٱلْوَكِيلُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Those to whom hypocrites said, "Indeed, the people have gathered against you, so fear them." But it [merely] increased them in faith, and they said, "Sufficient for us is Allah, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs."

proof_text: He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Waliyy commits a Muslim to affirming that Allah manages the welfare of creation in three ranks—generally for all creatures, specifically for the believers, and most specifically for the messengers, prophets, and the truthful—while He is never the Waliyy of the disbelievers (Surah Muhammad 47:11), and on the Day of Reckoning He takes charge of the believers' reward (as Az-Zajjaj explains regarding Surah Al-Baqarah 2:257). As Ibn Jarir at-Tabari explains regarding Surah Al-A'raf 7:196 and as stated regarding Surah Yunus 10:62-63, Allah's special guardianship is attained only by those who rectify their deeds through faith, taqwa, and obedience to Him. Consequently, this belief requires rejecting those who claim to be Allah's allies while practicing shirk, sorcery, and disobedience, recognizing them instead as allies of Satan.
dua_usage: Befriend the believers and rely on Allah's management of your life
when_to_invoke: A believer reaches for Al-Waliyy when despairing after relief or rain is withheld—as Dr. Najla Kurdi explains regarding Surah Ash-Shura 42:28—or when fearing that enemies may unsettle them from their religion and turn them away from following the Prophet, as Ibn Jarir at-Tabari explains regarding Surah An-Nisa 4:45.
ghazali_insight: Al-Waliyy, the Patron, is a lover and protector who supports the friends of religion and suppresses its enemies. A patron among men is one who befriends God's friends and shows enmity to His enemies, the worst of whom are one's own soul and Satan.
description_en: Al-Waliyy means the Guardian Lord who is near to His servants and takes charge of their welfare with kindness, guiding believers out of the darkness of disbelief into the light of faith as a guardian cares for a child or an orphan. As As-Sa'di and Dr. Najla Kurdi explain regarding Surah An-Nisa 4:45 and Surah Ash-Shura 42:28, this Name matters because His guardianship procures good for His servants and manages both giving and withholding with perfect wisdom.
description_ms: Al-Waliyy bermaksud Tuhan Pelindung yang dekat dengan hamba-Nya dan mengurus kebajikan mereka dengan penuh ihsan. Dia mengeluarkan orang beriman daripada kegelapan kekufuran kepada cahaya iman sebagaimana seorang penjaga mengurus kanak-kanak atau anak yatim. Seperti yang dijelaskan oleh As-Sa'di dan Dr. Najla Kurdi tentang Surah An-Nisa 4:45 dan Surah Ash-Shura 42:28, Nama ini penting kerana penjagaan-Nya mendatangkan kebaikan kepada hamba-Nya serta mengatur pemberian dan penahanan dengan hikmah yang sempurna.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.79; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, pp. 8805-8807).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the Protecting Friend and Ally who aids and guides the believers, bringing them from darkness into light. This special friendship (wilayah) is a source of tranquility and confidence for the believer, who strives to earn it through faith and piety.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Al-Biqa'i reads Ash-Shura 42:10 through exclusive guardianship: all disputes return to Allah because He alone is Al-Waliyy and Al-Qadeer, and nothing escapes His command. In 42:8 (p. 8805), taking other patrons is a denial of His exclusive wilaya.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, pp. 8805-8807)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِيهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فَحُكْمُهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبِّى عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is [to be referred] to Allah. [Say], "That is Allah, my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back."

proof_text: Or do they possess the treasures of the mercy of your Lord, the All Mighty, the Ever Giving?
aqeedah_belief: Allah is so generous that His immense generosity reaches all His slaves. He grants whatever he wills to whomever He wills. This includes guidance to His true religion, sustenance and cure from diseases.
salah_usage: Let this Name soften the heart before takbir so your salah flows with compassion.
dua_usage: Call upon Al-Wahhab when pleading for forgiveness for yourself, family, and the ummah.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Wahhab dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.
when_to_invoke: Reach for this Name whenever you seek Allah's rahmah after shortcomings.
ghazali_insight: Imam al-Ghazali lists Al-Wahhaab among the names that signify an indication of divine action, specifically as the Bestower. He explains that such names are free from mere synonymy, as each points to a distinct aspect of God's actions. All such attributes ultimately resolve to the singular essence of God and His foundational attributes.
description_en: Al-Wahhab reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Wahhab mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.135; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 16, p. 337 / page_id 8261).
al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Al-Wahhab (The Giver of Gifts) requires the believer to preserve Allah's great gifts, especially the gift of guidance, from being lost. This is achieved by avoiding what causes them to be lost, and by supplicating to Allah for steadfastness, just as the 'firm in knowledge' did when they asked Him not to let their hearts deviate after being guided.
dhikr_usage_en: Recite Ya Al-Wahhab during morning and evening dhikr while expressing gratitude for countless blessings.
dhikr_usage_ms: Sebut Ya Al-Wahhab dalam zikir pagi dan petang sambil mensyukuri nikmat yang tidak terhitung.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Sad 38:9, rebuking disbelievers who objected to prophethood, al-Biqa'i explains why 'Al-'Azeez Al-Wahhaab' is used: Allah freely bestows His mercy and revelation out of pure grace to whomever He wills, and none can restrict His gifts.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 16, p. 337 / page_id 8261)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?

proof_text: Allah is beautiful and loves beauty.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Jameel commits a Muslim to affirming that real beauty belongs to Allah in His Essence, Names, Attributes, and Actions in a manner befitting His majesty, without specifying how or likening Him to creation, as Al-Jalil states in connection with Quran 42:11 and Sahih Muslim 91. As Qadi Abu Ya'la al-Farra' explains, His beauty is an attribute of His Essence itself and cannot be reduced merely to His act of beautifying creatures or bestowing favors upon them. Furthermore, as Al-Sa'di explains, all of His actions revolve around goodness, wisdom, and justice with no vanity or wrong, and the greatest bliss of the people of Paradise will be beholding their Lord's unmatched beauty.
dua_usage: Call upon Al-Jameel out of longing to behold the One Who possesses all beauty in Paradise, following the Prophetic example that Al-Jalil cites from Sunan an-Nasa'i 1237 (graded sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih an-Nasa'i 1237).
when_to_invoke: You reach for Al-Jameel when seeking tranquility and contentment during painful decrees—trusting, as Al-Jalil explains, that only what is wise and beautiful arises from His beautiful actions—and when yearning for the supreme bliss of beholding Him in Paradise.
ghazali_insight: Al-Jameel, the Beautiful, is the one qualified by beauty. This beauty is not merely external form, but the interior form of majesty and perfection apprehended by insight. God is the truly and absolutely beautiful one, as all beauty and perfection in the world comes from the light of His essence.
description_en: Al-Jameel is the One Who possesses absolute, unmatched beauty in His Essence, Names, Attributes, and Actions, and Who is the sole source of every outward and inward beauty in existence. As Ibn al-Qayyim and Al-Sa'di explain, knowing Him by this Name inspires the believer to love Him for His perfection, long to behold Him in Paradise, and worship Him by beautifying both inward character and outward conduct.
description_ms: Al-Jameel ialah Tuhan yang memiliki keindahan mutlak yang tiada tandingan pada Zat, Nama-Nama, Sifat-Sifat, dan Perbuatan-Nya, serta menjadi punca tunggal bagi setiap keindahan zahir dan batin di alam wujud ini. Seperti yang dijelaskan oleh Ibn al-Qayyim dan Al-Sa'di, mengenali-Nya dengan Nama ini mendorong orang beriman untuk mencintai-Nya kerana kesempurnaan-Nya, merindui nikmat melihat-Nya di syurga, dan beribadah kepada-Nya dengan memperindah akhlak batin serta amalan zahir.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.167
al_jalil_commentary: Allah is beautiful and loves beauty, which should inspire the believer to worship Him through the beauty He loves in words, deeds, and character. One should beautify their tongue with truth and their heart with sincerity, love, and reliance upon Him.

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Pemurah Lagi Banyak Memberi
proof_text: Allah is Most Generous and He loves generosity.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Jawaad commits a Muslim to affirming that boundless munificence is a necessary attribute of Allah's Essence, just like His life, knowledge, hearing, and sight, and that all generosity in creation is less than a drop in the ocean compared to His giving. As Al-Sa'di explains, His universal munificence continuously sustains every creature in the heavens and the earth, while His special munificence answers petitioners and prepares vast bliss in Paradise for those who perfect their servitude to Him. Furthermore, as Ibn al-Qayyim states, Allah's absolute munificence never contradicts His wisdom, as He sends down provision in due measure and places His bounty where it belongs.
dua_usage: Call upon Al-Jawaad with hopeful expectation and utter neediness before Him, asking abundantly from His bounty since, as Ibn al-Qayyim explains in connection with Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3770 (graded sahih by Al-Albani), nothing is more beloved to Al-Jawaad than being hoped in and asked, which spares the servant from His anger.
when_to_invoke: You reach for Al-Jawaad when afflicted by hardship or in urgent need of His bounty—turning to Him in supplication either by spoken request or through the state of your poverty, as Al-Sa'di explains regarding Quran 16:53.
ghazali_insight: Imam al-Ghazali explains that true munificence (Al-Jawaad) belongs only to God, who gives to every needy person without seeking any return or fulfilling a personal goal, whether immediate or delayed. A true giver is one who benefits others solely for their sake, not for praise or to avoid blame.
description_en: Al-Jawaad is the Absolute Munificent One Whose abundant giving encompasses all creatures and Who never disappoints anyone who asks Him, whether by spoken word or through the silent state of their need. As Ibn al-Qayyim explains, because munificence is an essential attribute of His Essence, He loves to be hoped in and asked, and He loves for His servants to practice wise generosity in their wealth, knowledge, character, and service.
description_ms: Al-Jawaad ialah Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah secara mutlak yang limpahan pemberian-Nya meliputi seluruh makhluk dan tidak pernah menghampakan sesiapa pun yang memohon kepada-Nya, sama ada melalui kata-kata mahupun melalui keadaan diri yang memerlukan. Seperti yang dijelaskan oleh Ibn al-Qayyim, oleh sebab kemurahan ialah sifat yang lazim bagi Zat-Nya, Dia suka apabila hamba mengharap dan memohon kepada-Nya, serta mencintai hamba-Nya yang mengamalkan sifat pemurah secara bijaksana melalui harta, ilmu, akhlak, dan khidmat.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.147; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md
al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Al-Jawad (The Generous) should lead one to hope in Him, ask of His bounty, and adopt the quality of generosity. Al-Jalil outlines ten levels of generosity for the believer to practice, including generosity with one's life, position, comfort, knowledge, influence, physical help, honor, patience, cheerful disposition, and by not coveting what is in the hands of others.

proof_text: Shall I then seek a judge other than Allah?
aqeedah_belief: He is the One who judges amongst His slaves, in this life and in the hereafter, with absolute fairness and equity, based on (1) His universal will, (2) His religious legislation and (3) His reward and punishment.
salah_usage: Mention this Name when asking Allah to keep you fair in every responsibility.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Hakam when resolving disputes so you uphold the rights of others.
dhikr_usage: Ulang Ya Al-Hakam sebelum membuat keputusan besar agar keputusan menepati keadilan.
when_to_invoke: Lean on it whenever you decide matters that affect others' rights.
ghazali_insight: Al-Hakam is the Arbitrator, the absolute magistrate and avenging judge whose ruling no one overturns and whose decree no one corrects. He arranges all causes and applies them to their effects, making righteousness lead to happiness and iniquity to misery. Nothing escapes His comprehensive decree and perfect predestination.
description_en: Al-Hakam reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Hakam mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.97; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 9, p. 221 / page_id 4285).
al_jalil_commentary: He is the ultimate Judge to whom all judgment belongs and is returned. Belief in this name requires absolute submission to His judgment, whether it be His universal decree, His religious law, or His final judgment on the Day of Resurrection, and to reject any law that contradicts His.
dhikr_usage_en: Repeat Ya Al-Hakam before making major decisions so that decisions adhere to justice.
dhikr_usage_ms: Ulang Ya Al-Hakam sebelum membuat keputusan besar agar keputusan menepati keadilan.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: Closing Surah Yunus (10:109), al-Biqa'i notes that 'He is the Best of Judges' (Al-Hakam) grounds the command to be patient: Allah will decisively settle the dispute between truth and falsehood with absolute justice.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 9, p. 221 / page_id 4285)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: وَٱتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَٱصْبِرْ حَتَّىٰ يَحْكُمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: And follow what is revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and be patient until Allah will judge. And He is the best of judges.

english_meaning: The One Who honourably disdains anything unbecoming His mercy and generosity
bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Memiliki Sifat Malu Yang Mulia
proof_hadith: Reported by At-Tirmidhee and Abu Daawood
proof_text: Your Lord is modest and generous and would never turn the hands of someone without gain when he raises them to Him [in supplication].
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Al-Hayyiyu commits a Muslim to affirming the attribute of hayaa' (modesty and honorable disdain) for Allah in a manner befitting His majesty, without specifying how it is or likening it to the shyness of creatures. As Shaykh Al-Harras and Ibn al-Qayyim explain, unlike creaturely shyness—which is an emotional alteration and brokenness caused by fear of blame—Allah's hayaa' is an attribute of generosity, goodness, and majesty whereby He refrains from anything unbecoming His vast mercy, pardon, and forbearance. Even when a weak, needy servant uses Allah's own blessings to disobey Him openly, Al-Hayyiyu in His complete self-sufficiency and power disdains to tear away the servant's cover, and He invites His servants to call upon Him while disdaining to leave their raised hands unanswered, as Al-Sa'di explains from Sunan Abi Dawud 1488 and Sunan Abi Dawud 4012.
dua_usage: Call upon Al-Hayyiyu by raising your hands to Him in humble brokenness and acknowledgment of your shortcomings, trusting—as Al-Sa'di and Ibn al-Qayyim explain regarding Sunan Abi Dawud 1488 (graded sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih Abi Dawud 1320)—that His generous modesty disdains to leave a supplicant's raised hands unanswered.
when_to_invoke: You reach for Al-Hayyiyu when stretching out your hands in urgent supplication hoping not to be turned away unanswered, or when feeling broken and ashamed before Him after committing sins while He has veiled your fault.
description_en: Al-Hayyiyu is the One Who possesses a lofty attribute of modesty and honorable disdain—arising from His vast mercy, generosity, munificence, and majesty—such that He disdains to expose His disobedient servant or leave a supplicant's outstretched hands unanswered. As Ibn al-Qayyim and Al-Jalil explain, knowing Allah by this Name instills true modesty in the believer, inspiring shyness to be seen by Him in a disgraceful state of sin while He continually bestows blessings and conceals faults.
description_ms: Al-Hayyiyu ialah Tuhan yang memiliki sifat malu yang agung dan mulia—yang berpunca daripada keluasan rahmat, kemurahan, ihsan, dan keagungan-Nya—sehingga Dia enggan membuka aib hamba-Nya yang berdosa atau membiarkan tangan hamba yang berdoa kepada-Nya pulang dengan hampa. Seperti yang dijelaskan oleh Ibn al-Qayyim dan Al-Jalil, mengenali Allah dengan Nama ini menanamkan sifat malu yang sebenar dalam diri orang beriman, iaitu berasa malu untuk dilihat oleh-Nya dalam keadaan melakukan maksiat sedangkan Dia sentiasa melimpahkan nikmat dan menutup keaiban.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.161; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil explains that the name As-Sitteer (The Concealer) is linked to Al-Hayiyy (The Modest), as mentioned in the hadith. This quality means Allah, out of His modesty and desire for concealment, does not expose His servant's sins. Belief in this should inspire love for Him and modesty before Him, as well as the desire to conceal one's own faults and those of others.

bahasa_meaning: Tuhan Yang Maha Memelihara dan Mentadbir
proof_text: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Ar-Rabb commits a Muslim to affirming that Allah alone creates, owns, and actively manages every affair in the universe, which necessarily requires singling Him out in worship without any partner. Because His Lordship encompasses commanding, forbidding, and guiding creation to its purpose, Ibn Al-Qayyim and Al-Jalil explain in connection with Surah Al-Mu'minun 23:115 that He never leaves humanity neglected without revelation. It also entails believing that the unrestricted title Ar-Rabb without annexation belongs exclusively to Allah, as indicated in Sahih al-Bukhari 2552.
salah_usage: In salah, as Ibn Al-Qayyim explains regarding Surah Al-Fatihah 1:2 and the opening of the night prayer in Sahih Muslim 770, invoking Ar-Rabb makes the worshipper witness that Allah alone disposes of all decrees from above His Throne and is the Lord of the three angels entrusted with revelation and life.
dua_usage: Open your supplications by invoking Ar-Rabb annexed to yourself or to His great creations—such as the worlds, the heavens, the earth, and the Throne—to ask for the rectification of your heart, forgiveness of sins as in Surah Al-A'raf 7:23 and Sahih al-Bukhari 6306, protection at bedtime as in Sahih Muslim 2713, or relief from distress as in Sahih al-Bukhari 6345.
dhikr_usage: Dalam zikir, nama Ar-Rabb digunakan untuk mengagungkan dan mensucikan Allah dengan menyandarkannya kepada ciptaan-Nya seperti seluruh alam, langit, bumi, dan Arasy, termasuk dalam zikir sebelum tidur menurut Sahih Muslim 2713 serta zikir ketika kesulitan bersama lafaz tahlil menurut Sahih al-Bukhari 6345.
when_to_invoke: Reach for Ar-Rabb when seeking His special nurturing to rectify your heart, soul, and character, when repenting after wronging yourself as in Surah Al-A'raf 7:23, or when turning to Him for relief in severe distress and calamities.
description_en: Ar-Rabb means the Sovereign Owner, Master, and Disposer of all affairs who brings creation into being stage by stage and sustains every creature with His blessings. Beyond this general nurturing of all existence, As-Sa'di explains that He grants special nurturing to His chosen servants by rectifying their hearts, souls, and character.
description_ms: Ar-Rabb bermaksud Pemilik, Penguasa, dan Pentadbir segala urusan yang mencipta makhluk secara berperingkat serta memelihara mereka dengan pelbagai nikmat. Selain pemeliharaan umum untuk semua makhluk, As-Sa'di menjelaskan bahawa Dia memberikan didikan khas kepada hamba-Nya yang terpilih dengan memperbaiki hati, jiwa, dan akhlak mereka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.7; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md; Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 1, p. 54 / page_id 39).
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil discusses the common human error of harboring ill thoughts (ظَنَّ السوء) about God, feeling shortchanged or deserving of more than one has been given. Belief in Him as the Lord (Ar-Rabb) requires trusting His perfect wisdom and justice, compelling the believer to blame their own soul as the source of ignorance and wrongdoing, rather than finding fault with the Most Merciful and Just Ruler.
dhikr_usage_en: In dhikr, the name Ar-Rabb is used to glorify and sanctify Allah by attributing it to His creation, such as all the worlds, the heavens, the earth, and the Throne, including in supplications before sleep according to Sahih Muslim 2713 and during hardship alongside the phrase of tahlil according to Sahih al-Bukhari 6345.
dhikr_usage_ms: Dalam zikir, nama Ar-Rabb digunakan untuk mengagungkan dan mensucikan Allah dengan menyandarkannya kepada ciptaan-Nya seperti seluruh alam, langit, bumi, dan Arasy, termasuk dalam zikir sebelum tidur menurut Sahih Muslim 2713 serta zikir ketika kesulitan bersama lafaz tahlil menurut Sahih al-Bukhari 6345.

nazm_al_durar_insight.note: In Al-Fatihah 1:2 ('All praise is due to Allah, Rabb of all the worlds'), al-Biqa'i highlights the hadith qudsi of Al-Fatihah as a living dialogue between servant and Lord: praising Allah as 'Rabb al-'Alameen'—Nurturer and Sustainer of every realm—opens the servant's direct supplication for guidance.
nazm_al_durar_insight.source_attribution: Burhan al-Din al-Biqa'i, Nazm al-Durar fi Tanasub al-Ayat wa-l-Suwar (Turath 9098, Vol. 1, p. 54 / page_id 39)
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
nazm_al_durar_insight.ayah_translation: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds -

proof_text: Allah is gentle and loves those who are gentle. He gives for gentleness that which He does not give for harshness.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Ar-Rafeeq commits a Muslim to affirming that Allah's gentleness in unfolding creation stage by stage and revealing sacred laws gradually stems from His wisdom and mercy, despite His complete self-sufficiency and power to create everything at once. As As-Sa'di and Ibn Al-Qayyim explain in connection with Sahih al-Bukhari 6024 and Musnad Ahmad 4/87, it also entails believing that legal concessions in Islamic law are divinely intended expressions of His leniency, and that His delaying punishment for sinners is an act of gentleness to allow repentance.
dua_usage: Be gentle in your dealings; violence does not adorn anything.
when_to_invoke: Reach for Ar-Rafeeq when availing yourself of a legal dispensation to ease hardship, when you need calm restraint while guiding people or facing verbal provocation as in Sahih al-Bukhari 6024, or when seeking hope in Allah's leniency after repenting from sin.
description_en: Ar-Rafeeq means the Gentle One who acts without harshness, bringing creation into existence and legislating His rulings in gradual stages even though He has the power to accomplish everything in a single instant. Through this gentleness, He makes His laws suited to human capacity, grants legal dispensations to remove hardship, and gives disobedient sinners respite so they may repent.
description_ms: Ar-Rafeeq bermaksud Tuhan Yang Maha Lembut yang bertindak tanpa kekerasan, dengan mencipta makhluk serta menetapkan syariat secara berperingkat walaupun Dia mampu melakukan semuanya dalam satu detik. Melalui kelembutan ini, Dia menjadikan hukum-Nya mudah mengikut kemampuan manusia, memberikan rukhsah untuk mengangkat kesukaran, dan memberi tempoh kepada pendosa supaya bertaubat.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.143; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md
al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Ar-Rafeeq (The Gentle) should lead the believer to adopt the quality of gentleness and deliberation in their affairs, both with themselves and with others. The Prophet Muhammad praised this quality, and it should be practiced by being in the middle ground between haste and carelessness.

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Suci daripada Segala Kekurangan
proof_text: [You are] the Supremely glorified, the Holy. [You are] the Lord of the angels and of Jibreel.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in As-Subbooh commits a Muslim to affirming Allah's complete remoteness from any flaw, evil, likeness, partner, opposite, or rival that would be unbefitting of His Divinity. As Ibn Al-Qayyim explains in connection with Surah Al-Jumu'ah 62:1 and Surah Al-Isra 17:44, it also entails believing that every created thing across the seven heavens and the earth actively glorifies and sanctifies Him.
salah_usage: In salah, following the Prophetic practice in Sahih Muslim 487, the worshipper invokes As-Subbooh during bowing and prostration—where, as An-Nawawi explains, it declares Allah free of all imperfections and partners while joining the angels and all creation that prostrate and glorify Him.
dua_usage: Glorify Him frequently, especially in bowing and prostration.
dhikr_usage: Dalam zikir, nama As-Subbooh diamalkan dalam bacaan rukuk dan sujud menurut Sahih Muslim 487 serta dengan memperbanyakkan tasbih dan tahmid pada waktu malam dan penghujung siang bagi menyertai seluruh alam yang sentiasa bertasbih kepada Allah.
when_to_invoke: Reach for As-Subbooh during bowing and prostration in prayer as recorded in Sahih Muslim 487, and during the hours of the night and ends of the day when seeking spiritual comfort by joining the rest of creation in glorifying Allah.
description_en: As-Subbooh means the Supremely Glorified One who is far removed from every defect, evil, partner, opposite, or rival, and whom every being in the seven heavens and the earth continuously glorifies. Believing in this Name connects the worshipper's praise to the universal glorification performed by all creation, as Ibn Al-Qayyim explains regarding Surah Al-Jumu'ah 62:1 and Surah Al-Isra 17:44.
description_ms: As-Subbooh bermaksud Tuhan Yang Maha Disucikan yang jauh daripada segala kekurangan, keburukan, sekutu, lawan, atau tandingan, serta sentiasa disucikan oleh setiap makhluk di tujuh lapisan langit dan bumi. Beriman dengan nama ini menghubungkan tasbih seorang hamba dengan tasbih seluruh alam semesta seperti yang dijelaskan oleh Ibn Al-Qayyim mengenai Surah Al-Jumu'ah 62:1 dan Surah Al-Isra 17:44.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.25; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md
al_jalil_commentary: As-Subbooh is The Glorified, the one declared free from all imperfection. The author states that belief in this Name inspires a person to frequently remember, glorify, and praise Allah throughout the day and night. This practice brings a feeling of comfort and spiritual peace by joining with all of creation in its continuous glorification of God.
dhikr_usage_en: In dhikr, the name As-Subbooh is practiced in the recitations of bowing and prostration according to Sahih Muslim 487, as well as by increasing tasbih and tahmid at night and at the ends of the day to join all creation that continuously glorifies Allah.
dhikr_usage_ms: Dalam zikir, nama As-Subbooh diamalkan dalam bacaan rukuk dan sujud menurut Sahih Muslim 487 serta dengan memperbanyakkan tasbih dan tahmid pada waktu malam dan penghujung siang bagi menyertai seluruh alam yang sentiasa bertasbih kepada Allah.

proof_hadith: Reported by Ahmad and Abu Daawood: Saheeh
proof_text: The Master is Allah.
aqeedah_belief: Believing in As-Sayyid commits a Muslim to affirming, as Al-Khattabi and Al-Azhari explain, that true sovereignty and ownership belong to Allah alone and that all creatures without exception are His slaves. As Ibn al-Qayyim explains, He is the Master of creation who owns all their affairs, to whom they return, by whose command they act, and toward whom all desires and needs of angels, humans, and jinn are directed. While a creature may be called a master in the restricted sense of a leader in goodness—as Ibn al-Anbari explains regarding Quran 3:39—all worldly authority held by disbelievers, hypocrites, and the corrupt is false and devoid of true honor, as indicated by Sunan Abi Dawud 4977.
dua_usage: Act as a true servant to the true Master.
when_to_invoke: A believer reaches for this Name when praised to one's face with titles of mastership as recorded in Sunan Abi Dawud 4806, when holding worldly leadership over others so as not to oppress them or grow arrogant, or when tempted to fear and submit to a human master.
description_en: As-Sayyid means the absolute Master and Owner of all creation, before whom all angels, humans, and jinn are slaves who act by His command, return to Him, and cannot do without Him for the blink of an eye. Recognizing that true, eternal mastership belongs exclusively to Him frees the heart from abasing itself before any human master who possesses neither benefit nor harm, while instilling humility in anyone granted fleeting worldly authority.
description_ms: As-Sayyid bermaksud Tuan dan Pemilik mutlak bagi seluruh makhluk, yang mana semua malaikat, manusia, dan jin ialah hamba-Nya yang bertindak mengikut perintah-Nya serta bergantung kepada-Nya pada setiap detik. Kesedaran bahawa ketuanan yang hakiki dan kekal hanya milik Allah membebaskan hati daripada merendahkan diri kepada tuan dalam kalangan manusia yang tidak memiliki manfaat atau mudarat, serta melahirkan sifat rendah diri dalam hati sesiapa yang diberi kedudukan sementara di dunia.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.157; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md
al_jalil_commentary: Recognizing Allah as the true Master, whose sovereignty is perfect and eternal, leads to dedicating all worship to Him alone. This understanding fosters humility in the believer, preventing them from becoming arrogant with any worldly status, as they know that true mastery belongs only to Allah.

proof_text: Remove the disease, O Lord of mankind, and cure [him/her], for You are the Great Curer…
aqeedah_belief: Believing in Ash-Shaafee commits a Muslim to affirming that Allah alone cures bodies from physical ailments and heals chests from shirk, ignorance, doubts, and base desires through the Qur'an, as At-Tabari explains regarding Quran 17:82. All worldly remedies—such as honey mentioned in Quran 16:69 and lawful ruqyah—are merely created causes that Allah makes effective or nullifies as He wills, so attaching one's heart in fear or hope to a human healer contradicts reliance upon Ash-Shaafee. Furthermore, as Ibn al-Qayyim explains in connection with Quran 2:216 and Quran 4:19, the physical illnesses and calamities Allah decrees for a believer can themselves serve as divine medicine that purges destructive spiritual diseases from the heart.
dua_usage: Following the prophetic sunnah in Sahih al-Bukhari 5675 and Sahih Muslim 2191 and the explanation of Al-Halimi, one calls upon Allah in du'a as Ash-Shaafee—alone or paired with Al-Kaafee—to cure the body of ailments and the chest of doubts, envy, and rancor without attaching the heart to worldly means.
dhikr_usage: Seorang mukmin berzikir dengan memuji dan mensyukuri Ash-Shaafee atas nikmat kesembuhan rohani melalui al-Quran berdasarkan Surah Al-Isra 17:82 serta mengamalkan zikir pagi dan petang yang sahih bagi rawatan dan perlindungan penyakit dengan bertawakal kepada-Nya semata-mata.
when_to_invoke: A believer reaches for this Name when afflicted with bodily sickness, when visiting or performing lawful ruqyah for a sick person as recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari 5675 and Sahih Muslim 2191, or when suffering from spiritual diseases of the chest such as doubt, envy, and rancor.
description_en: Ash-Shaafee means the true Healer who alone cures physical illnesses of the body and spiritual diseases of the heart such as doubts, envy, rancor, and ignorance. Because all medicines and treatments are merely created means that benefit only if He wills, knowing Him by this Name prevents the believer from becoming attached to healers or remedies and anchors the heart in reliance upon Him alone for every cure.
description_ms: Ash-Shaafee bermaksud Penyembuh sebenar yang menyembuhkan penyakit fizikal pada tubuh serta penyakit rohani di dalam hati seperti keraguan, hasad dengki, dendam, dan kejahilan. Memandangkan semua ubat dan rawatan hanyalah asbab yang memberi manfaat dengan izin-Nya sahaja, keimanan kepada Nama ini menghalang seorang mukmin daripada bergantung kepada perawat lalu menetapkan hati untuk bertawakal kepada Allah semata-mata bagi setiap kesembuhan.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.155; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil clarifies that Ash-Shafi (The Healer) is the true healer of both bodies and hearts, and there is no healing except His. The Quran is a healing for the diseases of the heart, such as ignorance and doubt, and also for physical ailments. The servant's need for the healing of the heart through divine guidance is far greater than the body's need for physical medicine.
dhikr_usage_en: A believer engages in dhikr by praising and thanking Ash-Shaafee for the blessing of spiritual healing through the Quran based on Surah Al-Isra 17:82, and practicing authentic morning and evening supplications for treatment and protection from illness while placing complete trust in Him alone.
dhikr_usage_ms: Seorang mukmin berzikir dengan memuji dan mensyukuri Ash-Shaafee atas nikmat kesembuhan rohani melalui al-Quran berdasarkan Surah Al-Isra 17:82 serta mengamalkan zikir pagi dan petang yang sahih bagi rawatan dan perlindungan penyakit dengan bertawakal kepada-Nya semata-mata.

bahasa_meaning: Yang Maha Baik dan Maha Suci
proof_text: O people! Allah is Pure and, therefore, accepts only that which is pure. …
aqeedah_belief: Believing in At-Tayyib commits a Muslim to affirming, as Al-Qadi 'Iyad and Ibn al-Qayyim explain, that Allah is transcendent above every imperfection and that all pure words, pure actions, pure attributes, and pure Names belong to Him alone. Nothing proceeds from Him, ascends to Him, or draws near to Him except what is pure, and as indicated in Sahih Muslim 1015 and Sahih al-Bukhari 1410, He rejects charity and deeds tainted by unlawful wealth. As Ibn al-Qayyim explains regarding Quran 16:32, Quran 24:26, and Quran 39:73, Allah chooses only the purest of every category of creation and made Paradise the exclusive abode of the pure, purifying believers from remaining impurities through repentance, good deeds, or trials before they enter His neighborhood.
salah_usage: As Ibn al-Qayyim explains regarding the Tashahhud in salah, the worshiper attributes all pure words, deeds, and attributes exclusively to At-Tayyib, recognizing that this pure greeting in prayer befits none but Him and requires the ritual purity indicated in Sahih Muslim 224.
dua_usage: In supplication, one calls upon At-Tayyib with pure words and sincere intentions while ensuring one's food, drink, and clothing are lawful, since Sahih Muslim 1015 establishes that unlawful nourishment prevents a supplicant's plea from being answered.
dhikr_usage: Seorang mukmin berzikir dengan memuji dan mensyukuri At-Tayyib atas kurniaan syariat-Nya yang suci sambil memelihara lidah daripada kata-kata keji, dusta, dan umpatan sebagaimana huraian Ibn al-Qayyim terhadap Surah Fatir 35:10 bahawa ucapan yang kotor tidak akan diterima di sisi-Nya.
when_to_invoke: A believer reaches for this Name when purifying one's food, drink, clothing, and charity from unlawful earnings so that one's worship and supplications are not rejected like the traveler nourished by the unlawful in Sahih Muslim 1015.
description_en: At-Tayyib means the Good and Pure One who, as Al-Qadi 'Iyad and Ibn al-Qayyim explain, is completely transcendent above all defects in His essence, Names, attributes, and actions, and from whose purity every pure thing in existence originates. Understanding this Name teaches the believer that only wholesome speech, sincere deeds, and charity from lawful earnings ascend to Him and draw a servant near to Him.
description_ms: At-Tayyib bermaksud Yang Maha Baik dan Maha Suci yang, seperti dijelaskan oleh Al-Qadi 'Iyad dan Ibn al-Qayyim, bebas sepenuhnya daripada sebarang kekurangan pada zat, Nama, sifat, dan perbuatan-Nya, serta daripada kesucian-Nya berpunca segala perkara yang suci. Kefahaman terhadap Nama ini mendidik seorang mukmin bahawa hanya pertuturan yang baik, amalan yang ikhlas, dan sedekah daripada rezeki yang halal akan naik kepada-Nya serta mendekatkan hamba kepada-Nya.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.163; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md
al_jalil_commentary: Belief in Allah as At-Tayyib (The Pure, The Good) means recognizing He only accepts that which is 'tayyib'. This guides a believer to strive to offer only what is pure and good in their words, deeds, and earnings, and to seek out the purest in all aspects of life.
dhikr_usage_en: A believer engages in dhikr by praising and thanking At-Tayyib for the gift of His pure divine law while guarding the tongue from foul speech, falsehood, and backbiting, in accordance with Ibn al-Qayyim's commentary on Surah Fatir 35:10 that impure speech is not accepted in His presence.
dhikr_usage_ms: Seorang mukmin berzikir dengan memuji dan mensyukuri At-Tayyib atas kurniaan syariat-Nya yang suci sambil memelihara lidah daripada kata-kata keji, dusta, dan umpatan sebagaimana huraian Ibn al-Qayyim terhadap Surah Fatir 35:10 bahawa ucapan yang kotor tidak akan diterima di sisi-Nya.

proof_hadith: Reported by At-Tirmidhee and Abu Daawood
proof_text: Allah is the one Who fixes prices and who withholds and gives abundantly.
aqeedah_belief: The Withholder is the One who takes away souls, provision and whatever He pleases, and the Expander is the One who gives provision, mercy and whatever He wishes. He is also the One who stretches out His Hands so that the believers may repent and turn to Him. These two names are among those names of Allah which always come together, for absolute perfection is realised in their combination, and they cannot be used separately.
salah_usage: Raise your hands after salah accepting whatever provision Allah decrees.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Qabid when asking Allah to sustain your family and community with halal rizq.
dhikr_usage: Ingatlah Ya Al-Qabid ketika menyusun urusan harian supaya hati bergantung kepada Pemberi rezeki.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you feel uncertain about rizq and resources.
ghazali_insight: Al-Qabid is the One who contracts, complementing His attribute of expansion. He appropriates souls from bodies at death, restricts sustenance from the poor until no strength remains, and contracts hearts by revealing His overwhelming majesty. A wise person similarly contracts hearts by warning them of God's greatness and justice.
description_en: Al-Qabid reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Qabid mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.139; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil explains that this name should be understood with its counterpart, Al-Basit. Believing in them together brings about pure reliance on Allah, as none can expand what He has contracted. This leads to contentment with His decree, whether in ease or hardship, and motivates one to ask Him for the greatest of expansions: the expansion of the heart with mercy and guidance.
dhikr_usage_en: Remember Ya Al-Qabid when organizing daily affairs so that the heart relies upon the Provider of sustenance.
dhikr_usage_ms: Ingatlah Ya Al-Qabid ketika menyusun urusan harian supaya hati bergantung kepada Pemberi rezeki.

The believer should ask Allah for the best form of expansion, which is the expansion of the heart with the light of faith and freedom from the effects of sin.
dhikr_usage_en: Remember Ya Al-Basit when organizing daily affairs so that the heart relies upon the Provider of sustenance.
dhikr_usage_ms: Ingatlah Ya Al-Basit ketika menyusun urusan harian supaya hati bergantung kepada Pemberi rezeki.

proof_text: …You (i.e. Allah) are the Advancer and You are the Delayer…
aqeedah_belief: He places things where they should exactly belong. He advances and postpones whatever He pleases in His infinite wisdom and absolute justice. He decreed everything before He created the creation. He promotes whomever He wills to the higher positions of the righteous predecessors and delays and holds back whomever he wills, in His absolute wisdom and justice. No one can advance whatever He delays, nor delay whatever He advances.
salah_usage: Remember this Name when making qunut so you accept His decree.
dua_usage: Call Ya Al-Muqaddim whenever Allah redirects your plans.
dhikr_usage: Bisikkan Ya Al-Muqaddim ketika menyampaikan khabar perubahan agar hati tenang.
when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you accept Allah's timing for every affair.
ghazali_insight: Al-Muqaddim is the Promoter who brings close and promotes whomever He wills. He promotes His prophets and friends by drawing them near to Himself and guiding them perfectly. Any promotion in rank or spiritual station comes entirely from His divine will rather than a person's own industry.
description_en: Al-Muqaddim reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Muqaddim mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.141; Al-Ghazali TheNinety-nineBeautifulNamesOfGod_text.pdf; Existing CSV asmaul_husna_retention.csv
al_jalil_commentary: Al-Jalil explains this name should be understood with its counterpart, Al-Mu'akhkhir. Belief in them fosters singular reliance on Allah, since none can advance what He delays or delay what He advances. The believer's standard for who should be advanced—in love, loyalty, and honor—should align with Allah's standard, which is based on piety and faith, not worldly status, wealth, or power.
dhikr_usage_en: Whisper Ya Al-Muqaddim when delivering news of change so that the heart remains calm.
dhikr_usage_ms: Bisikkan Ya Al-Muqaddim ketika menyampaikan khabar perubahan agar hati tenang.

description_en: Al-Mu'akhkhir reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.

al_jalil_commentary: This name should be paired with Al-Muqaddim. Believing in them instills reliance on Allah alone, as He controls all advancement and delay. True advancement is progress in obedience to Allah and towards His pleasure, while true delay is falling behind in that pursuit. The believer thus asks Allah to be advanced in what is good and not be delayed from it.
dhikr_usage_en: Whisper Ya Al-Mu'akhkhir when delivering news of change so that the heart remains calm.
